solving real problems for real people in real communities while advancing careers.we operate on a hybrid schedule with four in-office days per week (monday–thursday). this approach enhances creativity, innovation, communication, and relationship-building, fostering a dynamic and collaborative work environment.for more information, visit covista.com and follow us on linkedin, instagram and youtube.job descriptionthis is a fast-paced and exciting role where you will help shape how the leader of america’s largest healthcare educator shows up, both inside the company and beyond it, at a moment when our story is growing in relevance and scope. as part of his communications team, you’ll be a strategic partner to a ceo who has a voice that’s unmistakably his own. you'll help decide where, when and how to use that voice to move the business forward. you’ll bring business savvy and a fresh pulse on what’s moving across content, the media landscape and culture, including healthcare and education, to sharpen ideas, spot the right moments and match each message to the channel, audience and stage where it will have the most impact. you’ll be part counselor, part editor and part strategist. the work is high-visibility and high-trust. you’ll partner closely with the executive office and senior leadership. you’ll also work across corporate affairs (investor relations, government and public affairs, alumni engagement and social impact) and with our institutions so that every appearance, post and message builds a clear, credible leadership presence that carries our purpose further.responsibilities:ceo voice and platform strategy help build and steward the ceo’s communications platform, including core narratives, signature themes and proof points that line up with covista’s business strategy and reputation goals elevate his authority by spotting the ideas, data and moments where covista can shape the national conversation on healthcare and education, and finding the formats that carry them furthest stay at the leading edge of how executives break through: track what’s working across media, platforms and formats and bring the ideas worth trying be a trusted editorial partner: a second set of eyes and a collaborator, keeping covista’s narrative consistent across every format and audience offer counsel on which moments to lead, which to amplify and which to skip, based on business priorities, news cycles and audience insight \channels, events and moments help plan the ceo’s external visibility across speaking engagements, conferences, media, industry forums, policy settings and executive social, choosing opportunities for business impact rather than volume connect the ceo’s voice to key business moments, including earnings, investor events, partnerships, research launches and major company milestones, working closely with investor relations and corporate communications help shape the ceo’s internal communications presence, including town halls, leadership forums and colleague messages, so his voice reaches our people as clearly as it reaches external audiences counsel, preparation and execution lead preparation for high-stakes moments, including briefing materials, messaging, q&a and rehearsal for media interviews, keynotes, panels and investor-facing settings draft and edit when needed, including speeches, remarks, bylines and presentations, while also editing and elevating the ceo’s own writing build and run the ceo’s communications calendar and operating rhythm with his chief of staff and executive assistant, making sure approvals, timelines and details are handled define and report on success measures for the ceo’s platform, connecting visibility and engagement to reputation and business outcomes use ai and technology to work smarter, sharpen insight and move faster  who thrives here: you’re a strategic communicator first. you know that the most valuable thing you can do for a ceo is help them say the right thing in the right place at the right moment, not write every word. you’re a trend spotter by instinct, seeing what’s breaking through in media, culture and executive communications before it’s obvious and turning it into thought leadership worth acting on. you’ve earned the trust of top executives by being candid, discreet and consistently right on judgment, so you’re confident pushing back and comfortable in any room with senior leaders. you have a great ear for voice, so the work gets stronger and still sounds like him. you’re energized by building rather than maintaining, drawn to a mission bigger than any single message and at your best as part of a team. qualificationsbachelor's degree in communications, marketing, journalism or a related field building an executive’s platform and choosing the channels, moments and opportunities that advanced business goals an exceptional editor’s ear: the ability to absorb a leader’s voice, sharpen their thinking and elevate their own writing across formats executive social expertise: hands-on experience shaping a senior leader’s linkedin presence with measurable impact business fluency: comfort working at the intersection of corporate reputation, investor relations and company strategy, ideally at a publicly traded company discretion and presence: trusted with sensitive information, steady in high-stakes situations, and confident counseling senior leaders comfort with ai tools: you actively use ai to produce better work, faster  preferred background: experience supporting executives at publicly traded companies is a plus, as is a background in higher education, healthcare or regulated industries. you move easily between strategic counsel and flawless execution. you build trust quickly with the executive office, internal partners and external stakeholders alike. a bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or a related field is required. if you want your best descriptionwest basin municipal water district (west basin) is a global leader in the water industry in water recycling, conservation, water resource management, and youth and adult education. west basin provides drinking water and recycled water to six cities, four private water utilities, one county waterworks district and one groundwater agency. the district serves a population of nearly one million residents in 17 cities and unincorporated areas along the coastal corridor from palos verdes to malibu. the district is governed by an elected five-member board of directors and is a member agency of the metropolitan water district of southern california.west basin operates the edward c. little water recycling facility and three satellite locations. it is the largest treatment and water purification system of its type providing nearly 40 million gallons of water each day to nearly 600 site connections. west basin utilizes various advanced treatment processes to produce five types of detail.desc: descriptionamazon’s last-mile delivery network touches millions of customers every day — and with that scale comes real scrutiny. legislation, regulatory shifts, and coordinated advocacy campaigns can move fast, and the stories they generate don’t wait for anyone. this role puts you at the center of how amazon identifies, understands, and responds to the issues that matter most to its last-mile delivery operations.as communications manager, last-mile issues and campaigns, you'll own the communications strategy for a portfolio that touches aspects of amazon's last-mile delivery model. last-mile delivery touches regulation, safety, and public trust, and this role sits at the center of how we communicate across all of it. you'll lead strategic narrative development and scenario planning that keeps the team ahead of legislative shifts, emerging campaigns, and related issues. you'll coordinate across relevant business lines and communications teams, partnering with policy comms, field comms, and others, to bring the right expertise to bear at the right moment and ensure amazon speaks with one clear, strategic voice. you'll draft the statements, talking points, and briefing documents that represent amazon externally, and you'll manage the feedback and approval cycles that come with them. you'll spend as much time seeding stories and shaping narratives as you do managing the reactive moments that come with the portfolio.you're a high-judgment communicator who doesn't flinch when things get complicated. you can hold multiple fast-moving situations at once without losing your footing, but what sets you apart is your ability to spot the issue before it breaks and start building the strategy, not just the response. you think clearly under pressure, write precisely on deadline, and know how to bring the right people together at the right moment. you're comfortable as an on-the-record spokesperson, and you know how to work with reporters to shape a story before it spirals. you think like a strategist, connecting dots across policy, operations, and reputation to protect and advance the business. you don't wait to be told there's a problem. you've already mapped the landscape, built the plan, and brought the right people to the table.this is a strong independent contributor role that reports into the core operations communications team within the global operations and workplace reputation team.key job responsibilitiesmanage complex, fast-moving, and unexpected communications challenges with high judgment and professionalism.be precise under tight deadlines and prioritize and manage multiple situations simultaneously.effectively represent amazon as an on-the-record spokesperson.work with reporters to correct and clarify breaking news stories.write, develop, and manage approvals of external communications materials dealing with sensitive and timely topics.participate in multi-stakeholder emergency response meetings to provide insight and guidance from an external communications point-of-view.a day in the lifeyou might start your morning scanning media coverage and legislative trackers to flag any new developments that could affect amazon’s last-mile operations — then pull together a quick brief for a leader heading into a sensitive meeting. by midday, you could be on a call with legal and public policy partners to assess the communications implications of a pending bill or regulatory action, working through the messaging framework and drafting an initial statement. in the afternoon, you may shift to handling a reactive media inquiry on a breaking story, coordinating approvals in real time while staying in close contact with the reporter to manage the narrative. you’ll close out by updating scenario plans for upcoming legislative milestones and checking in with issues managers across the team to make sure nothing’s falling through the cracks.about the teamwe’re a team of strategic communicators responsible for telling the story of how amazon gets people their packages — from the first mile to the last. we work across organizational boundaries to develop integrated communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. we use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. we value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.on the issues side of the team, we move fast and we move together. when a legislative campaign or regulatory challenge emerges, we’re the ones coordinating the response — aligning messaging across legal, policy, and business partners and making sure amazon’s voice is clear, consistent, and credible. we’re building for the long term — investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as amazon grows. if you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other’s growth, this is the team for you.basic qualifications bachelor's degree 7+ years of recent professional communications or public relations consumer product, link, makes online payments and digital transactions effortless and secure—the digital wallet for what’s next.this is a unique opportunity to continue building a standalone brand and introduce it to new global audiences. you’ll play a key role in making payments more personal and convenient while doing some of the most impactful work of your career.about the teamsitting within brand studio, the link team is building stripe’s first consumer brand. we build, evolve, and maintain a versatile, forward-looking visual identity system and find clear, fresh ways to apply it across surfaces. the brand designers on our team are multidisciplinary: they design robust visual systems, lead art direction, and craft surfaces that prioritize brand and product storytelling.working with cross-functional teams across stripe and external partners, we set the vision and execute to a high quality bar. our work shows up irl, online, and everywhere between.what you’ll doyou’ll be joining a highly creative team that spans anywhere from developing storytelling to creating digital tools, brand systems to rapid ideation. the work is highly experimental, idea driven, and very collaborative and cross-functional.responsibilitiesbe an adamant maker that is genuinely curious, experimental, and loves to tinker, iterate quickly, and innovate on ideas, narrative, and making beautiful thingscontribute to raising the team's standards and culture of craft through the quality, clarity, and consistency of your own workelevate and shape a brand system that is flexible enough to work across various surfaces and exemplifies stripe’s commitment to craft & beautycollaborate with like-minded creative people who have radically different skill sets and together create ideas that envision an optimistic, progressive futurepartner widely with cross-functional teams to build upon great ideas through making thingsgive and solicit feedback from wide range of teammates and stakeholderswho you arewe’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. if you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. the preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.minimum requirements5+ years of relevant design and art direction experience for technical and product-driven companiesexperience creating high-quality visual design work, with strong typography and a hands-on approach to making and iterating.strong track record of independently delivering work as well as influencing the work of other designers, contractors, and agenciesexperience applying and evolving a brand in a fast-paced environment.proficient in figma, adobe creative cloud, keynote, and google slidesdemonstrated experimentation with ai tools to both generate ideas, get stakeholders to see where an idea is headed, and to scale designexceptional craftpreferred qualificationscuriosity, ambition, and a distinct point of view on design, with strong typography skills and an appreciation for creative process, technology, and design engineering.are persuasive and humble in explaining your work, process, and decisionshave excellent organization and presentation skills, and excel in written and verbal communicationlove working with other designers to help them learn and grow—and invite them to help you learn and growexperience partnering with cross-functional teams.creative coding or creative technologist background is a nice to havein-office expectationsoffice-assigned stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. this expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. for example, stripes in stripe delivery center roles in mexico city, mexico, bengaluru, india, and dublin, ireland work 100% from the office. also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. this approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.pay and benefitsthe annual us base salary range for this role is $175,200 - $262,800. for sales roles, the range provided is the role’s on target earnings ("ote") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. this salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the us may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.we look forward to hearing from you.at stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. you're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. at stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. join us.apply nowplease find our california applicant personal information notice here.

company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. incumbents like adp and workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. warp is built for ai to be the primary operator. every advance in llm capability widens our lead.we process $x billion in annual payments for high-growth companies across all 50 us states + globally.we've and the founders of dropbox and replit. our team comes from mit, ramp, brex, google, gusto, rippling, and more.we hire people who ship constantly, own outcomes, and care about craft. if you want to automate an entire category of work that every company depends on, this is the place.as a brand designer at warp, you'll be directly responsible for shaping how the world sees us. you'll own our logo and visual identity system, design the graphics that show up in every campaign, deck, and launch, and turn complex financial concepts into visuals people actually want to look at. working closely with marketing, product, and the founding team, you'll set the visual bar for a company still still early in its story and design the marks and systems that carry warp as we scale,we're looking for someone who's obsessed with:craft. sharp typography, clean systems, a logo and identity that hold up at any size or surface. story. turning complex financial concepts into visuals people actually want to look at. speed. shipping polished work fast, without waiting for a perfect brief. systems. building the templates, guidelines, and libraries that let the rest of the company move fast without breaking the brand. what you’ll doown warp's logo and visual identity including the marks, systems, and standards that show up across product, marketing, and every customer touchpoint. design the assets that drive growth. social posts, landing pages, event posters, and team merch that turn attention into pipeline while keeping the brand consistent. build the operating system for brand: guidelines, templates, and asset libraries that let anyone at warp ship on-brand work fast. prototype fast. use design software and ai to test new directions before committing to a final concept. own the production pipeline from asset handoff to print- and web-ready exports, so design never becomes the bottleneck. partner directly with marketing, product, and sales to turn briefs into polished visual work that fits the moment. lead by making. ship 2–3 brand-defining pieces of work each year—a rebrand element, a campaign identity, a flagship asset—that raise the bar for how warp looks. spot the opportunities to sharpen and evolve warp's visual identity as the company scales, and make the case for the changes that matter. coordinate with freelancers, print vendors, or production partners when a project needs extra hands.  what you need4+ years of experience in brand, graphic, or visual design. hybrid thinking, someone who thrives at the intersection of craft and speed, brand and business. a strong portfolio demonstrating logo design and brand identity work. strong expertise in design software (pref. figma, adobe illustrator, photoshop)startup or digital agency experience. solid understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy. strong operational instincts. you have a passion for building templates, guidelines, and processes that let the whole company move fast without breaking the brand. proactive, can-do attitude and are equally excited to push boundaries as you are to shipability to juggle multiple projects with grace, manage your own timelines, and thrive in fast-paced environments. excellent communication skillshigh agency and the ability to figure things outnice to haveexperience with motion graphics or basic animationfamiliarity with brand strategy or naming projectsillustration skillsan understanding of fintech or b2b product brandingbenefits at warp: 100% health coverage: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents. 401(k) matching: start investing in your future from day one. flexible pto: we offer uncapped flexible pto, meaning you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge while balancing your responsibilities and team commitments. commuter benefits: pre-tax commuter benefits for your daily trip to our nyc office. catered lunch daily: great food, every day, on us. no meal prep, no decision fatigue. quarterly offsites: beautiful locations to connect as a team. past locations include spain, catskills, and san francisco. warp is based in new york city, and most of our team works together in-office 5x per week. please refer to the top of this page for this position's hiring location and working model. compensation range: $125k - $170k

about fairefaire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. at faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. with the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.we’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. if you believe in community, come join ours.about this rolewe are looking for an analytical, creative, and resourceful seo/aeo content strategist to help grow faire’s visibility and authority across both traditional search engines and emerging answer engines such as chatgpt and google ai mode.this person will help research, identify, and execute content opportunities across faire’s owned properties to improve organic search and ai visibility. they will combine hands-on content creation, optimization, and refreshes with data-driven research to identify high-impact opportunities across the blog, landing pages, transactional pages, youtube, and other relevant surfaces.the ideal candidate combines strong content writing skills, editorial judgment, and seo expertise. you’re curious about how ai is quality. above all, you always put the customer first.what you’ll dohelp shape and execute faire’s content strategy across owned properties to grow organic visibility, qualified traffic, and authority across traditional search engines and ai answer engines like chatgpt and google ai mode.conduct keyword, competitive, and search-intent research to identify high-impact topics, content gaps, and and communicate performance and progress to key stakeholders.optimize content structure, internal linking, and on-page seo to help search engines and ai platforms discover, understand, and cite faire’s content.build and optimize ai powered workflows to streamline research, drafting, content enrichment, optimization, and publishing while maintaining editorial standards and content quality.partner closely with brand, social, product, community, and engineering to strengthen faire’s authority and build a consistent, differentiated source of information about wholesale and independent retail.qualifications4-6 years of experience in seo, content marketing, editorial strategy, or a related field.proven track record of growing organic traffic, ai visibility, and we’re looking for the steven spielberg of sales content: someone with real sales experience who wants to work with the top 1% of sales trainers and practitioners to make sales training actionable, practical, and fun.if sitting in the director’s chair at the #1 media company in sales sounds like your kind of next chapter, you’re in the right place.this is a content role. no quota. but you need 3+ years of sales experience, because you’ll be doing things like:interviewing an ae who hit 302% of their number and getting them to show exactly how they prospect on camerataking a topic like territory planning and finding the angle that makes it useful and funbuilding a discovery call teardown with blue chip trainers like jen allen-knuth, mark kosoglow, jason bay, todd caponi, and moreyour job: turn what top 1% sellers do into step-by-step content other sellers can actually use.directing youtube content: live cold calling, negotiation training, new podcast bits. you’ll help shape the concepts, structure the lessons, and storyboard content that makes learning sales actually fun. writing our newsletter, blog & toolkits: you’ll work with top sellers and leaders to turn their president’s club stories into punchy, tactical 30mpc breakdowns for the #1 sales newsletter on the internet. bringing new ideas to life: from our next course to a sponsored concept that pushes the edge to a new youtube series, you’ll help turn ideas into the fun, practical content people expect from 30mpc. you might be a seller looking to move into content, or a marketer with sales experience. either way:you must have 3+ years of sales experience, ideally in tech. you can explain the science behind good selling. you know why one discovery question gets a buyer talking and another fizzles. you can spot where a negotiation went off the rails and explain what should have happened instead. you’re a phenomenal writer. you’re excited to turn interviews and ideas into tactical newsletters and blog posts that people actually want to read. we create together in nyc, because the best content ideas happen face-to-face.in-person location (nyc + retreats!): you’ll work with me (hi, i’m nick). i’m based in nyc, and so is 75% of our team. we meet in person 3x per week because we do our best content jamming around a whiteboard, not on zoom. compensation: we pay at the 75th percentile and include performance-based bonuses for key roles to reward top performers. compensation, level, and pay band will be determined by the candidate’s experience. annual salary for this role ranges from $100,000 to $145,000. benefits: we have top notch healthcare, including a plan with fully covered premiums, a 401(k), and fun perks like team retreats. our last one was in costa rica!want to try working together first? we occasionally begin with a paid 30-day trial to de-risk the move for both sides before going full-time.ready to help more sellers punch their ticket to president’s club? we’d love to meet you!

detail.desc: position summarysdsu is seeking a media relations officer for the college of health and human services (chhs). this role is part of the sdsu media relations team and will report to the senior director of media relations and deputy chief communications officer in sdsu’s department of strategic communications and public affairs (stratcomm). the ideal candidate will be able to find the story in complex research and translate it into clear, accurate, and engaging content for general audiences. in this role, you will tell stories about chhs-related research, highlighting the real-world impact on individuals, communities, and society. this is journalistic research writing, not a grant writing or technical writing role.the chhs media relations officer will work directly with researchers, faculty, university leaders, members of the media, and fellow campus communicators to develop compelling stories, elevating chhs research and initiatives locally, nationally, and internationally.this is a hands-on communications role with plenty of variety. one day, you may be interviewing a researcher, writing about a new study, and pitching the story to national media; another, you may be developing a communications plan for a college initiative, preparing a faculty member for an interview, responding to a media inquiry, or creating multimedia and social media content. the individual in this role will also be responsible for monitoring chhs-related news and online conversations, assessing emerging issues, and recommending messaging and communications strategies.what you'll doresearch storytelling & contentidentify compelling stories across sdsu's research enterprise, particularly in health, science, and human services.translate complex research into clear, engaging stories for sdsu newscenter, sdsu magazine, websites, social media, external media pitching, and other channels.develop multimedia and short-form content that expands the reach of research stories.media relationsdevelop targeted pitches, news releases, media advisories, and communications plans.build relationships with regional, national, and international reporters and identify opportunities to connect sdsu researchers and experts with the news.coordinate interviews and prepare faculty and staff for media engagement.respond to media inquiries and develop recommended messaging and statements.college of health and human services communicationsserve as a key communications partner to chhs faculty and leadership.identify stories, develop communications strategies, and coordinate media relations, editorial, and social media efforts.develop content for college communications, including newsletters, websites, and other digital channels.collaborate across stratcomm and with campus communications partners to keep messaging aligned.issues & emerging communicationsmonitor news and social media for emerging issues, misinformation, and reputational concerns.draft holding statements, faqs, reactive messaging, and communications recommendations.balance proactive storytelling with the real-time communications needs of a large public research university.what we're looking forwe're looking for an experienced communicator who can move comfortably between journalistic science writing, media relations, and strategic communications. you should be able to interview researchers and translate complex scientific, health-related, and technical information into clear, accurate, and compelling stories for general audiences. this is not a grant writing or technical writing role.you should be able to make complicated subjects accessible, recognize a strong story, build relationships with reporters, manage competing priorities, and exercise good judgment when issues move quickly.above all, this role is for someone who is curious enough to dig into a complicated subject, confident enough to ask the follow-up question, and adaptable enough to switch gears when the story changes.as part of the california state university (csu) system, san diego state university helps power one of the largest and most impactful public university systems in the nation. see what it’s like to work at the csu—watch our video and imagine your future here: working at the csu .position informationthis is a full-time (1.0 time-base), benefits eligible, permanent/probationary position.this position is designated as exempt under flsa and is not eligible for overtime compensation.standard sdsu work hours are monday – friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., but may vary based on operational needs. the position is approved for partial telecommuting with onsite work at the san diego campus on monday and wednesday. please note that the incumbent will be called to campus on telecommuting days to support campus activities as needed.department summarysan diego state university (sdsu) is a leading public research university within the california state university system, serving more than 46,000 students. sdsu is recognized for its academic excellence, research, innovation, global engagement, and commitment to student success.the president serves as the university’s chief executive officer, providing leadership for sdsu’s academic mission, operations, and strategic priorities. the office of the president supports the president in carrying out these executive responsibilities and advancing the university’s goals.strategic communications and public affairs (stratcomm) serves as the official voice of sdsu, sharing the president’s vision, values, and priorities and telling the university’s story to campus and external audiences. stratcomm leads communications across marketing, media relations, social media, web and digital communications, executive and internal communications, crisis and issues management, visual communications, and government and community relations. the department also manages and protects the sdsu brand and works with partners across the university to highlight sdsu’s programs, achievements, and impact.for more information regarding the strategic communications and public affairs (stratcomm) department, click here .education and experienceequivalent to a bachelor’s degree in a related field and four years of relevant experience. additional experience which demonstrates acquired and successfully applied knowledge and abilities shown above may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. an advanced degree in a related field may be substituted for the required experience on a year-for-year basis.key qualificationsdemonstrated experience in strategic communications, media relations, and science or research communications, preferably within a large organization.exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific, engineering, and technical information into clear, compelling content for broad audiences.proven success developing media strategies, building relationships with reporters, and securing earned media coverage at the regional, national, or international level.experience advising executives, faculty, researchers, or subject-matter experts on media engagement, strategic messaging, issues management, and reputational considerations.ability to develop and execute integrated communications across earned media, digital, social, editorial, and multimedia channels.demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, cross-functional communications projects, balance competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.experience using media analytics, audience insights, and performance data to evaluate communications efforts and inform strategy.strong knowledge of communications and editorial best practices, including ap style.preferred qualifications:experience supporting science, research, engineering, or technology communications within higher education, a research institution, public agency, or similarly complex organization.knowledge of higher education communications and the research environment, particularly within a public research university.professional proficiency in spanish is desirable.licenses/certifications requiredvalid california driver’s license or the ability to obtain one within 30 days of hire.compensation and benefitssan diego state university offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth.compensationstep placement will be determined based on relevant qualifications and professional experience, in alignment with the department’s budget and equity guidelines.initial step placement is not expected to exceed step 1 ($5,877/month).salary step placement for internal applicants will follow the csueu collective bargaining agreement.csu classification salary range: $5,877-$8,561 per month (step 1-step 20).future increases, including step advancements, are subject to contract negotiations.full benefits package includesgenerous time off: 15 paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave.retirement: calpers pension plan with retiree healthcare, and reciprocal agreements with other california public retirement systems, including the uc.health coverage: medical, dental, and vision options at low or no cost.education support: csu tuition fee waiver for employees and eligible dependents.optional offerings: flexcash, life and disability insurance, legal and pet plans.campus & community: access to the library, campus events, employee groups, and volunteer and social activities.our benefits are a significant part of total compensation. learn more at the sdsu with title vi of the civil rights act of 1964, title ix of the education amendments of 1972, the americans with disabilities act (ada), section 504 of the rehabilitation act, the california equity in job descriptionwho we arecreative artists agency (caa) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, licensing, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, caa’s diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. the trailblazer of the agency business, caa was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in china, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations.the departmentcaa brand consulting is a strategy-led, full-service marketing agency with expertise in cultural and consumer insights, data and analytics, talent/influencer and property partnership advisory, experiential, social impact, creative services, and content and digital strategy. these integrated capabilities come together to offer solutions from planning through execution, and we pull in a collective perspective of expertise with each client brief to ensure we are tapping into diverse thinking and building strategies reflective of the marketplace and culture we work within.the rolewe are seeking a designer to join the caa brand consulting creative team to focus on brand & design. equal parts conceptual thinker, craftsperson, and visual storyteller, this role independently develops strategically grounded brand systems, campaigns, experiential graphics, and customer-facing creative across sports, entertainment, media, and culture.working closely with creative directors, art directors, account directors, project managers, and experiential partners, the designer manages multiple owned workstreams, develops and presents conceptually led solutions, and delivers polished creative across digital, print, environmental, presentation, and motion touchpoints. the role also contributes to pitches, provides guidance to junior designers, and maintains rigorous brand, production, and quality-control standards in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.essential functions:independently concept, develop, and execute brand identity systems, campaigns, and customer-facing creative across a portfolio of sports, entertainment, and cultural brands, ensuring every solution is strategically grounded and visually compelling.champion exceptional craft across digital, print, presentation, environmental, and experiential design, delivering world-class creative that elevates both brand and fan experiences.develop graphic identity systems and production-ready assets for live events, sponsorship activations, and environmental applications, partnering closely with experiential teams to ensure cohesive translation across physical, digital, and motion touchpoints.partner with creative directors, account teams, and external partners to transform business objectives into integrated creative solutions.clearly communicate creative concepts and design rationale to internal leadership and clients, incorporating feedback while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.provide day-to-day guidance, constructive feedback, and craft support to junior designers while contributing actively to team reviews and shared creative standards.independently manage a large initiative or multiple concurrent workstreams, allocating time effectively, meeting milestones, and ensuring creative output remains aligned with the brief, workback schedule, and quality standards.requirements:2-4+ years of graphic design and/or brand design experience within media, entertainment, sports, broadcasting, lifestyle, or cultural brands. environmental and experiential design experience, a big plus.develop multiple high-quality creative concepts and design solutions that respond to strategic briefs across a range of visual styles.strong understanding of brand identity systems, logo development, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.exceptional eye for composition, color, texture, lighting, hierarchy, and detail, with the ability to create premium, visually compelling work.advanced-to-expert proficiency in photoshop, indesign, and illustrator, including high-end compositing, retouching, image finishing, and vector illustration.working knowledge of after effects and premiere pro is a plus; proficiency with figma, powerpoint, or presentations and design documentation.strong conceptual mindset with experience translating ideas into compelling visual narratives, storyboards, and customer-facing experiences.confident presenter who can clearly articulate creative rationale to internal teams and clients while managing project feedback and revisions.manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to consistently meet deadlines and creative standards.actively contribute to brainstorms, collaborate across disciplines, mentor junior designers, and help elevate the overall quality of the creative team.build trusted relationships with clients and cross-functional teams by proactively communicating project status, solving challenges, and contributing thoughtful creative recommendations.preferred skills:conceptual thinking: ability to translate business and brand objectives into original, strategically grounded creative concepts.communication & presentation: excellent verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to confidently present work, explain creative rationale, and incorporate feedback.collaboration: strong cross-functional partnership skills with the ability to work effectively with the creative team, account leaders, and external partners.creative problem solving: ability to think critically, adapt quickly, and develop innovative design solutions that balance creativity with business objectives.locationthis role will be hybrid, located in our new york office or los angeles office. the brand consulting department offers a flexible work schedule and requires a minimum of three days per week on-site.compensationthe annual base salary range for this position is as global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like booking.com, healthequity, allianz, sap, barmeniagothaer, and tui already deploying parloa at scale.about the roleparloa is looking for an experienced sr. brand designer to define and craft our brand’s visual identity across all touchpoints.in this role, you will design high-impact brand assets to support digital marketing, field events, product marketing, high-stakes presentations, and more. you’ll join our in-house creative team, reporting directly to the global head of design & creative to help set the standard of creative at parloa and the category. this role combines design excellence, team collaboration, and ai-driven innovation. you’ll work within parloa’s brand design system to ensure every asset is not only consistent and precise but also visionary, guiding, and emotionally resonant.areas of ownershipcraft the direction and expression of parloa brand designparticipate in the creative development of assets across digital and physical channels. partner with marketing, brand, content, product, sales, and partnerships teams to align visual storytelling.set the visual bar, and ensure brand fidelity detail.desc: the american cancer society cancer action network (acs can) is the nation's leading cancer advocacy organization. together with our charitable partner, the american cancer society, we work in congress, state legislatures and local jurisdictions to support evidence-based policy and legislative solutions designed to eliminate cancer as a major health problem.leads media advocacy efforts for assigned territory of arkansas, florida, louisiana, texas, oklahoma and puerto rico, both in english and spanish, providing input into campaign planning, implementing tactics to support policy and revenue activities, driving relevance, and enhancing acs can brand recognition in support of local, state, and federal priorities. provides a full range of media outreach, including developing target media lists and building relationships with key capitol press corps, health reporters and diverse news outlets. drafts talking points, fact sheets, news releases/advisories as well as opinion editorial articles and letters to the editor. secures editorial meetings and earned media placement by leveraging digital media skills and selling story ideas by phone and electronically to print, radio and tv newsrooms.***candidates must be home based in one of these following states/territories: arkansas, florida, louisiana, texas, oklahoma and puerto rico. must be a strong communicator with excellent writing and verbal skills in english and spanish. prior experience with legislative and advocacy campaign experience is highly preferred. ***essential functions:assist in drafting and implementation of strategic media advocacy plans for local, state and federal policy campaigns, to demonstrate broad based public support for cancer-related policy initiatives. assist in occasional ballot and electoral campaign planning. draft and implement such plans directly, in assigned multi state geography of arkansas, florida, louisiana, texas, oklahoma and puerto rico. (30%) develop messaging that is tailored to the specific political environment and attuned to the rapid pace of legislative activities. write and coach others to enhance their writing of press releases, media advisories, letters to the editor, op-eds, talking points, faqs, fact sheets, speeches, presentations and other media material as needed, ensuring appropriate review for subject matter accuracy and brand standards. plan and manage media events, including press conferences and editorial board meetings. (30%) develop and maintain relationships with press corps in assigned multi state geography, and proactively engage these reporters on legislative issues as well as responding to media inquiries. track and report media results and trends. (20%) coordinate activities with acs marketing & communications staff, as well as with acs can media advocacy colleagues as needed. manage media activities to support acs can fundraising. (5%) conduct media trainings as needed for volunteers and staff. identify and/or vet and train staff and volunteer spokespeople with personal stories related to acs can’s policy campaigns. (5%) represent acs can in coalitions for priority campaigns to ensure coordination and brand recognition with joint media activities (5%) elevate the profile of acs can, by working through the media to ensure that opinion leaders are aware of acs can legislative activity and voter education activity. (5%) experience/qualifications:minimum degree required: bachelor's degree preferred degree: bachelor's degree certificate(s) or license(s): n/a years of experience: 2-3 years knowledge, skills, and ability:spanish language proficiency requiredat least 2-3 years of experience in journalism or public relations and/or legislative communications. familiarity with the legislative and/or political process a must; familiarity with reporters and/or media outlets in the covered markets preferred. political campaign or legislative experience preferred. knowledge of health care policy preferred. excellent written, oral, interpersonal and computer skills required. ability to work independently with minimum direction as well as work as a member or leader of a team. demonstrated ability to work on fast-paced, time-sensitive matters with internal and external constituents. ability to complete work in a timely and efficient manner and ensure work is accurate. ability to utilize available technology to perform position responsibilities. self-starter and proactive with creating ideas and messaging adept at working independently in a remote setting. travel requirements:some overnight travel for meetings required. physical requirements:limited lifting for media event setup may be required the starting rate is $73,000 to $83,000 annual. the final candidate's relevant experience/skills will be considered before an offer is extended. actual starting pay will vary based on non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.acs can provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. we are a proud equal opportunity employer.

detail.desc: about hungrypanda 关于熊猫外卖founded in 2017 and headquartered in london, hungrypanda connects overseas communities with authentic chinese and asian food through its delivery platform. we work with merchants and delivery partners to make familiar flavors more accessible and support local businesses.熊猫外卖成立于2017年，总部位于伦敦，致力于通过外卖平台连接海外社区与地道的中餐及亚洲美食。我们与商家和配送伙伴合作，让熟悉的味道触手可及，并支持本地商家的发展。our value 我们的价值理念satisfy your chinese taste. we bring people closer to the food they love and the communities they call home.满足你的中国胃。以美食连接用户与社区，传递熟悉的味道与归属感。our mission 我们的使命connect merchants and consumers through technology and delivery services, creating opportunities across the overseas chinese food ecosystem.通过科技与配送服务连接商家和消费者，为海外中餐生态创造更多发展机会。our people 我们的团队we are food lovers who value initiative, collaboration and practical results. we welcome people who take ownership, communicate openly and turn ideas into action.我们热爱美食，重视主动担当、团队协作和实际成果，欢迎愿意开放沟通、承担责任并推动想法落地的伙伴。about the role 岗位介绍we are looking for an experienced, hands-on public relations manager to strengthen u.s. government and stakeholder relationships and protect hungrypanda’s reputation across media, social platforms and online communities. you will independently lead sensitive issue responses, advise leadership and personally execute communications across english- and chinese-language channels. this role combines government relations, crisis communications, media relations and proactive reputation building, with clear ownership from early risk assessment through resolution.我们正在寻找一位经验成熟、执行力强的公关经理，负责维护美国政府及重要利益相关方关系，并在新闻媒体、社交平台及网络社区中维护熊猫外卖的企业声誉。你将独立主导敏感事件应对，为管理层提供判断建议，并亲自执行中英文对外沟通。岗位涵盖政府关系、危机公关、媒体关系和主动声誉建设，要求从风险发现到事件闭环全程负责。main duties and responsibilities 主要工作职责government relations and public affairs: build and maintain credible relationships with relevant u.s. government offices, regulators, industry associations, chambers of commerce and community organizations. track policy and public affairs issues affecting delivery platforms and prepare briefings, meetings and responses with leadership and legal.政府关系与公共事务：建立并维护与美国相关政府部门、监管机构、行业协会、商会及社区组织的可信关系；跟踪影响外卖平台的政策与公共事务议题，与管理层及法务协同准备沟通材料、组织会面并回应问询。crisis communications and issues management: independently lead responses to negative coverage, allegations, viral complaints, service or safety incidents and other reputational risks. verify facts, assess severity, recommend response timing and channels, prepare action plans and personally drive execution, escalation and follow-up.危机公关与敏感议题管理：独立主导负面报道、争议指控、投诉扩散、服务或安全事件及其他声誉风险的应对；核实事实、判断风险等级、确定回应时机与渠道、制定行动方案，并亲自推动执行、升级汇报和后续跟进。cross-platform social listening and online reputation: own monitoring and response coordination across major english- and chinese-language channels, including instagram, tiktok, facebook, x, youtube, linkedin, reddit, xiaohongshu / red, wechat, weibo and douyin, as relevant to u.s. audiences. include community forums, google and yelp reviews, app store ratings and digital news. map cross-platform spread, identify influential voices and prioritize risks by credibility, reach and business impact.全平台舆情监测与网络声誉：负责主要中英文渠道的监测与回应协调，包括instagram、tiktok、facebook、x、youtube、linkedin、reddit、小红书、微信、微博及抖音，并根据美国市场受众确定优先级；同时覆盖社区论坛、google与yelp评论、应用商店评价和网络新闻。分析跨平台传播路径、识别关键影响者，并依据内容可信度、传播范围及业务影响判断风险。hands-on response and bilingual writing: personally draft statements, press materials, media q&as, executive talking points, social responses and stakeholder updates in english and chinese. adapt messaging to each platform while maintaining factual consistency; address legitimate concerns, correct misinformation with evidence and coordinate reports of policy-violating content. align public comments, direct outreach and official communications with customer service and legal.亲自执行与双语写作：独立撰写中英文声明、新闻材料、媒体问答、管理层发言要点、社媒回应及外部沟通更新。根据不同平台调整表达，确保事实与核心口径一致；回应合理诉求，以证据澄清不实信息，并协调对违规内容的申诉。与客服及法务统一公开评论、直接沟通和官方回应。media relations and proactive reputation building: develop relationships with u.s. mainstream, local, industry and chinese-language media, journalists, creators and community stakeholders. handle sensitive inquiries and prepare spokespeople. identify credible stories about merchants, delivery partners and community impact, and execute communications that strengthen trust before and after a crisis.媒体关系与主动声誉建设：维护美国主流媒体、本地媒体、行业媒体、中文媒体、记者、内容创作者及社区伙伴关系；处理敏感问询并准备发言人材料。挖掘商家、配送伙伴及社区价值等有事实依据的故事，执行日常与危机后的传播，持续建立外部信任。cross-functional incident coordination: lead communications workstreams with legal, operations, customer service, marketing and leadership to investigate issues, align messages and support corrective action. coordinate external agencies and advisers when needed, track owners and deadlines, and ensure follow-through until the issue is resolved.跨部门事件协调：牵头与法务、运营、客服、市场及管理层的公关协作，调查问题、统一口径并推动改进措施；按需协调外部机构与顾问，明确责任人和时间节点，持续跟进直至事件解决。preparedness, analysis and measurement: establish monitoring alerts, escalation procedures, crisis playbooks and platform-specific response guidelines. use social listening and media data to assess sentiment, spread, message accuracy and response effectiveness. brief leadership on emerging risks and document lessons and corrective actions after incidents.危机准备、分析与效果评估：建立监测预警、升级机制、危机预案及各平台回应指引；通过舆情与媒体数据评估情绪变化、传播情况、信息准确性及回应效果；向管理层汇报新出现的风险，并在事件后复盘经验与改进措施。qualifications and requirements 任职要求5+ years of relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, public affairs or crisis communications, including substantial hands-on ownership of sensitive issues. strong individual contributors and agency professionals with end-to-end client responsibility are welcome.5年以上公关、企业传播、公共事务或危机沟通相关经验，并具有独立处理敏感事件的实战经历；欢迎资深执行型人才，以及曾全流程负责客户项目的公关机构候选人。demonstrated ability to independently manage a significant reputational incident. be ready to discuss your decisions, personal contribution and outcomes using non-confidential examples.能够证明自己独立主导过重要声誉事件；面试时可通过不涉及保密信息的案例，说明判断过程、本人承担的工作及处理结果。practical u.s. government relations experience and established, relevant stakeholder relationships. understand how to engage government offices and regulators professionally and work effectively with legal.具备美国政府关系实操经验及与业务相关的外部关系基础，熟悉政府部门和监管机构的沟通方式，能够与法务有效配合。professional fluency in both english and mandarin is required, including excellent english writing and the ability to draft and review simplified chinese crisis communications.英语及普通话必须达到专业工作水平；英文写作能力优秀，能够独立撰写和审核简体中文危机沟通内容。demonstrated experience managing reputational issues across multiple social platforms and digital communities. status: full-time in-office, exempt/salary compensation: base salary of $100,000 - $110,000 doe are you the right fit? would it excite you to have a pivotal role in communicating to our community what is necessary to overcome our housing shortage and make home more attainable to everyone? if yes, please keep reading. about useveryone deserves a place to call home. not just an address or somewhere to take shelter, but a little slice of the universe that’s all your own. a place where you can plant roots and grow. where you have a voice. where you make memories. where you always belong. a house is a structure with four walls and a roof—but a home is wherever you can be you. that place might look a little different to everyone, but the feeling of safety and comfort it provides is universal. and to us, that’s a feeling no one should live without.since 1909, the master builders association of king and snohomish counties has been making home happen. we live in one of the best places in the world, and as representatives of our region’s housing industry, it’s our duty to keep it that way—by making housing available and attainable to everyone. that’s why we support those who provide the puget sound region with places people can call home.we’ve been the voice for builders for more than 100 years, helping to shape our community for the greater good. we devote years to creating legislation that promotes a free market where housing supply can keep up with regional demands. we collaborate with our communities to develop land in ways that serve everyone, balancing environmental preservation with housing provision. and we’re continuously building a home of our own, where our members can connect, learn from each other, and succeed. together, we’re determined to provide our region with attainable housing—today, tomorrow, and for the next 100 years.there’s a reason people say home is where the heart is—because home is where everything begins. it’s integral to human success, to creating connected communities, and to building a better tomorrow. that’s why, as the master builders association of king and snohomish counties, we don’t just make housing happen—we make home happen.what it takes to succeedhere are the skills and traits you’ll need to be successful in our organization.a team player -- you define personal success by the success of the association and your teammates in addition to the excellence of your own work.courageous – you are always willing to try something new, whether that is a new responsibility or a new way of approaching an existing one.self-motivated but also collaborative – you take full ownership of your work statement but also enjoy working with a team.highly adaptive and resilient – when necessary, you are happy to iterate, react to changes in requirements, and learn for next time.organized and detail-oriented – you have a knack for record-keeping and multi-tasking and have strong proofreading and copyediting skills. an excellent communicator – you write and speak effectively at varying levels of technical detail depending on what is most effective with any given audience.skilled & experienced but also humble – you are confident in what you bring to the team while recognizing that your opinion isn’t the only one that matters.position overviewthe communications manager has an overarching primary objective: to ensure members, policymakers, and the broader community understand mbaks’ advocacy priorities and how to make home more attainable for all.to accomplish that objective, the communications manager has three primary responsibilities:1. develop and execute strategic, member-focused communications that advance the priorities of the homebuilding industry and demonstrate the value of mbaks advocacy.2. contribute to a culture of excellence within the team to advance the priorities and objectives of the association.3. develop and / or maintain processes, tools and behaviors that support the needs of variety of audiences, including homebuilders and remodelers, industry professionals and suppliers, elected officials, and the general public across websites, targeted emails, a weekly e-newsletter, presentations, and digital and physical collateral for advocacy events. the communications manager needs to understand the unique voice and branding elements for each of those audiences and be adept at both overseeing and executing the full production process for all forms of communication. success in this role requires strong writing and storytelling skills, public policy fluency, visual communication skills, and the ability to connect mbaks advocacy work to practical impacts on members and housing.required education, experience, knowledge, and skillseducation: bachelor’s degree in materials.ability to travel locally for meetings or events, as needed (if applicable).use of office equipment, including computers, printers, telephones, and other office machinery, requiring manual dexterity and coordination.mental requirements:strong cognitive skills for problem-solving, critical thinking, and troubleshooting.ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, adjusting priorities based on shifting deadlines and organizational needs.high attention to detail, ensuring the accuracy and quality of work in a fast-paced environment.strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and work efficiently under pressure.ability to remain focused on tasks for extended periods, with minimal distractions in an office environment.adaptability to changing work environments, technologies, and organizational processes.ability to work both independently and collaboratively, demonstrating a team-oriented mindset.employee benefitspurpose-driven work where we believe everybody deserves a place to call home.medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage- 2 medical plan choices, and an hsa plan.annual paid holidays- 11 total.vacation executive communications will bring both creative storytelling and strategic discipline to one of marketing’s broadest and most technically complex portfolios. working across azure’s rapidly evolving opportunities, and align communications around the highest-priority moments. this is a fast-paced, dynamic environment in which priorities can shift quickly. the right candidate will thrive in ambiguity, exercise sound judgment with sensitive information, and operate at the speed of the business while strengthening the executive’s impact and authentic voice.microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. as employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.in alignment with our microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.responsibilitiesexecutive counsel, voice, and strategy own the integrated executive communications strategy for the corporate vice president of azure marketing. serve as a trusted advisor, providing candid recommendations on narrative, audience, timing, channel strategy, opportunities, and risk. establish a highly collaborative working rhythm with the executive, bringing developed drafts and points of view and ensuring the executive is fully prepared for important engagements. develop and maintain an authentic, differentiated executive voice grounded in business priorities, customer needs, and the evolving cloud and ai market. prepare the executive for complex, sensitive, and high-stakes moments and provide calm, practical counsel when priorities change quickly. narrative and content build and evolve a distinctive azure marketing narrative that connects a broad portfolio into a coherent customer and market story. create durable messaging frameworks that can scale across audiences, channels, product innovation, and major business moments. translate complex technical, product, customer, and business material into clear, credible, and human stories without losing substance or precision. develop speeches, keynotes, presentations, talking points, briefings, executive emails, videos, articles, social content, and other audience-facing materials. lead communications for major internal and external moments, including customer and partner events, employee engagements, media opportunities, and industry events. identify thought leadership opportunities that strengthen the executive’s credibility and advance business priorities. executive events insight, application, and expertise.culture at scribd, inc.we support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.we believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. scribd flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. occasional in-person attendance is required for all scribd, inc. employees, regardless of location.so what are we looking for in new team members? at scribd, inc., we hire for “grit.” traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, grit reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. for us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving goals, delivering results within your role, contributing innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader team through collaboration and attitude.this posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.about the team and rolewelcome to our small but mighty tpm (technical program management) team! we are the driving force that shapes how our company plans, prioritizes, and executes. as a senior tpm, you will own program strategy and execution across our marketing organization, which owns two key pillars of work: customer operations and brand marketing.customer operations is the pillar that reflects the voice of the customer back to the company, and the one that works to deliver an effortless customer support experience. you will partner with its leadership to drive the programs that connect that work to the rest of the company, from the voice of the customer program, to how that support experience is designed and delivered end to end, to the evolution of the operational model and team structure for premium support.brand marketing is the pillar that helps the company build and sustain brands people love and want to tell their friends about. you will act as the connector between brand strategy and product strategy and execution, working across stakeholders to design the processes, workflows, and tools that make sure the personality and identity of our brands are felt in the product itself and in our messaging and communications, which include larger brand campaigns as well as always-on communications.you will drive the roadmap across both, connect them to the teams and leaders that depend on them, and bring a builder's instinct to the work, using ai and creative workflows to design better ways of running these programs.about youyou are a thoughtful opinionator: you hold strong, well-reasoned views and are capable of voicing them respectfully to anyone, at any level. you are a proactive communicator who identifies possible problems before they surface.you are a relationship builder and organizational navigator at heart, adept at building bridges across teams and functions. you are comfortable working with customer experience, marketing, and creative teams as well as product and engineering, able to follow the substance and hold your own with the subject matter experts you partner with.you care about customers and about the power of building strong brands. you understand what a great customer experience is worth to a company, and you are intellectually curious about how brand personality and identity show up in consumer-facing products. you have been part of efforts that connected brand strategy to how a product is built and experienced.you are already working with ai, and you have a point of view on where the tpm craft is headed in an increasingly agentic world. you have changed how you operate because of it.you are a continuous learner with a growth mindset and an appetite for unfamiliar problems. lastly, you are a voracious reader with a passion for books and the written and spoken word in all its forms!what you will doact like an owner: be an owner of program strategy and execution across our customer operations and brand marketing pillars, and serve as the connective tissue between those pillars and the partners they depend on.build relationships: our tpm team thrives on collaboration. you will work closely with stakeholders at every level, from customer experience and marketing teams to engineers and executives, and your ability to build trust and align diverse perspectives will be central to what you can accomplish.drive strategy: you will dive deep into the how and the why of your programs, developing plans that connect day-to-day execution to where these pillars need to go. your judgment will shape how decisions get made.decide what's worth doing: partner with customer operations leadership to prioritize projects by customer impact, weigh them against team capacity, and defer or decline the rest. the customer's experience stays at the center of every tradeoff.connect marketing and product: act as a connector between our marketing organization and our product-centric teams, working across stakeholders to design the processes, workflows, and tools that make sure brand is part of our key releases, in the product experience itself and in the messaging and communications around it.be a leader: act as a leader within the tpm team. identify opportunities to collaborate, share what works, and coach your teammates.lead beyond your pillars: our tpm team also owns cross-company processes like yearly planning. you will contribute to these shared efforts and take a leadership role in shaping them.own the complexity: drive multiple complex cross-functional programs simultaneously, and create scalable frameworks across pillars and functions to track work and communicate progress.enable your drivers: many of the people driving and contributing to customer operations initiatives are also handling day to day frontline work and escalations. you will plan around their real capacity and give them structure and support, rather than assigning tasks and chasing updates.manage timelines: lead the delivery timeline for your programs. proactively identify risks and create mitigation strategies through workflows, communication, or resource allocation.measure success: proactively propose success metrics for yourself and your programs, and identify when those metrics are at risk.build to move faster: use ai and lightweight tooling to reduce the coordination tax on your teams. when you spot a manual, repetitive process, build something better.improve how we work: identify and drive process improvements at the team and cross-team level, so the whole organization delivers at a larger scale.we're looking for5+ years of experience in a program management, operations, or equivalent role at a technology company.a track record of operating independently, leading through ambiguity, and navigating complex organizational dynamics.a structured approach to your work, paired with the judgment to know when to add process and when to remove it to reduce overhead and drive velocity.experience partnering closely with customer operations, marketing, or brand teams, and connecting their work to product and engineering teams.an understanding of what great customer support is worth to a brand, and enough knowledge of brand to hold your own with marketers. you have worked with customer support teams, or know their workflows well enough to be a useful partner to them.a customer-first lens in how you make decisions, with the judgment to weigh customer impact against efficiency.experience rolling out operational changes, such as process and tooling to a frontline team.strong familiarity with the software development process, working with product and engineering teams from roadmapping through delivery.experience working directly with product managers, engineers, marketers, and other subject matter experts.hands-on experience using ai in your work, and a clear point of view on how it changes the program management craft. you have already adjusted how you operate because of it.experience using data to identify problems and communicate solutions.the ability to work and partner successfully across multiple functions in an organization.excellent communication and interpersonal skills.exceptional attention to detail and the ability to understand and articulate the big picture.distinctive problem-solving and analytical skills.bonus pointsyou have held a program management role at a company where customer support sits at the heart of the brand.you have seen up close how great customer support works, even if you have not worked in it directly.you have run or helped run brand campaigns.you have worked in a brand or marketing role earlier in your career.you have costing, pricing, p&l, inventory, and profitability and partner with marketing to plan ek campaign spend within marketing budget. . serve as point of contact for licensing and brand partnership opportunities, incl. project approvals partner and travel with sales and marketing for activations and retailer-specific programs and events. what you'll bring5+ years in brand management experience in refreshing and evolving brands;
