detail.desc: descriptionabout springssprings window fashions has been a leader in the window treatments industry since 1939. headquartered in middleton, wi, we operate across 14 locations in north america with a team of over 8,000 associates. our diverse portfolio of brands—including bali, graber, sunsetter, and mecho—can be found in major retailers, designer showrooms, and commercial spaces worldwide. as a privately owned company, we are committed to delivering the best experience—for our consumers, channel partners, and associates—through innovation, quality, and exceptional service.our departmentthe brand strategy & consumer marketing team at springs window fashions is responsible for building strong brands that drive growth, create customer value, and inspire consumers. we define how our brands and product portfolio compete in the market and bring those strategies to life through consumer-facing marketing, including websites, social media, public relations, content, and campaigns.the team leads brand and portfolio strategy, including positioning, target consumer frameworks, portfolio architecture, and alignment between brand and product strategy. we ensure every brand has a clear role, differentiated value proposition, and reason to win.we also lead go-to-market planning for new product launches, partnering closely with product management, channel marketing, sales, and creative services to ensure coordinated and effective execution.fast-paced and highly collaborative, the team connects insights, strategy, and execution to strengthen our brands, enhance the customer experience, and drive growth across our residential business.role overviewsprings window fashions is seeking a brand manager ii to lead the end-to-end brand strategy and consumer marketing execution for our residential brands, with a primary focus on our retail brands and their presence at the home depot and lowe’s. this is a high-impact, highly visible role responsible for shaping how shoppers experience our brands, from product discovery to purchase and beyond.this role will be the brand steward and strategic lead, ensuring our brands are clear, compelling, and consistent across all touchpoints – digital, in-store, and in partnership with our retail customers and channel marketing teams. we are looking for someone who is part strategist, part project manager, and part creative thinker – someone who can zoom out to set direction and zoom in to deliver results. the ideal candidate will bring a strong sense of ownership and a results-driven mindset, with the opportunity to grow this role as the impact of retail marketing continues to expand.key responsibilitiesbrand strategy & positioningown the brand strategy and hierarchy for retail brands, including purpose, positioning, messaging, and visual identitylead simplification and clarity of brand architecture across skus and channelscollaborate with creative, social, consumer insights, digital, public relations, and channel marketing to deliver cohesive brand storytellingensure alignment and consistency across retail.com, in-store signage, and seasonal campaignsensure adherence to brand guidelines for owned performance marketing campaignsannual marketing & campaign planninglead the annual marketing planning process for assigned brandscoordinate cross-functionally with product, sales, finance, and creative to build integrated plans that align to business goalscollaborate with creative to produce photography, video, and digital assetsown product launch planning and execution across all channels from briefing through activationrequirementseducation & experience5+ years of experience in brand management, marketing strategy, or retail marketing—experience with home goods or cpg a plusstrong understanding of retail environmentsexperience working directly with the home depot and/or lowe’s preferredknowledge, skills, and abilitiesproven ability to develop integrated go-to-market plansanalytical mindset and comfort with marketing dataexcellent communication and storytelling skills with experience developing brand narratives, briefs, and campaignsdigital-first mindset with knowledge of content strategy, social media, and retail.com best practicesstrong project management and budget oversight capabilitiespassion for building brands and delivering measurable business resultshow we work to deliver a best experience: our cultureour core value: we do the right thing, alwaysour seven cultural behaviorsempowerment - we trust our people.ownership - we take 100% responsibility for our roles actions, and results.leadership - we all lead by example and talk direct with respect (dwr).one team - we are one springs team.customer first - we consider our customers’ needs before every decision.continuous innovation - we are constantly learning, innovating, and improving.speed - we define priorities and operate with a sense of urgency and agility.salary and other compensationfactors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.benefits: the company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with up to 5% company match of eligible contributions, life insurance, long-term disability insurance, short-term disability insurance, paid vacation time, paid holidays, and one paid volunteer day off per year.this posting is anticipated to remain open until a qualified candidate is hired.

detail.desc: our storylaunched in 2015, sol de janeiro is a globally recognized, award-winning beauty brand, drawing inspiration from brazil’s beauty rituals, warmth, and spirit. sol de janeiro delivers a sensory experience beloved by multi-generational consumers worldwide, with clinically proven results, transformative textures, and transportive fragrances.  headquartered in new york and launched as a digitally native brand, we have expanded globally with teams in paris, london, and germany. our commitment to excellence has earned high-profile honors, including being named one of time100’s 2024 most influential companies, fast company’s 2024 world's most innovative companies, and wwd beauty inc’s power brands of 2024, underscoring its leadership in the beauty industry and outstanding workplace. these accolades highlight our dedication to being a leading brand in the beauty industry and an exceptional workplace.  what you’ll dothe manager will serve as a key category marketing expert for the americas fragrance business, with deep knowledge across the brand, category, consumer, and competitive landscape. this role is responsible for both shaping and executing regional strategies that build brand desirability, recruit consumers, and accelerate growth across the americas.   this role will report to the americas executive director, brand marketing, fragrance. what you’ll be working onserve as a day-to-day lead for the core fragrance business, maintaining a holistic understanding of brand, consumer and commercial performance. monitor launch performance and portfolio productivity, identifying opportunities to optimize existing franchises, accelerate high-potential innovations and address performance gaps. conduct in-depth market research to identify trends, consumer insights, and competitive insights, translating findings into actionable fuel for shaping brand propositions, messaging, and campaign toolkits. leverage multiple sources, including circana, nielsen niq, and more.   lead regional promotions & pricing strategy; conduct price & product deep dives to inform recommendations; lead coordination with cross-functional teams on price increase execution and calendarizing promotional offers, balancing promotional depth and breadth with brand strategy and p&l targets.  champion the voice of the americas consumer across regional and global teams, ensuring consumer insights inform product, communication and activation decisions. serve as a key day-to-day partner to gpm and gce, elevating category and commercial perspectives throughout product and campaign development. lead development of integrated americas gtm strategy for fragrance launches and brand moments, translating global initiatives into locally relevant, consumer-centric plans. develop clear campaign and launch plans that align media, social, influencer/pr, experiential, retail marketing, e-commerce and other partners around business objectives. drive excellence in execution, ensuring programs deliver against brand standards, strategic objectives, timelines and investment guidance. manage brand marketing budgets, timelines and agency partners, ensuring programs are delivered efficiently, on budget and consistent with brand standards. ensure marketing allocations are aligned with global guidance.  contribute to key elements of the annual planning process, including category growth strategies, innovation plans, and npl assessments.   partner with executive director, sales, and global/commercial leadership in preparation for key retailer meetings (market, in the kitchen), business review, strategy & planning presentations. must havesbachelor’s degree in marketing preferred 3-5 years experience in marketing, beauty industry experience preferred  strong organizational and problem-solving skills  strong attention to detail, ability to prioritize and work effectively in fast-paced environment   excellent communication skills with ability to work effectively across departments and levels    salary range: $80,000 usd - $90,000 usd why sol de janeiro?competitive salary and bonus program for full-time team membersflexible hybrid work environment with opportunities for collaboration and growthinclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and celebrates individualitythe chance to be part of a fast-growing, award-winning global beauty brand the information contained herein is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee, as these may change or new ones may be assigned at any time. sol de janeiro is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. we are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. requests for accommodation due to a disability or any other protected characteristic can be made at any stage of the recruitment process and during employment by contacting our people experience team at careers@soldejaneiro.com. https://soldejaneiro.com/pages/privacy-policy-sol-de-janeiro

company description anthem community council (acc) is the central governing organization for the anthem, az community, providing leadership and coordination across hoas and shared community assets. acc’s mission is to preserve, protect, and enhance the plans, policies, infrastructure, and resources that support a strong sense of community. the organization focuses on ensuring sound community and promoting a high quality of life for all anthem residents. acc collaborates with local partners, community groups, and residents to create an inclusive, safe, and vibrant environment. team members join a mission-driven organization dedicated to long-term community well-being and responsible growth.duties and responsibilities the director of communications is a highly responsible executive position that promotes anthem’s overall image, brand, communications goals, initiatives, customer service, special events, programs, and services, and ensures that all areas of communications and public affairs are strategically aligned with organizational priorities, programs, and action plans. the director of communications reports to the executive director and has regular interaction with the acc board, committees, department heads, hoa managers, government and community partners, the news media, and anthem residents. of critical importance is the director of communications’ capacity to bring a positive, collaborative, and solution-oriented leadership style to the communications department and organization, and to protect the credibility and public trust the acc depends on. essential functions serves on the executive leadership team and works closely with the executive director to define and accomplish strategic communications goals and objectives; drafts and presents board reports, memos, and presentations to the board of directors, committees, and the community. supervises the communications, customer service, and special events staff. hires, coaches, and develops staff; manages performance and builds a creative, responsive team that delivers consistent, high-quality communications and events. directs resident and internal communications, including digital and print communications, social media, marketing and promotion, graphic design and print services, and community and vendor relations; provides communications and marketing support to other acc departments. ensures that all forms of communications are coordinated, timely, accurate, and “on message” in order to ensure credibility, public trust, and the best interests of the acc and anthem; reviews and approves digital and print materials, website content, and signage for all acc departments. serves as the primary acc spokesperson and point of contact with news media, government officials and agencies, community and civic leaders, and other stakeholders, and as liaison with anthem’s hoa managers on communications to their residents, in coordination with the executive director. leads crisis and emergency communications, in coordination with the executive director. oversees customer service operations at the civic building, including front desk and business support services, and ensures a high level of service to residents, tenants, and visitors. oversees special events production and marketing, including large-scale acc events and third-party events held in anthem. oversees the anthem veterans memorial, including paver brick sales, donations, grant acquisition, marketing, and acc or awf ceremonies and other activities at the memorial. oversees the activities, marketing, and fundraising of the anthem way foundation (awf), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, including the annual jim martin stem college scholarship and anthem veterans service award. prepares, manages, and evaluates department and program budgets and resources; consults with other directors regarding common budget items; and collaborates with the executive leadership team. researches, creates, and enforces process improvements and policies including, but not limited to, media relations, website standards, crisis communications, social media, video/photography, department procedures, special events requirements, and customer service operations. performs other duties and special projects as assigned by the executive director.  qualifications education: bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. experience: minimum of ten (10) years of progressively responsible and diverse experience in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, customer service operations, event management, or a related field, including leading and supervising multiple functions and employees. knowledge, skills, and abilities: exceptional writing and editing skills, with proven experience in press releases, proofreading, script writing, digital marketing content, and other public-facing communications; strong time management skills and awareness of details; the ability to create presentations and summary documents and present them comfortably to the board of directors and the community; an understanding of customer service expectations and the basic operations of a master-planned community; event planning, including production, marketing and promotions, and vendor and sponsor sales; grant writing for a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization; and knowledge of military and veteran protocol as it pertains to the anthem veterans memorial. computer skills: proficiency in the microsoft 365 suite, adobe creative suite, and website design software; knowledge of email distribution and crm software, photography, and videography a plus. must possess a valid az driver’s license. must have a high level of initiative to manage multiple priorities, facilitate positive outcomes, and engender the trust and confidence of employees, the board, and the community. must be a strategic thinker who can assess complex issues and chart a course forward while consistently exercising good judgment. self-awareness, the willingness to take ownership when things do not go as planned, and the courage to face difficult issues and decisions are essential. must always be a consummate professional and positive representative of the organization and community. a genuine desire to help staff grow professionally and feel empowered and appreciated is essential. above all, the director must always lead by example and model the anthem way values, with a leadership style that is open, encouraging and collaborative. essential physical requirements must be able to operate a computer, printer, phone, and other routine office equipment. ability to see well enough to read faint or partially obscured writing or printing.  must be able to speak, read and write english so that various types of communication may be conducted with people of various levels of education and capabilities both in-person and over the phone. must be able to sit for extended periods, and to stand, walk, reach, bend, and stoop as needed for office work, meetings, and community events. position requires the ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds. must be able to transport oneself around the office, community, facilities, and grounds as needed. work environment  must be able to work efficiently on more than one assignment at a time with frequent interruptions, changes, and delays. must remain alert to working conditions and safety, health, and environmental concerns. must be able to work effectively with a positive attitude and demeanor in an environment which may be stressful due to the nature of the position.  the position will primarily be working indoors in a controlled climate but may include working in an outdoor setting throughout the year. hours/work location  official hours are monday through friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. must also be available to be flexible and work additional hours to ensure proper execution of job responsibilities including attending board of directors meetings, committee meetings, external meetings, special events, and non-traditional hours handling priority or emergency communications. special events require regular evening, weekend, and holiday work.

company description fairvote is a nonpartisan organization, founded in 1992, that leads efforts to improve elections at the local, state, and national levels through research, communications, and collaboration. the organization is a driving force behind ranked choice voting and fair representation in multi-winner legislative districts, aiming to create more competitive races and more civil campaigns. fairvote works to give voters greater choice and a stronger voice, advancing reforms that make democracy more representative and responsive. team members contribute to meaningful, systemic change that affects how elections are conducted across the united states.role description the deputy director of communications is a full-time, hybrid role based in silver spring, md, with flexibility for some work from home. this role oversees and executes fairvote’s communications strategy, ensuring consistent and compelling messaging across press outreach, digital platforms, and internal materials. day-to-day responsibilities include drafting and editing press releases, op-eds, and public statements; communications team, working in close partnership with another communications officer, the director of communications, and a communications intern.nyhealth background:nyhealth is a private and independent foundation dedicated to improving the health of all new yorkers, especially people of color and others who have been historically marginalized. nyhealth began operations in 2006, and today the organization has more than $400 million in assets and a $17 million annual grants and operating budget.nyhealth is committed to making a meaningful difference that extends beyond grantmaking by informing health care policy and practice, promoting the adoption of effective programs to improve the health care system, convening health leaders across new york state, and providing technical assistance to grantees and partners. today, the foundation concentrates its initiatives in four areas: primary care; healthy food, healthy lives; veterans’ health, and responsive grantmaking through a special projects fund.position overview:the communications officer manages the day-to-day development, production, and execution of communications projects and activities to advance nyhealth’s goals and objectives. core responsibilities include project management, editorial production, and coordination across teams to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality communications materials. working closely with staff across the foundation, the communications officer helps capture, share, and promote information, stories, and lessons learned from nyhealth’s grantmaking and areas of expertise.the communications officer serves as a strategic thought partner to the foundation’s program and policy & research teams; manages the editing and production of foundation materials, including board books for quarterly directors’ meetings, grant outcome reports, research reports and briefs, and other publications; coordinates online and in-person/hybrid events; and supports website content, social media, and online marketing. the officer also leads media relations, serving as the foundation’s primary media contact and strategist, developing relationships with journalists, promoting the foundation’s and grantees’ work, and overseeing media coverage tracking and distribution to staff and board.reports to: director of communicationsresponsibilities:contribute to the development and execution of the foundation’s communications plans, strategies, and tactics. bring curiosity, proactive energy, and strategic thinking to generate and implement ideas for communications opportunities in collaboration with colleagues across the organization.draft, edit, and manage the production of written materials for external and internal audiences, including the media, policymakers, health care providers, community organizations, nyhealth grantees, senior staff, and board members. take hands-on responsibility for developing and refining content, coordinating input and revisions, and ensuring materials are accurate, polished, and completed on schedule. independently manage publications and other communications products from initial draft through editing, design, approval, and dissemination. lead day-to-day project management, including establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, tracking deliverables, journalists across new york state and proactively identifying and pitching stories. draft press materials, public statements, and op-eds; monitor and report on media coverage; and keep staff and board members informed about relevant news and media trends.expand the foundation’s media reach by cultivating relationships with traditional and digital-first outlets, independent journalists, podcasters, newsletter writers, and other mission-aligned content creators—amplifying reach, diversifying audiences, and elevating the foundation’s voice in new and innovative ways.serve as a thought partner to program and policy & research teams to develop communications plans and identify opportunities to elevate the foundation’s and grantees’ work among policymakers, health care and public health practitioners, community organizations, advocates, funders, and other key audiences.develop and share compelling stories illustrating the foundation’s and grantees’ impact and opportunities for policy change through news media, social media, webinars, the foundation’s website, and other channels.work with program and policy & research staff to plan, promote, and execute webinars and in-person/hybrid events highlighting the foundation’s program areas and policy priorities. help maintain the foundation’s social media presence, develop content, monitor engagement and audience the foundation’s goals and priorities.conduct research and develop talking points, speeches, presentations, blog posts, and other commentary for the ceo.perform other duties as assigned.required experience and qualifications:superior writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with strong editorial judgment and an understanding of communications strategies and tactics.demonstrated project management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage complex projects, coordinate multiple stakeholders, meet competing deadlines, and deliver high-quality work with careful attention to detail.demonstrated experience developing and executing successful media relations strategies; existing relationships with new york health journalists are a plus.experience with social media strategy and website content management systems. experience producing multimedia content, including videos and infographics, is a plus.strong analytical and critical thinking skills, creativity, flexibility, and sound judgment, with the ability to solve problems, make decisions, justify recommendations, and take initiative.excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with colleagues, grantees, partners, vendors, and consultants and work effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.strong commitment to the foundation’s mission and goals. commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace, detail.desc: about pebblepebble is a sustainable living startup defining a new way to live, work and explore from anywhere with a 100% electric, hassle-free rv trailer. built by a team of experts in both automotive and consumer technology, pebble combines electrification with cutting-edge automotive technology for a travel trailer experience that removes the hassles rv trailer owners have struggled with for decades.at pebble, we are building out the future of lighter, more flexible living. we see a world where your home can be anywhere you want to take it. pebble blends the best of what it means to be at home, on the road, and off-grid into something useful and magical. this is a collective effort. our team is dedicated to making not just products, but a lifestyle that is truly sustainable. if the idea of building out the future sparks your imagination and intersects with your skills, we’d love to meet youabout the roleyou will drive how the brand shows up across owned social channels and integrated campaign moments. you are a social media strategist and builder, someone who can develop a channel strategy from the ground up and grow an engaged community. you bring hands-on content creation skills, copy and design, contributing to social and campaign content in partnership with the broader team. you support the campaign arm of the team, which spans partnerships, product launches, experiential and event activations, and other brand initiatives, ensuring each of these efforts ties back to a cohesive social and content strategy. this role blends creative and analytical thinking, cultural fluency, and executional rigor across social and campaigns.key responsibilitiesdevelop and own the brand's social media strategy across all channels, including platform approach, content pillars, voice and tone, and community growth.build and manage an active, engaged brand community; turn existing customers into advocates and create genuine two-way relationships with followers.identify and activate organic content opportunities that build credibility and extend reach in ways paid media cannot.track engagement metrics and community sentiment; translate data into strategic recommendations that inform broader marketing decisions.write and develop social copy, campaign messaging, and supporting content concepts, partnering with design as needed to ensure a consistent brand voice and visual identity across channels.stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm shifts, and cultural moments to keep the brand relevant and responsive.support and help shape the brand's campaign strategy, spanning partnerships, product launches, experiential and event activations, and other brand initiatives, and drive execution across each.develop internal resources and processes to support consistent execution across campaign types and teams.identify and prioritize campaign opportunities, including partnerships, launches, and activations, based on audience fit, brand alignment, and return potential.define clear goals and success metrics for every campaign before investment is committed; track, report, and apply learnings continuously.collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure social and campaign activity aligns with broader company priorities.required qualifications5 to 7 years of experience across social media strategy and content creation, with exposure to campaign or brand marketing, and at least 2 years leading the function.demonstrated ability to build and execute social media strategy, not just manage existing channels; a track record of measurable community and engagement growth.strong content creation skills, including copywriting and a solid eye for design, with the ability to brief and direct designers as needed.deep fluency across major social platforms, with a strong point of view on how each should be used differently and an eye for what's emerging next.experience identifying and activating organic content creators and community voices to build brand credibility.experience managing the on-site execution of events or activations, from concept through day-of logistics.strong analytical skills; comfortable building measurement frameworks and presenting performance to senior stakeholders.experience managing agencies and vendors across multiple concurrent workstreams.background in a consumer, lifestyle, outdoor/adventure, or premium product category, preferredcompensationstock options, unlimited paid vacation policy, comprehensive healthcare + dental + vision$149,000—$189,000 usd

our mission at too good to go is to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. it’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!at too good to go, you’ll join a team that cares about developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis. you’ll join an elite team to elevate our growth and collaborate daily with world-class minds—while doing work that’s both high-impact and deeply meaningful.the roleas the marketing manager for north america, you will own the local strategy and execution of consumer-facing campaigns across the us and canada. sitting within the b2c marketing team, you will be the creative force that brings the too good to go brand to life, inspiring both prospective and existing customers to join the food waste movement.in this role, you will bridge the gap between imaginative storytelling and analytical rigor. you will own your workstreams end-to-end, moving fluidly from high-level campaign concepting to tactical execution. rather than settling for vanity metrics, you will look deep into the data to prioritize initiatives that drive true brand love, user acquisition, and measurable marketplace impact.core responsibilitiescampaign strategy & brand concepting (b2c)campaign ownership: own the strategy, ideation, and end-to-end execution of high-impact, consumer-facing marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness and user adoption across north america.brand collaborations: identify, pitch, and execute strategic partnerships and brand collaborations that amplify our mission and connect too good to go with culturally relevant audiences.creative oversight: partner closely with external creative agencies and internal design teams to oversee production, ensuring all marketing assets and copy are exceptionally creative, on-brand, and localized for the north american market.content, influencer & community growthinfluencer marketing: scale and manage our influencer marketing program from end-to-end, including sourcing creators, negotiating contracts, briefing content, and tracking roi.owned social & content creation: drive the overarching strategy for our owned social media channels, concepting highly engaging, viral-worthy content that highlights the value of saving food.community management: oversee regional community management strategies to foster deep brand loyalty, turn casual users into brand advocates, and keep our audience highly engaged.cross-functional collaboration & data impactmatrixed collaboration: serve as a key connective tissue across marketing verticals, collaborating daily with local and global teams—including crm marketing managers, partner marketing managers, social media managers, and pr managers.data-driven optimization: regularly dig into performance data to evaluate campaign health. move beyond likes and impressions to measure how your workstreams impact core business metrics like customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.requirementsthe experience: significant years of hands-on experience in brand marketing, campaign management, or consumer marketing. experience within a high-growth b2c app or mobile-first marketplace is highly preferred.creative brand acumen: a natural creative storyteller who instinctively understands how to bring a brand identity to life across digital and physical touchpoints. proven experience managing external creative agencies is a must.multi-channel expertise: deep familiarity with modern consumer marketing channels, including influencer networks, owned social platforms (tiktok, instagram), experiential activations, and community management.data fluency: you don't just report on vanity metrics; you are comfortable digging into the data to understand the true business impact of your campaigns and use insights to build your next strategy.strategic & tactical: you can dream up big, innovative campaign ideas but are equally excited to roll up your sleeves, build briefs, write copy, and execute the work.collaborative owner: you are a self-starter who thrives when given total ownership of a project, while remaining a supportive, highly aligned team player within a complex global structure.what it takes to succeedwe are looking for people who are energized by the opportunity and driven by the discipline it takes to achieve it. too good to go is building a high performing team where the right people thrive by holding themselves and each other to these standards. if you are looking for a place to grow, own your work, and make an impact—you’ll fit right in.to succeed here, you’ll need to embody these four principles:choose excellence over ease: you take initiative and prioritize long-term impact over short-term comfort, consistently pushing for exceptional quality rather than settling for "good enough."demonstrate integrity and responsibility: you do the right thing when no one is watching. you recognize your own agency to influence outcomes and take responsibility —meeting setbacks with solutions and humility rather than excuses.seek honesty: you ask questions and prioritize truth over comfort, welcoming candid feedback, and addressing performance directly to ensure we never stop improving.bring energy and joy to the journey: you take responsibility for the energy you bring to the team, finding meaning in the work while celebrating our shared wins and lessons.benefitsagility & autonomymodern hybrid model: maintain a high-performance rhythm with a balance of focused remote work and collaborative office days (3x a week) in our nyc hub.global mobility: the flexibility to work from abroad for up to 30 days per year.dedicated time to recharge: 20 days of paid vacation plus additional paid volunteer time through our shareback program.parental support: comprehensive paid parental leave with top-up support to ensure you can be present for life’s most significant milestones.holistic wellbeing & securitypremium health coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (epo), dental, and vision options for employees.comprehensive support: access to our employee assistance program (eap) for mental health care, legal and financial advisory, and family support.active lifestyle: stay energized with monthly classpass credits and our dedicated bike mobility program.financial future: plan for long-term security with a 401(k) program, including an employer-matched contribution.community & belongingglobal connectivity: engage with our international team through various employee resource groups (ergs), including p.r.i.d.e., women in the workplace, global majority voices, and functionally diverse groups.vibrant workspace: experience a welcoming office environment with curated snacks, premium coffee, and regular team celebrations that foster a true sense of community.how to applywe take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of too good to go.submit your cv and cover letter in english.please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. no cv or cover letter will be accepted by email or linkedin direct messaging.certain us states/jurisdictions require too good to go to include a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role. a reasonable estimate of the range for new joiners for this role in the united states is $85,000 - $95,000. actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, an individual's assigned work location, experience, and expertise.

manager, public relationsabout usblacksky is a real-time intelligence company. we own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. blacksky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. blacksky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.blacksky is seeking a manager of public relations to support media relations, corporate communications and executive visibility. as part of the integrated marketing & communications team, you will collaboratively create, develop, and execute high-visibility global story campaigns that support blacksky’s business objectives while contribute directly to shaping blacksky’s reputation in the news and earned media. the manager of public relations will support press initiatives around corporate announcements and speaking engagements and be responsible for the operational aspects of blacksky’s pr machine, including monitoring and tracking.this role is based in our herndon, va, office, and will be expected to spend two days in the office each week. we may also consider candidates in the seattle, wa area.responsibilitiescreatively develop, and collaboratively execute high-visibility global-reaching international security and economy story campaigns.write corporate announcements (press releases), award submissions, speaker abstracts, executive speeches, blog posts and more.collaborate with leadership and internal subject matter experts to train/prepare spokespersons and create supporting campaign assets, not limited to briefing documents, outward-facing briefing materials and news announcements, imagery, and other creative visual assets.manage operational aspects of media relations activities, i.e. curating and maintaining a database of key reporters, third-party national security analysts and experts, and managing channels of communication.measure and communicate insights around the qualitative and quantitative impact of media activities. use these insights to continually optimize blacksky’s earned media efforts.partner within the integrated marketing and communications team to develop earned+owned+paid plans in support of industry events and major milestones.other job-related duties as assigned.required qualificationsa bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, or a relevant field, or equivalent length of relevant professional pr experience.at least seven years of relevant experience in creating and managing global-reaching earned media campaigns that deliver measurable story results against pre-defined objectives.ability to work well and remain calm under pressure and can flow within the dynamics of multiple editorial deadlines.a quick and enthusiastic learner. inquisitive and resourceful, with exceptional negotiation, persuasion, and communication skills.exhibits a healthy balance of risk-taking and discernment, with on-the-fly complex problem solving and decision-making abilities.strong organizational skills as a good time manager and effective multi-tasker.a passion for the space industry and a natural grasp for technology and cultural megatrends shaping our world.previous experience landing tier-1 stories.preferred qualificationsmaster’s degree in communications, journalism, international relations, or related field.previous defense or aerospace technology exposure; international a plus.deeply familiar with (u.s.) media law, ap style, and journalistic principles for newsgathering and publication.life at blacksky for full-time benefits eligible employees includesmedical, dental, vision, disability, group term life and ad&d, voluntary life and ad&d insuranceblacksky pays 100% of employee-only premiums for medical, dental and vision and contributes $100/month for out-of-pocket expenses!15 days of pto, 11 company holidays, four floating holidays (pro-rated based on hire date), one day of paid volunteerism leave per year, parental leave and more401(k) pre-tax and roth deferral options with employer matchflexible spending accountsemployee assistance and travel assistance programsemployer matching donationsprofessional developmentmac or pc? your choice!awesome swagthe anticipated salary range for candidates in herndon, va or seattle, wa is $130,000 - $140,000 per year. the final compensation package offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on specific background and education. blacksky is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect salary ranges in other states or locations outside of herndon, va or seattle, wa.blacksky is committed to hiring and retaining a detail.desc: about logicgatelogicgate is the leading ai grc platform for the enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. built to provide a centralized view of risk and compliance, with ai intelligence woven into the platform's core, logicgate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. recognized as a leader in the grc market, logicgate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.the grc marketgovernance, risk, and compliance (grc) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. logicgate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale.senior pr managerabout the roleas a senior public relations manager you’ll serve as a hands-on storyteller who orchestrates our media relations and thought leadership strategy end-to-end. logicgate’s software helps enterprises turn risk into a business advantage, and you’ll uncover the stories inside this market shift and shape them into impactful narratives that earn tier-one coverage. this is an autonomous, highly visible builder seat where you will set the pr strategy, write pitches, and measure outcomes with direct access to leadership. if you are a tenacious pr professional who wants to own day-to-day execution, make critical calls without layers of approval, and build a function from the ground up, you will thrive in this environment.what you’ll domedia relations strategy: cultivates relationships with reporters, editors, podcasters, and newsletter writers at tier-one publications to secure earned placements across business, technology, and grc sectors. proactive storytelling: writes and distributes targeted weekly pitches—spanning customer stories, product news, original research, and executive commentary—to drive brand awareness and earn coverage. rapid response communications: responds to fast-moving industry news and issues with expert commentary from logicgate leaders to maximize news-jacking opportunities and protect corporate reputation. executive voice & social amplification: manages logicgate's corporate linkedin presence and coaches executives on their personal platforms to amplify earned media and build industry credibility. pr operations & measurement: owns the inbound press inbox, media calendar, and reporting metrics (such as share of voice and aeo citation rates) to clearly demonstrate pr's influence on the sales pipeline. cross-functional collaboration: partners with product marketing, sales, and demand generation teams to align pr campaigns with broader product launches, research, and revenue goals. what you bringrequired:execution & autonomy: 8 or more years in public relations at an agency or b2b technology company, with a proven track record of independently pitching and securing tier-one earned placements. technical translation & communication: exceptional written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating the ability to turn dense product capabilities, customer stories, or complex data into sharp, compelling pitches and releases. agility & news judgment: sound news judgment and the ability to operate calmly under pressure to handle reactive, sensitive communications and fast-moving industry trends. analytical & ai literacy: demonstrated ability to explain pr impact with data (coverage quality, share of voice) alongside curiosity and experience leveraging modern ai tools, llms, or automated workflows for operational efficiency and social listening. relationship building: strong existing network (or proven ability to build relationships quickly) with reporters and influencers, coupled with a collaborative style that earns trust from internal executives and subject matter experts. flexibility for on-site engagement: willingness and ability to travel as needed for team and company gatherings; a strong preference to candidates that are located near our bellevue or chicago offices. nice to have:industry expertise: experience in grc, cybersecurity, or enterprise software. data-driven storytelling: background with data-driven storytelling or original research, such as benchmark reports and industry surveys, to generate unique narratives. aeo familiarity: familiarity with how ai answer engine optimization (aeo) cites sources and how earned media strategies can feed that visibility. corporate milestone support: experience supporting a company through financial milestones or major leadership announcements. pr agency experience: working in the agency world is a plus!social media acumen: linkedin savvy, strong interest in the power of social mediathe anticipated base salary range for the role is $115,000 - $130,000 per year + bonus + variable + equity + benefits. actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors, such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.office locationthis role is classified as hybrid, based out of our bellevue office. you are expected to be available to work from the office as needed to support in-person collaboration with your team which may include recurring in-office days.how we workat logicgate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. as we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers.our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. we believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported.global total rewardswe invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the us and the uk:compensation & equity: competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options. health & wellbeing: comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region. time away: generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best. growth & development: continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms. recognized as a top workplace by built in, crain’s chicago business, and the chicago tribune.logicgate is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a high-performing, diverse workforce. we make all employment decisions based on merit, business needs, and professional qualifications. we strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic governed by federal, state, and local laws in the united states, the equality act 2010 in the united kingdom, or applicable regulations in any jurisdiction where we operate.

communications, the senior writer is responsible for creating compelling executive and organizational communications that help inform, engage, and connect audiences across uw medicine and beyond. this role translates complex, sensitive, and time-sensitive information into clear, strategic messaging across written, digital, presentation, and multimedia formats. the senior writer plays a visible role in shaping communications that support senior leaders, strengthen organizational alignment, and advance uw medicine’s mission through engaging content, thoughtful storytelling and strong editorial judgment.this hybrid role combines remote work with regular onsite presence to support interviews, reporting, outreach and engagement, and multimedia content development.key responsibilitiesexecutive and leadership communications – 45%draft and refine high-visibility communications on behalf of senior leaders across uw medicine, ensuring each message reflects the leader’s voice, priorities, and about avanteask any employee to explain their benefits, and you'll likely get a confused shrug. ask any hr leader if their benefits investment is working, and you'll get an honest "i don't know." for employees, benefits are confusing and overwhelming. for hr and finance leaders, benefits are the second-largest expense, but they lack the visibility to know what's working and what's wasted.at avante, we're changing that. we're an ai-native benefits intelligence platform built to help companies and hr leaders run benefits more effectively with ai. for employees, our agent carly provides personalized, always-on benefits guidance. for benefits leaders, our agent ava serves as the extension of the benefits team, handling operational workload and giving them better insights, sooner.we're based in seattle and expanding our presence to new york city, and work 4 days a week in the office (one day remote). we sell to fortune 2000 employers, with customers like samsung, zscaler, and news corp, and our marketing team is still small enough that one person's writing sets the tone for how the entire market understands what we do. we're looking for a senior content marketing manager to be that person.the roleai for benefits barely existed two years ago, and someone has to write the story of why it matters. that's this role: you'll be the voice behind the ideas, events, and content that make hr and benefits leaders sit up and pay attention.day to day, you'll plan and write across a range of formats: blog posts, sales enablement materials, event and webinar content, social, and more, moving fluidly between short-term production and longer-term editorial planning. you'll partner closely with product marketing, demand generation, and creative to make sure content ladders up to the right goals and reaches the right audience, and you'll use data to figure out what's working and adjust accordingly.this is a senior individual contributor role built for a writer at heart: you'll launch thought leadership communications, shape the narrative behind our webinars and panels, and turn avante's customer relationships into stories nobody else can tell. you'll own and curate avante’s brand voice, and identify areas of improvement as this industry continues to develop. what's yours is the writing itself: the original thinking, sharp framing, and proprietary point of view that no ai tool or outside agency can produce.what you'll dobuild avante's content engine. stand up the fundamentals: a working content calendar, website content, and a steady cadence of gtm enablement materials that give sales something concrete to use in every deal.curate avante's point of view. build narratives, materials, and thought leadership that define our category, educate and entertain our buyers, and enlighten and engage our partners and customers.write and shape our event content. build the speaker guides, narrative arcs, and talking points behind our webinars, panels, and podcasts. you provide the narrative and direction; creative partners handle production.lead our social presence. you'll shape what we say on our social platforms and make sure it sounds like a company with something to say, not another ai vendor posting for the algorithm.support demand generation with nurture content. write the drip sequences that keep leads warm once they enter the funnel, and write to improve aeo and seo through topical content, optimized for ranking.protect a consistent brand voice. make sure everything avante puts out, whatever the format or channel, sounds like it's coming from the same company. you're the one who catches it when copy drifts off-brand, and the one who keeps that voice sharp as more people touch content over time.use ai to extend your reach, not replace your thinking. let it handle the mechanical work, slicing long-form pieces into emails, subject lines, and social copy, so you can spend your time on what it can't produce: original ideas, real customer stories, and a voice that's recognizably avante's.adapt as we grow. scope will shift as the marketing function scales, and you should welcome that.what we're looking for7+ years in content marketing or a writing-heavy communications role, with a portfolio led by thought leadership and executive or event content, not general content opsbachelors degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent experienceexcellent, independently strong writing and editing skills; you can take a rough transcript or technical brief and turn it into something a senior hr or benefits leader wants to readdirect experience writing for events: speaker guides, panel and webinar narratives, or podcast contenta track record of producing enablement materials that sales teams actually use, built on real relationships, not generic testimonialscomfort using ai tools to repurpose and extend long-form writing, paired with clear judgment about what only a human writer should produceexperience partnering with product marketing or brand partners and executing on their vision.early-stage startup experience, including comfort being the only content person for a whileexperience marketing to enterprise-level/fortune 2000 companiesnice to havea published writing background (bylines, books, or a personal platform with real readership)experience marketing to hr, benefits, or healthcare buyershow we workour four values aren't aspirational. they translate into concrete operating tenets that shape how we make decisions every day.beat yesterday. we re-evaluate our own toolkit every quarter, because the workflows that made you effective three months ago may already be outdated. we act on 70% of the information rather than waiting for certainty. we timebox, execute, and iterate, getting work in front of real people quickly instead of polishing in isolation. and we own our output regardless of how we produced it. ai can get you 80% of the way there. everything that goes out with your name on it is your responsibility to review, refine, and stand behind.embrace type 2 fun. we take on hard problems and find meaning in the work, even when it's uncomfortable. we assume good intent and follow up directly rather than venting in side channels. we celebrate wins loudly and specifically, naming the actual behavior so the whole team learns what great looks like. we are on by default, because we owe it to each other and to our customers to be available beyond what a regular corporate job would demand. and we do unscalable things today that build scalable advantages tomorrow: every hand-built case study and late-night byline turnaround earns us the right to scale later.stay hungry, stay curious. we expect everyone to be the expert on ai in their function before anyone asks them to be. the landscape changes weekly. when you learn something, teach it. learn enough about adjacent functions to ask good questions. ask the question you think is too basic, because in complex domains like benefits, the cost of a wrong assumption can be a lost account. and remember: curiosity without urgency is a hobby. learning has to translate into action on a timeline that matches the opportunity.act like an owner. we say the uncomfortable thing early, raising missed commitments or quality gaps directly with the person within 48 hours. we surface problems when they're small, not the week they become a crisis. customer-facing work gets priority, always. and we close the loop every time, because over-communication is a feature at our stage, not a bug.comp: $120k-$155k base, + equity

in seattle and barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. we’re investing in ai as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to ai tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.we are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 best companies to work for in seattle business magazine and washington’s best workplaces in the puget sound business journal. at rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.want to make an impact? join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.who we're looking for:you live on the internet, you know creator manager, you’ll lead how rover shows up with creators. that means choosing who we work with, building relationships that last, and shaping the strategy behind every collaboration. you’ll make sure creator content feels native to the platform, true to our brand, and loved by pet parents. you’ll sit on the brand pr & social team and work hand in hand with our paid and affiliate marketing manager, who owns performance and paid amplification, so great creator work goes further and everything we put out reads as one story.this is a role with room to shape. you’ll help define how rover brand awareness, and aeo ranking). find and select the right creators. scout, vet, and recommend creators who fit our brand and audience, and review agency recommendations with a sharp eye. build real relationships. be the day-to-day face of rover for creators. make briefing, approvals, and payments smooth so the best ones keep coming back. build, scale and manage our community program. rover has a passionate community of care providers and pet parents. you will help tap into this community to build long term value, nurture relationships, and increase social mentions and positive sentiment. own content review. give clear, creative feedback that protects the brand without flattening the creator’s voice, and make sure disclosure and brand standards are met in partnership with brand studio creative teams. negotiate and contract. work with legal and finance on rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights. keep teams in sync. coordinate across brand, studio, pr, social, and performance so launches and campaigns become one cohesive story. manage agency partners. share day-to-day agency management for creator work and help evaluate vendors and platforms. bring curiosity and a test & learn mindset . track trends, platform changes, and partnerships in the market, and bring ideas and novel ways of testing or ways of working the team hasn’t thought of yet. measure what matters. report on creator performance across reach, consideration/conversion, engagement, sentiment, and brand health, and turn it into recommendations. explore adjacent partnerships like ambassadors and talent as the program evolves. what you bring6-8 years in creator, influencer, social, or brand partnerships marketing, with a track record of building programs and relationships that moved both brand and business results. a deep, current feel for social. you know what’s working on tiktok, instagram, and youtube right now, who’s rising, and what makes content feel native instead of forced. a strong eye for creators and a point of view on how brand and creator partnerships are evolving in the marketplace. experience managing creator relationships end to end, from outreach and briefing to review, approvals, and payment. working knowledge of usage rights, exclusivity, whitelisting, and ftc disclosure requirements. experience with agencies and creator management platforms (such as creatoriq or similar). strong creative judgment and the ability to give clear, kind, useful feedback to creators and internal teams. comfort measuring creator work across brand and performance metrics, and presenting it clearly to senior stakeholders. a genuinely collaborative style. you work well with brand, creative studio, and paid media teams, and you’re excited about building a holistic program that supports differing goals (awareness, conversion, aeo ranking) adaptability when priorities, ownership, and structure shift, and curiosity that keeps you learning. experience using ai and automation tools to work faster and smarter, while also maintaining strong ai guardrails for platform usage. bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. benefits of working at dedicated infusion pump consumables business. this highly visible role sits at the intersection of product management, commercial execution, customer engagement, and business strategy.the individual successful product launches, and commercial adoption.key responsibilities portfolio strategy & business growth develop and execute portfolio strategies to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market share expansion for the dedicated infusion consumables portfolio.  identify market opportunities, customer needs, competitive vulnerabilities, and emerging industry trends that can influence financial performance.  develop portfolio investment recommendations based on customer insights, market opportunity, and business impact.  product marketing & commercial execution develop compelling value propositions, positioning, and messaging that clearly differentiate icu medical infusion systems and cross-portfolio products in the marketplace.  partner closely with commercial teams to execute growth strategies and achieve business objectives.  lead product launch planning and commercialization activities for new products, line extensions, and portfolio enhancements.  create and deliver impactful sales enablement programs, training materials, competitive tools, and customer-facing content.  deliver everboarding content and materials for sales kick-off and various other sales trainings throughout the year  ensure consistent and effective communication of portfolio strategies across commercial organizations.  engage directly with clinicians, pharmacists, supply chain leaders, and hospital decision-makers to identify unmet needs and validate product and portfolio strategies.  provide responsive support to sales & customer requests  pricing & profitability management develop pricing recommendations, value-based pricing strategies, and portfolio packaging approaches to optimize revenue and margin performance.  monitor competitive pricing dynamics and recommend actions that strengthen market position.  evaluate profitability trends and identify opportunities for margin expansion.  forecasting & operational leadership own demand planning inputs, portfolio forecasting, allocation support, and inventory-related commercial planning activities.  partner with supply chain and operations teams to ensure alignment between market demand and product availability.  lead commercial input for rfi, rfp, and strategic account opportunities.  competitive intelligence maintain expert knowledge of the competitive landscape and emerging market developments.  conduct primary and secondary market research to identify growth opportunities, customer needs, and competitive threats. provide actionable competitive intelligence to support sales effectiveness, product strategy, and business planning.  anticipate market shifts and develop proactive responses to competitive threats. minimum qualifications, education, and experience bachelor's degree in business, marketing, life sciences, healthcare administration, engineering, or related field.  minimum 4 years of experience in marketing, sales, or commercial roles within the medical device or healthcare industry.  demonstrated experience developing and executing successful commercialization strategies.  experience creating customer-facing value propositions and sales enablement programs.  strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.  demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.  excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, including with c-suite executives.  proficiency with microsoft 365 applications.  must be at least 18 years of age. preferred qualifications mba or other advanced business degree.  experience with infusion therapy, vascular access, iv consumables, medication delivery, or related clinical products.  direct marketing management responsibilities for an fda class ii medical device with dedicated consumables  experience marketing both medical consumables and capital equipment.  knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, gpo dynamics, and healthcare economics.  experience supporting product launches in regulated healthcare environments.  familiarity with nursing, pharmacy, and acute care clinical workflows. travel requirements typically requires travel 5-20% of the time physical requirements and work environment this role is a largely sedentary role  while performing the duties of this job, the employee comparisons, synthesizing findings, and recommending next steps is a plus. working knowledge of creative experimentation or user-testing principles and limitations.about perkspotour journey began in solution employees across the globe rely on to stretch their paychecks. in 2018, perkspot raised $50m from susquehanna growth equity and today the business serves more than 22 million employees from decisions.your first few months as a perkspotterproviding value doesn’t have to wait, from day one we are open to your big ideas. in your first few months, you will...meet the team! we think our bit of time with the creative & experience strategy team members.get to know perkspot! immerse yourself in the business, engage with internal stakeholders, and participate in monthly companywide all-hands meetings.sharpen your skills! you’ll deepen your expertise in marketing program management and cross-functional collaboration.see your impact! own how approved priorities are scoped, offercompetitive salary, matching 401k, and company-paid disability.comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance is effective on your first day of employment!time off is required. we want our team members to rest, relax, and recharge, so we encourage employees to take 20 days off each year. plus, we offer 8 paid company holidays and our office is closed from christmas eve through new year's day.summer fridays are great and are an annual tradition between memorial day and labor day every year.to help you get a jump start on company holidays, we close at 1 pm the day prior to each company holiday as “holiday eve.”tenure is valued and rewarded. in addition to pto, we offer a paid sabbatical for up to 3 months to employees at 5 years and 10 years of service.commuting can be expensive – we get it. so, we provide a monthly transportation stipend and free lunch every wednesday.connection and relationship building is everything. we offer regular outings, virtual events, fun the qualifications, plus any other information you feel would be relevant to perkspot. don’t be afraid to show your spark and personality!all positions require a complete background screening.perkspot standards across content, campaigns, and marketing assets. as the voice of marketing within the integration team, you represent brand and marketing interests across workstreams and ensure that integration decisions uphold brand integrity. you ensure each firm transitions cleanly from integration into business-as-usual (bau).reporting into the growth & marketing lead, integration and coordinating through the integration management office (imo), the firm's central governance body for coordinating and overseeing integration execution, you serve as the accountable owner for brand consistency and quality within the marketing & brand workstream. you partner closely with corporate brand, campaign marketing and the digital and website integration teams to ensure brand and marketing execution is consistent, on-standard, and high quality while reflecting local market and language needs. you operate as both a workstream lead and a hands-on brand practitioner, ensuring brand consistency is delivered repeatably as the firm scales across geographies.essential functions and responsibilities: own the brand integration plan for assigned firms, translating approved brand decisions into clear actions, milestones, owners, dependencies and handover dates.  translate approved brand strategy and acquisition brand decisions into clear integration plans, milestones, owners and dependencies.  ensure each integrated firm adopts a consistent visual identity, applying branded templates, visual identity assets, and guidelines uniformly across markets.  review and quality-assure integrated content, campaigns, and marketing assets to confirm they meet global brand standards before go-live.  act as the voice of marketing within the integration team, representing brand and dependencies across workstreams and ensuring integration decisions uphold brand integrity.  coordinate localization and translation requirements with relevant market and specialist teams, ensuring approved brand standards are maintained.  support the application of approved global campaigns and creative in integrating markets, working with campaign marketing and creative teams to maintain a consistent brand look, feel and message.  coordinate with the sales & marketing collateral lead to keep brand content and sales collateral visually and stylistically consistent.  partner with corporate brand and campaign marketing to enforce global brand standards, messaging, and creative quality across integrated firms.  manage integration activities against capacity, identifying gaps, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs; escalate decisions through imo governance.  coordinate with outsourced and contracted delivery partners where brand, creative, or content production is externally sourced, ensuring brand quality and standards are met.  use established brand governance playbooks and standards to support consistent, repeatable brand onboarding, identifying gaps or improvements for brand operations to address.  provide practical brand onboarding and guidance to joining marketing teams, helping them understand what must be applied consistently, where adaptation is permitted and when central approval is required.  maintain a clear record of brand decisions, approvals, exceptions, open issues and outstanding actions throughout each integration.  other duties as assigned. you have the following technical skills and qualifications: bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field  5-7 years of experience in brand management, brand marketing, creative direction, or related roles within professional services or b2b environments  demonstrated experience enforcing brand consistency, visual identity, and creative quality standards across markets or business units  strong eye for visual identity, design quality, and brand governance, with experience managing brand guidelines and asset libraries  experience supporting website or digital content integration while maintaining brand and visual identity standards  familiarity with localization and translation of marketing content across languages without compromising brand consistency  proven ability to lead cross-functional work, influence stakeholders, and deliver against defined timelines in a matrixed environment  experience managing outsourced or contracted delivery partners against defined deliverables and quality standards  excellent communication and project management skills, with strong attention to detail and creative quality  experience experience, business needs, progression within the role, geographic location, and internal equity. at grant thornton, compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.about usat grant thornton, we believe in making business more personal and building trust into every result – for our clients and you. here, we go beyond your expectations of a
