detail.desc: the application window is expected to close on: 11/12/2026meet the teamglobal communications is a team of more than 150 best-in-class communications professionals. our mission is to protect and improve cisco's reputation through innovative and thought-provoking storytelling, execution excellence and transparency. the pr team is responsible for leading cisco's corporate and technology pr programs, as well as crafting and delivering clear and compelling narratives that grab the attention of media and influencers.your impactas pr manager for the office of the cto, you'll shape how the world understands cisco's most forward-thinking innovation—from quantum computing breakthroughs to the emerging internet of agents. you'll operate at the intersection of cutting-edge research, open source strategy, and product innovation, telling stories about the hidden technologies and transformative shifts that define cisco's future. this is a unique opportunity to be a strategic storyteller and discovery engine, uncovering and amplifying narratives that position cisco as an innovation leader while working collaboratively across research, product, and communications teams.in this hybrid role, you'll split time between external visibility for outshift (our incubation engine for emerging technologies) and broader strategic storytelling around other innovative technologies. you'll translate complex, nascent innovations into clear, compelling narratives for enterprise leaders, industry influencers, and developer communities. you'll serve as a thought partner to research and product teams, helping them recognize storytelling opportunities early, refine positioning, and navigate the ambiguity of innovation storytelling. you'll move with startup agility, dig into technical depth, and build the media relationships and narrative frameworks that give cisco outsized mindshare in categories not yet fully defined.key responsibilitiesstrategic storytelling & discovery: serve as a discovery engine for emerging narratives around cisco's research innovations, open source contributions, and platform strategy—identifying white-space storytelling opportunities and translating complex technical breakthroughs into clear, audience-relevant narratives. work deeply with research teams to uncover stories early, refine positioning based on market signals, and connect innovation work to broader business strategy. cross-functional collaboration & stakeholder management: partner with research, product, product marketing, and communications teams to align on narrative direction and ensure storytelling opportunities are identified and elevated early. provide strategic counsel and clarity to technical teams on messaging and positioning, managing stakeholder expectations across matrixed environments. cross-functional collaboration: build strong partnerships with cisco communications teams, bridging the gap in our storytelling between cisco’s products today and innovations that will unlock future opportunities for our customers. partner with global communications teams to amplify our work in region. media relations: proactively build and nurture relationships with top-tier business, technology, trade and new media covering ai, quantum, distributed systems, developer topics and emerging infrastructure. pitch stories with conviction, secure high-impact coverage, and drive message pull-through. campaign management: own end-to-end campaign execution for launches and strategic initiatives—from strategy through measurement. manage timelines, agency relationships, and multi-channel delivery, leveraging ai tools and automation to accelerate workflows without sacrificing editorial rigor. lead coordination with other communications functions, including analyst relations, employees communications and digital communications. strategic counsel: serve as a trusted strategic advisor to product, product marketing, and executive leadership. bring external market perspective (competitive moves, media sentiment, industry trends) to internal decision-making. minimum qualifications7+ years of experience in public relations, communications, or marketing (with at least 3 years in a pr or external communications role). domain expertise in enterprise b2b technologies—particularly experience covering or communicating about networking, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, open source, emerging compute, or ai. proven ability to synthesize complex technical information and translate it into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences (practitioners, c-suite, investors, media). track record of building relationships with media, analysts, and influencers; demonstrated ability to secure coverage in relevant publications. comfort with ambiguity and emerging technologies—ability to operate in spaces where categories are nascent, positioning is in flux, and narratives are still forming. strong cross-functional collaboration skills—proven ability to work effectively with product, research, and technical teams; skilled at managing up, across, and down in matrixed environments. self-starter mentality—bias toward discovery and action; ability to identify storytelling opportunities and refine narrative direction with minimal direction. comfortable engaging with researchers, engineers, and product teams on technical depth while translating for external audiences. strong writing and editorial judgment—ability to craft sharp, clear narratives and refine positioning based on market feedback. preferred qualificationsbackground at a tech company, or research-focused organization—where you've navigated rapid pivots, worn multiple hats, and moved fast with incomplete information. experience in quantum computing, ai research, or infrastructure innovation—or demonstrated hunger to learn and build expertise in these spaces. experience in communications roles with open source strategy and/or developer communities. active in tech communities—well-networked with technologists, researchers, journalists; finger on the pulse of emerging trends and who carries narrative influence. why cisco?at cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the ai era – and beyond. we’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. these solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. we work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.we are cisco, and our power starts with you.message to applicants applying to work in the u.s. and/or canada:the starting salary range posted for this position is $129,100.00 to $163,800.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in u.s. and/or canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, ai era with strategic communications that inspire business leaders, decision-makers and society at large.we lead with earned media and pair it with strategy, data and creative that connect to how detail.desc: our offices in boca raton, fl and nashville, tn are where we come together for collaboration, education, and celebrations, and we’re looking for teammates who can join us in person for those meaningful moments.reports to: evp, strategy & innovationyears experience: 10+ yearsdepartment: strategy & innovationthe position:the director, brand strategy is the lead commercialization and market strategy expert within bpd’s integrated pharmaceutical engagement model. bridging commercial strategy, market access, customer engagement, and brand activation, this role helps pharmaceutical clients position, launch, and grow brands in competitive markets - translating scientific differentiation into business opportunity and engagement strategies that drive adoption, access, and long-term growth.partnering across medical affairs, market access, analytics, media, creative, sales enablement, and account leadership, the director, brand strategy develops commercially viable, insight-driven go-to-market strategies grounded in real market dynamics and customer behavior, and serves as a trusted strategic advisor in client engagements and business development.the responsibilities:includes, but not limited to the following:lead commercial planning for pharmaceutical brands across pre-launch, launch, and growth phases, including launch readiness and strategic prioritization.develop integrated commercialization and go-to-market strategies — channel strategy, stakeholder engagement, customer journey planning, and activation frameworks — aligned to market opportunity and business objectives.analyze therapeutic category dynamics, competitive landscapes, reimbursement environments, and customer behavior; translate market intelligence into actionable commercial recommendations and identify barriers, adoption challenges, and whitespace opportunities.integrate market access, payer, and healthcare ecosystem considerations into brand strategy, and support stakeholder segmentation across hcps, payers, health systems, advocacy groups, and patients.partner with brand strategy and creative to define differentiated positioning and messaging frameworks that align scientific differentiation with commercial opportunity, translating clinical value into meaningful market narratives.partner with media and engagement teams to shape omnichannel engagement and customer activation plans across digital and in-person ecosystems, leveraging bpd and mjh engagement capabilities.serve as a strategic advisor to clients throughout engagements, building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.play an active role in business development - partnering with growth and account leadership to shape pharma-focused pitches, proposals, and organic growth opportunities, and representing bpd’s commercial strategy capabilities in the market.leverage ai-enabled tools and bpd’s proprietary data platform to accelerate market analysis, insight generation, and commercial planning.the essentials:10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical commercialization, brand strategy, launch planning, or consulting.deep understanding of pharma market dynamics and commercialization models; experience in specialty, rare disease, or complex therapeutic categories preferred.strong grasp of payer, reimbursement, and market access considerations.experience developing omnichannel engagement and customer activation strategies.ability to communicate effectively with scientific and commercial stakeholders alike, and to collaborate across integrated, cross-functional teams.ba/bs in an advanced science, business, or related field; advanced degree (mba, mph, or science) a plus.fluency with ai-enabled tools and data platforms to inform insight generation, market analysis, and commercial planning.comfort operating in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.able to travel as needed.the vision:bpd health is the strategic growth partner trusted by the most ambitious brands in health. purpose-built for health brands, health systems, pharmaceutical companies and healthcare innovators, we help organizations grow by connecting market position, team engagement, physician referrals, patient demand, payer relations and community impact into one coordinated growth system. as part of mjh life sciences, we give clients direct access to the largest physician engagement network in the u.s.unified bpd unites our diverse backgrounds and perspectives into a stronger collective—one that fosters a more inclusive, impactful future for our people, our clients, and healthcare as a whole. guided by ongoing reflection and learning, we respect every race, ethnicity, gender expression, sexual identity, ability, and life experience.as bpderrrs, we:celebrate and value what makes each of us unique;unite around our shared purpose to ignite greatness in those we serve and, by extension, help them improve the health to the communities they serve;lead through inclusive work that authentically connects with all consumers and champions health equity for alllean into honest dialogue, acknowledging that building a diverse workforce, fostering belonging, and creating the best, most inclusive work for our clients and their communities is an ongoing journey.this commitment ignites our organization’s greatness and grounds the brilliant work we do for our clients and communities.bpd is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. bpd recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, protected veteran status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or citizenship status.

why usaa?at usaa, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. we seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.embrace a fulfilling career at usaa, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.we are proud to support active-duty military spouses. usaa roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.the opportunityour creative strategist senior translates business priorities, audience insights, and usaa’s brand strategy into compelling creative strategies that strengthen relevance, deepen trust, and drive growth. connects the needs of prospective and existing members with distinctive storytelling across channels and the marketing journey. develops clear, actionable creative briefs that align stakeholders and guide creative development. partners across marketing to connect creative decisions to meaningful member and business outcomes while reinforcing usaa’s mission and a unified brand.we offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. this position can be based in one of the following locations: san antonio, tx, plano, tx, phoenix, az, charlotte, nc, colorado springs, co, and tampa, fl.relocation assistance is not available for this position.what you'll dodevelops creative strategy for assigned campaigns and initiatives, translating business objectives, audience priorities, and the master brand platform into focused creative recommendations. applies usaa’s understanding of the military community and the master brand platform to campaign-level strategy, messaging, and storytelling.creates concise, actionable creative briefs that define the business challenge, audience, desired response, core insight, messaging priorities, and creative guardrails. applies the master brand platform to campaign-level creative strategy and messaging, ensuring assigned initiatives reinforce a consistent and distinctive expression of usaa.develops messaging and storytelling recommendations across acquisition, engagement, and retention, adapting recommendations to audience and channel needs. clarifies requirements, consolidates stakeholder feedback, and confirms alignment before creative development.partners closely with in-house creative teams and external agencies from briefing through development, representing the strategy, providing actionable feedback, and evaluating concepts against the approved brief, master brand platform, audience needs, and intended outcomes.applies audience insights, creative testing findings, campaign performance, and other available evidence to refine campaign-level strategy, messaging, and recommendations.applies established strategic frameworks and emerging cultural, channel, and creative practices, including responsible ai use, to improve the relevance, quality, and efficiency of strategic work. resolves routine questions and escalates significant or conflicting direction promptly to the lead creative strategist reduce avoidable back-and-forth and rework. ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.what you havebachelor's degree; or 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.7-8 years of experience in creative strategy, brand strategy, account planning, integrated marketing strategy, or a related discipline. demonstrated experience independently developing creative strategy for integrated marketing campaigns. demonstrated ability to translate audience research and business objectives into concise creative briefs and messaging recommendations that creative teams can execute. experience collaborating with creative teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and agencies to clarify direction and resolve feedback. experience applying audience insights, creative testing, and campaign performance findings to refine campaign-level creative strategy and messaging. knowledge of brand building, consumer behavior, and channel-specific storytelling across digital, social, video, and other marketing channels. demonstrated ability to present strategic recommendations clearly and manage multiple assignments and deadlines. what sets you apartconnect business strategy to creative strategy translate defined business objectives, audience needs and brand direction into a focused creative problem and actionable strategy for assigned initiatives.find the insight that unlocks the work connect available audience insights, cultural context and member needs to identify the human tension or truth most relevant to the assignment.bring a clear strategic point of view make and clearly articulates strategic recommendations rather than simply capturing stakeholder input or facilitating the process.inspire rather than constrains creative teams you write focused briefs and provides strategic guidance that inspires ideas while leaving room for creative exploration.make the work feel distinctly usaa apply the master brand platform and usaa’s understanding of the military community to campaign-level messaging and storytelling.is a trusted creative partner work alongside creative teams from briefing through development, providing constructive strategic feedback that keeps the work true to the brief and brand.compensation range: the salary range for this position is: $103,450 - $197,730.usaa does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., h-1b, tn, stem opt training plans, etc.).compensation: usaa has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. you are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. the actual salary for this role may vary by location.employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the usaa board of directors.the above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.benefits: at usaa our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. these benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.for more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on usaajobs.com.applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting. usaa is an equal opportunity employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

at link snacks, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. we don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. we push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the north woods of wisconsin four decades ago.we’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. and just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—jack link’s®, lorissa’s kitchen®, golden island®, bifi®, and peperami® and kooee!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. what you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the link family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.dominating this space across the world takes a team. a team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. a team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.real meat protein. real people. real results. that is link snacks.job descriptionjoin jack link’s as a brand manager and help build and grow the newest brands in the link snacks portfolio. as part of the emerging brand marketing team, you will develop and execute strategies that drive brand growth, combining strategic business leadership with strong execution skills.in this role, you will lead a range of marketing projects that draw on your leadership, strategic and analytical thinking, project management, and creative skills. success requires leading cross-functional teams, driving key initiatives, and collaborating with a variety of internal and external partners.you will also evaluate financial and market performance to identify opportunities and implement strategies that deliver the brand’s revenue, profit, and market share objectives.key responsibilitiesdevelop strategic business models for emerging brands portfolio.  test, learn, and implement. manage and deliver the brand p&l. work with cross-functional teams to measure and analyze sales impact, sales execution and the profitability/roi of marketing investments. partner with director and agency partners to build the brand from the ground up, specifically establish brand positioning, brand voice, brand personality and packaging architecture. develop and execute brand marketing plans, with excellence through cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality and readiness of plans, tracking of performance in market, course-correction and learnings to improve future performance. lead cross-functional efforts, in close partnership with product development and consumer insights to develop and commercialize new products and expansion efforts to drive sales and profit. develop product positioning, packaging, and pricing strategy to produce the highest possible long-term market sharelead development of best-in-class, integrated marketing plans informed by consumer insights and backed by data. understand channel and customer business dynamics and leverage insights to inform brand growth strategies, product and consumer marketing opportunities to drive growth, including non-traditional channels and ecommerce. uncover actionable and powerful insights through analysis of brand performance, consumer insights, category trends & competitive dynamics.  leverage these insights to shape brand strategy and growth opportunity recommendations. create marketing plans/initiatives to drive growth through lean investment.  including building relationships with other emerging brands, creative marketing tactics, etc. work with cross-functional teams to measure and analyze sales impact, sales execution and the profitability/roi including brand budgets. perform other duties as assigned.  qualificationsundergraduate degree in marketing or related field with 5+ years marketing experience. 5+ years preferred experience within a start-up company or start-up environment. consumer packaged goods (cpg) industry experience preferred. demonstrated experience thinking and executing like a business owner: someone who can take initiative and get things done while having fun in an entrepreneurial environmentexperience in rapidly developing & testing new marketing models. experience managing & analyzing meta ads to assess performance and pivot as needed. experience leading the launch of a product from idea to market. high levels of interpersonal skills, specifically in the area of influencing without direct authority, resolving conflict, and creative problem solving. ability to lead complex, strategic projects through commercialization. proven track record of driving profitable growth including p&l and marketing spend responsibilities. experience managing and influencing cross-functional teams in conversations and in presentations. resilient problem solver.  experience building consensus even if all team members may not be in agreement.  can find creative solutions and common ground in order to move key initiatives forward. ability to work independently and cross-functionally to lead programs, analyze data and drive results in a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment. proficient in nielsen/iri syndicated data. familiarity with common consumer marketing research tools and techniques. excellent verbal and written communication skills; must work effectively with all levels of leadership and team members. must be willing to roll up your sleeves, learn new skills, and wear multiple hats. driven to build and willing to pivot in a rapidly changing environment. highly organized with strong on time management and meeting deadline skills. strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking. highly creative with ability to think opportunity the greater toledo community foundation has been a force for community investment and impact for more than fifty years. by connecting generosity with meaningful community causes, the community foundation is the largest philanthropic institution serving northwest ohio and southeast michigan. the foundation seeks a skilled and versatile communications officer to serve as its primary charitable resource serving the greater toledo region. with more than $600 million in assets across 1100+ funds, the foundation is the region’s largest grantmaker, distributing over $30 million impact. in addition, the foundation designs and hosts innovative programs that strengthen the region’s nonprofit ecosystem. position summary the communications officer is the community foundation’s consistent with the community foundation’s voice, and proofread final materials to catch copy and design errors before publication. ﻿program support develop the communications that support the community foundation’s events and programs, such as promotion, invitations, and written materials. provide support for event planning, media coverage and execution. essential professional assets bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, english or a related field, or equivalent experience. three to five years of experience in communications, public relations, journalism or marketing, ideally in a nonprofit or higher education setting. exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio showing range across news, feature, executive and donor-facing writing. working knowledge of ap style and the ability to maintain a consistent brand voice. experience writing for executives, including speeches, talking points and bylined articles. experience with website content management, email platforms and social media scheduling tools. essential personal assets a sharp eye for detail and a rigorous, unsparing editing standard, with a proven ability to catch copy, formatting and design errors, from typos and inconsistent style to misaligned layouts and incorrect names, figures and dates. comfort managing several projects and deadlines at once, including a recurring publishing calendar. sound judgment and discretion with confidential donor, board and financial information. collaborative style, with the ability to work with staff at every office environment and requires the ability to speak, hear, and see (near and far), move throughout the office, sit for extended periods, and attend meetings. reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. work authorization authorization to work within the united states without sponsorship. what we offer salary commensurate with experience comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance 403(b) retirement plan with 5% employer match life and disability insurance generous paid time off, starting at three (3) weeks annually sick leave and generous paid holidays this is a full-time position based in toledo, ohio. the location the greater toledo community foundation is located in downtown toledo, offering a collaborative and welcoming detail.desc: descriptionamazon’s last-mile delivery network touches millions of customers every day — and with that scale comes real scrutiny. legislation, regulatory shifts, and coordinated advocacy campaigns can move fast, and the stories they generate don’t wait for anyone. this role puts you at the center of how amazon identifies, understands, and responds to the issues that matter most to its last-mile delivery operations.as communications manager, last-mile issues and campaigns, you'll own the communications strategy for a portfolio that touches aspects of amazon's last-mile delivery model. last-mile delivery touches regulation, safety, and public trust, and this role sits at the center of how we communicate across all of it. you'll lead strategic narrative development and scenario planning that keeps the team ahead of legislative shifts, emerging campaigns, and related issues. you'll coordinate across relevant business lines and communications teams, partnering with policy comms, field comms, and others, to bring the right expertise to bear at the right moment and ensure amazon speaks with one clear, strategic voice. you'll draft the statements, talking points, and briefing documents that represent amazon externally, and you'll manage the feedback and approval cycles that come with them. you'll spend as much time seeding stories and shaping narratives as you do managing the reactive moments that come with the portfolio.you're a high-judgment communicator who doesn't flinch when things get complicated. you can hold multiple fast-moving situations at once without losing your footing, but what sets you apart is your ability to spot the issue before it breaks and start building the strategy, not just the response. you think clearly under pressure, write precisely on deadline, and know how to bring the right people together at the right moment. you're comfortable as an on-the-record spokesperson, and you know how to work with reporters to shape a story before it spirals. you think like a strategist, connecting dots across policy, operations, and reputation to protect and advance the business. you don't wait to be told there's a problem. you've already mapped the landscape, built the plan, and brought the right people to the table.this is a strong independent contributor role that reports into the core operations communications team within the global operations and workplace reputation team.key job responsibilitiesmanage complex, fast-moving, and unexpected communications challenges with high judgment and professionalism.be precise under tight deadlines and prioritize and manage multiple situations simultaneously.effectively represent amazon as an on-the-record spokesperson.work with reporters to correct and clarify breaking news stories.write, develop, and manage approvals of external communications materials dealing with sensitive and timely topics.participate in multi-stakeholder emergency response meetings to provide insight and guidance from an external communications point-of-view.a day in the lifeyou might start your morning scanning media coverage and legislative trackers to flag any new developments that could affect amazon’s last-mile operations — then pull together a quick brief for a leader heading into a sensitive meeting. by midday, you could be on a call with legal and public policy partners to assess the communications implications of a pending bill or regulatory action, working through the messaging framework and drafting an initial statement. in the afternoon, you may shift to handling a reactive media inquiry on a breaking story, coordinating approvals in real time while staying in close contact with the reporter to manage the narrative. you’ll close out by updating scenario plans for upcoming legislative milestones and checking in with issues managers across the team to make sure nothing’s falling through the cracks.about the teamwe’re a team of strategic communicators responsible for telling the story of how amazon gets people their packages — from the first mile to the last. we work across organizational boundaries to develop integrated communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. we use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. we value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.on the issues side of the team, we move fast and we move together. when a legislative campaign or regulatory challenge emerges, we’re the ones coordinating the response — aligning messaging across legal, policy, and business partners and making sure amazon’s voice is clear, consistent, and credible. we’re building for the long term — investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as amazon grows. if you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other’s growth, this is the team for you.basic qualifications 7+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience bachelor's medical need. diffusphere™, a proprietary, polymer-based micro-sphere technology, is designed to facilitate targeted drug delivery of both existing and novel drugs. the technology is designed to support an extended duration of effect and delivery of drugs in a hyper-localized fashion, targeting only the tissues that physicians want to treat. we believe the potential for fewer adverse events traditional drug delivery methods. the precision of eupraxia's diffusphere™ technology platform has the potential to augment and transform existing fda-approved drugs to improve their safety, and culture!quarterly profit-sharing bonushybrid work schedule team member appreciation events and recognition programsvolunteer opportunitiesmonthly it stipendcasual dress codeon-demand pay options: and new ways of working through communication campaigns, educational content, practical resources, and team member success stories.gather feedback and analyze channel and campaign performance through surveys, stakeholder conversations, focus groups, and analytics. use those insights to improve content, channels, and strategy.maintain high standards for accuracy, accessibility, brand alignment, and quality by verifying information and testing links, processes, and the full team member experience before distribution.perform any other duties needed to help drive our vision, fulfill our mission, and support our core values.to land this opportunityyou have 8+ years of experience in internal communications, marketing communications, corporate communications, or a related field.you have experience helping shape internal communications strategy and translating it into thoughtful plans, high-quality deliverables, and measurable results.you have meaningful experience using microsoft teams and sharepoint as strategic communications channels - not simply publishing content within them.you have a strong eye for visual storytelling and communication and can create engaging, on-brand internal materials. experience with canva is a plus.you understand how to build an effective channel mix, establish clear purposes for different channels, reduce duplication, and help important messages reach the right audiences.you have experience communicating with multiple team member audiences. bonus points for experience supporting a large, distributed, frontline, manufacturing, or fulfillment-center workforce.you’re an exceptional writer and editor who can make complex information clear, concise, relevant, engaging, and actionable across audiences and channels.you know that accurate copy is only the starting point. you instinctively consider what is most important, what the audience needs to understand, why the message matters, and what action someone should take.you’re a proactive self-starter with strong business judgment who can work through ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, find answers, identify missing information, and keep initiatives moving without extensive supervision.you can shape the big picture while rolling up your sleeves to execute the details - from strategy and stakeholder alignment through drafting, publishing, measurement, and follow-through.you can respectfully challenge a request and recommend that a communication be changed, combined, delayed, redirected, or not sent when that best serves the audience and business.you technologies and can help team members understand, adopt, and use new tools confidently and responsibly.you’re willing and able to travel a few times each year for internal meetings, company events, and team member engagement activities.bonus points if you have earned a bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, business, marketing, or a related field.about your future teamour marketing team is an eclectic bunch who likes to have fun and eat (we are in the foodservice space after all). if you have a wealth of knowledge of pop culture, you like sci fi or can bake a mean chocolate chip cookie, you’ll fit in just fine…at parts town, we value transparency and are committed to ensuring our team members feel appreciated and supported. we prioritize our positive workplace culture where collaboration, growth, and work-life balance are celebrated. the salary range for this role is $ 99,296.59 - $ 149,735.85 annually which is based on including but not limited to qualifications, experience, and geographical location. parts town is a pay for performance-company. in addition to base pay, some roles offer a profit-sharing program, and an annual bonus depending on the role. our comprehensive benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with match, employee assistance programs, paid time off, paid sick time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, detail.desc: public relations account supervisor, automated solutionscomplex business. high expectations. stories worth telling.you’re at your best when the work asks more of you. you enjoy digging in to complex topics, asking smart questions and uncovering stories others might overlook. you know how to build relationships, offer confident counsel and turn challenging conversations into productive ones. and you bring the experience, judgment and initiative to move work forward without waiting to be asked.as a public relations account supervisor at bader rutter, you’ll lead day-to-day pr and corporate communications efforts for a key manufacturing client in automated solutions. dedicated to one client, you’ll become deeply immersed in their business, develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders and help shape how they tell their stories to the audiences that matter.if you find satisfaction in solving a tough problem, building strong client relationships and seeing your work make an impact, you’ll find plenty to dig in to here.what you’ll do:lead the client relationship. serve as the day-to-day pr lead and trusted adviser, building strong relationships with client stakeholders; anticipating needs; managing expectations; and providing confident, solutions-oriented counsel.drive earned media and corporate communications. develop compelling, newsworthy storylines; assess opportunities for earned media potential; and execute proactive outreach to trade, business and national media. leverage and expand established journalist relationships to secure meaningful coverage, executive visibility and thought leadership opportunities.own the program. lead content strategy, execution, measurement and reporting, while partnering with account leadership to manage scopes, budgets, key performance indicators and performance.make complex stories compelling. drive content, thought leadership, search engine optimization (seo) and earned media that connect technical expertise to meaningful business and industry issues. translate technical information and business priorities into clear, accurate and engaging narratives — messaging and communications that resonate with industry audiences.anticipate what is next. stay ahead of industry trends, competitor activity, emerging issues and the media landscape to identify opportunities, bring forward fresh thinking and help clients stay ahead of the conversation.deliver exceptional work. maintain high standards for strategic thinking, writing, accuracy and brand voice. guide the development and review of communications materials, ensuring work is thoughtful, polished and ready for clients.bring disciplines together. collaborate across pr, strategy, creative, digital and paid media teams to develop integrated communications approaches while providing direction and mentorship to junior team members.help the business grow. identify opportunities to expand the partnership and support new business efforts.what you’ll bring:at least seven years of relevant experience in public relations or corporate communications, preferably within an agency environment or supporting high-profile brands, complex businesses or senior corporate leadership.a proven track record in earned media relations, including established relationships with relevant trade, business and national media; strong editorial instincts to identify newsworthy angles and evaluate opportunities; and hands-on experience developing compelling pitches and executing targeted outreach that delivers meaningful coverage.strong corporate communications and storytelling expertise, with exceptional writing, editing and presentation skills and the ability to turn complex subject matter into compelling narratives.experience leading client relationships and advising senior stakeholders, with the confidence to provide strategic recommendations, respectfully challenge assumptions and guide conversations toward productive decisions.a track record of earning client trust, delivering thoughtful counsel and moving difficult conversations toward decisions.resilience and composure under pressure. the ability to navigate challenging situations; receive and respond constructively to candid feedback; and maintain confidence, professionalism and perspective when expectations are high.a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment, work independently, and take ownership of projects and results.exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with demonstrated success managing demanding projects, competing priorities and tight deadlines without compromising quality.a collaborative work style, with experience guiding junior colleagues, working across disciplines and bringing teams together to deliver strong work.a genuine interest in manufacturing, automation, supply chain and technology, with the curiosity and ability to quickly develop expertise in complex industries.strong writing, storytelling and media relations skills, including success securing meaningful trade and business coverage.a bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.location: milwaukee, chicago or northern pennsylvaniatravel: up to 25% for client needssalary range: $70,000-95,000 annuallythe provided salary range is a good faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this hire. the actual salary offered will be influenced by candidate experience and other job and market-related factors.in addition to the base salary, our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental and vision insurance with hsa and fsa options, disability and life/ad&d, accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity insurance, pet insurance, identity theft protection, unlimited virtual telemedicine and mental health counseling, 401(k) including company matching, flexible paid time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave and much more.

lead communication and project management for each initiative from inception to completion, on time and in scope. direct promotional efforts that align with each brand's strategy and drive brand growth. partner with operations to assess each property's current marketing, adjust the plan as needed, and own its execution. create print and digital marketing materials, and help restaurant management keep all menus and marketing up to date. work with the graphic designers so every initiative and property need meets brand standards. maintain the shared drive of photos and media. keep every location accurate across internal and third-party platforms (google business profile, yelp, tripadvisor, reservation platforms and others), with current hours and relevant promotional messaging; run weekly audits of hours and content. make website edits and support web and content management (image resizing, color correction, document uploads). manage email marketing campaigns and databases, focusing on the content calendar and lead generation. manage incoming inquiries from the website database. oversee all local pr messaging, external communications and influencer marketing; detail.desc: descriptionamazon’s last-mile delivery network touches millions of customers every day — and with that scale comes real scrutiny. legislation, regulatory shifts, and coordinated advocacy campaigns can move fast, and the stories they generate don’t wait for anyone. this role puts you at the center of how amazon identifies, understands, and responds to the issues that matter most to its last-mile delivery operations.as communications manager, last-mile issues and campaigns, you'll own the communications strategy for a portfolio that touches aspects of amazon's last-mile delivery model. last-mile delivery touches regulation, safety, and public trust, and this role sits at the center of how we communicate across all of it. you'll lead strategic narrative development and scenario planning that keeps the team ahead of legislative shifts, emerging campaigns, and related issues. you'll coordinate across relevant business lines and communications teams, partnering with policy comms, field comms, and others, to bring the right expertise to bear at the right moment and ensure amazon speaks with one clear, strategic voice. you'll draft the statements, talking points, and briefing documents that represent amazon externally, and you'll manage the feedback and approval cycles that come with them. you'll spend as much time seeding stories and shaping narratives as you do managing the reactive moments that come with the portfolio.you're a high-judgment communicator who doesn't flinch when things get complicated. you can hold multiple fast-moving situations at once without losing your footing, but what sets you apart is your ability to spot the issue before it breaks and start building the strategy, not just the response. you think clearly under pressure, write precisely on deadline, and know how to bring the right people together at the right moment. you're comfortable as an on-the-record spokesperson, and you know how to work with reporters to shape a story before it spirals. you think like a strategist, connecting dots across policy, operations, and reputation to protect and advance the business. you don't wait to be told there's a problem. you've already mapped the landscape, built the plan, and brought the right people to the table.this is a strong independent contributor role that reports into the core operations communications team within the global operations and workplace reputation team.key job responsibilitiesmanage complex, fast-moving, and unexpected communications challenges with high judgment and professionalism.be precise under tight deadlines and prioritize and manage multiple situations simultaneously.effectively represent amazon as an on-the-record spokesperson.work with reporters to correct and clarify breaking news stories.write, develop, and manage approvals of external communications materials dealing with sensitive and timely topics.participate in multi-stakeholder emergency response meetings to provide insight and guidance from an external communications point-of-view.a day in the lifeyou might start your morning scanning media coverage and legislative trackers to flag any new developments that could affect amazon’s last-mile operations — then pull together a quick brief for a leader heading into a sensitive meeting. by midday, you could be on a call with legal and public policy partners to assess the communications implications of a pending bill or regulatory action, working through the messaging framework and drafting an initial statement. in the afternoon, you may shift to handling a reactive media inquiry on a breaking story, coordinating approvals in real time while staying in close contact with the reporter to manage the narrative. you’ll close out by updating scenario plans for upcoming legislative milestones and checking in with issues managers across the team to make sure nothing’s falling through the cracks.about the teamwe’re a team of strategic communicators responsible for telling the story of how amazon gets people their packages — from the first mile to the last. we work across organizational boundaries to develop integrated communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. we use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. we value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.on the issues side of the team, we move fast and we move together. when a legislative campaign or regulatory challenge emerges, we’re the ones coordinating the response — aligning messaging across legal, policy, and business partners and making sure amazon’s voice is clear, consistent, and credible. we’re building for the long term — investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as amazon grows. if you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other’s growth, this is the team for you.basic qualifications 7+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience bachelor's this is a hybrid role that requires 4 days/week in either our london office (fitzrovia) or nyc office (financial district)about lorumthe structural conflict at the centre of correspondent banking is not technological. it is economic. banks earn revenue from their balance sheets: they lend deposits, capture fx spreads, and hold funds as long as it is rational to do so. clearing, the act of releasing funds quickly and predictably, competes directly with those economics. an institution designed to lend has a structural incentive to hold deposits; an institution designed to clear has an incentive to release them. when one institution does both, clearing loses. the result is unpredictable settlement, trapped capital, and a correspondent network shrinking by design.why lorumlorum was founded on a different premise: clearing as the business, not a byproduct. the model has been operational since 2023 and grew 55x in 2025, with usd clearing now the majority of volumes alongside a growing treasury offering. we have applied for a u.s. national trust bank charter. the people we hire now will build the clearing and treasury infrastructure it unlocks.lorum should look and feel like the defining correspondent institution for banks. the substance is in the model, the regulation and the volumes. the brand should say so before anyone reads a word, and getting that right is one of the highest-leverage things we can do over the upcoming months.we're looking for a brand design lead to own our brand identity and visual systems. this is a hands-on role, where you will personally design and build cohesive, distinctive brand assets and apply that visual language consistently across every external surface.our clients are regulated financial institutions. everything you design needs to communicate precision, credibility, and institutional quality. this is not consumer fintech.day-to-day responsibilitiesinherit and systematize lorum's existing brand foundation, then evolve the visual identity: logos, typography, colour, iconography, imagery, and brand guidelines.design and produce our on-brand marketing assets: website pages, decks, social, events, and sales else.work closely with marketing, sales, and product to make sure the brand shows up consistently wherever clients encounter us.direct freelance and agency support where it helps, so your own time company description voulez vous is an immersive cabaret experience where dining, performance, and nightlife converge into a fully curated evening. positioned at the intersection of luxury hospitality and experiential entertainment, it reimagines the traditional dinner show and elevates the modern nightlife experience. every detail—from choreography and lighting to atmosphere and service—is intentionally designed to create a cohesive narrative and a memorable journey for guests. currently in a pre-opening phase, voulez vous is bringing this concept to life through a behind-the-scenes story that highlights the artistry, discipline, and creativity behind the final performance. the brand will launch flagship locations in chicago, il and naples, fl, offering themed cabaret nights, private events, corporate entertainment, and signature shows for guests who value exceptional hospitality and immersive storytelling.role description the marketing manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in chicago, il. the marketing manager will lead the development and execution of marketing strategies to build brand awareness, drive ticket sales and reservations, and support the launch and growth of voulez vous in its flagship locations. day-to-day responsibilities include planning and managing integrated campaigns across digital, social, email, and experiential channels; ambitious. we have raised over $900m so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. we are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion energy demand. you can read more about us in this letter from our founders.why this role mattersfusion is one of the most exciting energy stories of this century, but most people don't understand it. fusion.this is a role for someone who understands how great content, strategic distribution, and engaged communities can turn a complex technology into something people understand, follow, and care the cheapest, fastest, most reliable power is power produced closer to where it is usedfor over a hundred years, our electricity system has been built around centralized power plants that send electricity across hundreds of miles of wires to where people work and live. today, that system is straining under growing demand, aging infrastructure, and extreme weather, while every new plant or transmission line takes years to build and costs billions. there is a better, cheaper, and faster way to keep the lights on and prices low. rooftop and community solar, home and neighborhood batteries, electric vehicles and chargers, smart thermostats, and efficient technologies can do the job of new power plants at a fraction of the cost and time. this is local power, sometimes called distributed energy resources or virtual power plants, and it is already working across the country.in 2025, business, trade association and non-profit leaders launched common charge, a national 501c3 non-profit coalition to align advocacy and communications efforts and provide a centralized policy and campaign hub to unlock these local, distributed energy solutions across the country and fundamentally transform our energy system over the next decade.    hiring: campaign director to run multi-state campaign common charge is hiring a campaign director to design, build, and execute a multi-state campaign to craft and maintain the narrative that local, distributed power is here, delivering reliability, and saving consumers money. this role will work with the common charge staff, board, and members organizations to:design, write, and execute state-specific campaign strategies that hold utilities accountable to harnessing the power of locally-sourced community energy with a focus on visibility and education work in partnership with our communications and policy teams to communicate with gubernatorial staff, media, and other leaders in key states and ensure visibility of our core messages by intended audiencesbuild in-state relationships with common charge members and other stakeholders working to ensure coordination with active in-state and regional groups and advance local, distributed energy in our target statesrecruit local, regional, and national non-profit and business partners to join and work in partnership with common charge  be an active spokesperson for local, distributed power, and represent common charge at state, regional and national conferences common charge is a young organization with a start-up mindset. while we’ve done our best to capture the nature of this position, this role will be responsible for performing other duties as assigned.qualificationsat least 8 years of experience in advocacy campaigns, which can include campaign organizing, communications and / or lobbying. specifically looking for candidates with experience using communications as a core advocacy tool. experience building relationships with governor’s offices, lawmakers and / or regulators. the ideal candidate brings existing relationships in multiple states across the country. experience getting a coalition and / or multiple stakeholders to take shared action. common charge is uniquely designed as a 50/50 business and non-profit coalition. experience working with both business as well as non-profit leaders is a plus. passionate about scaling distributed energy as a solution for clean, affordable, reliable energy. while candidates don’t need direct experience working on distributed energy, ideally candidates bring experience working in energy or consumer issues.    experience building a new program, organization, and / or initiative. looking for a candidate with an entrepreneurial spirit to help build and grow the organization as common charge heads into its second year.   detailsthis role is fully remote within the united states. must have access to high-speed internet and within an hour of a major airport. this role will require frequent travel throughout the country andin-person attendance at events, conferences, convenings, government offices, legislativesessions, and other meetings and gatherings (up to 40 - 50% per month). this is a full-time exempt position that reports to the executive director. annual salary range is $140,000 - $150,000. current benefits include healthcare, employer contribution to a retirement account, and paid time off. staff will receive a remote-office setup stipend of $500 plus a laptop, external monitor and home printer.  to applyto apply, fill out this application on our website (https://www.commoncharge.org/post/hiring-local-power-campaign-director-common-charge) by december 1, 2026common charge is an equal opportunity employer. we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

detail.desc: descriptionlocation: raleigh, north carolina (hybrid/office as applicable)schedule: monday and friday remote, tuesday-thursday in office (based on business needs)about edpncat edpnc, our mission is to improve the economic well-being and quality of life for all north carolinians. in partnership with state, regional, local, and private sector leaders, we support north carolina’s growth through business recruitment, existing industry support, international trade and export assistance, small business counseling, and tourism promotion. as a public-private partnership serving on behalf of the state of north carolina, edpnc operates at the intersection of public service and economic strategy. our work helps attract investment, support employers, strengthen communities, and position north carolina as one of the best places in the country to live, work, and do business. we are a collaborative, mission-driven organization that values professionalism, initiative, responsiveness, and strong relationships. the work is fast-paced, meaningful, and highly collaborative, offering employees the opportunity to engage with leaders across business, government, and communities throughout the state. at edpnc, team members are motivated by the opportunity to make a tangible impact while working alongside smart, dedicated people who care deeply about north carolina’s future.about the rolethe community engagement manager is responsible for raising awareness of the impact of the economic development partnership of north carolina among key stakeholders, civic and business leaders, state and local government officials and legislators. the role is focused on developing and implementing communications strategies that demonstrate the positive outcomes of the organization’s work at the grassroots level. a proactive advocate for the edpnc brand, the community engagement manager will collaborate cross-functionally within the organization to identify compelling and relevant narratives that illustrate how the edpnc creates tangible economic opportunities for all north carolinians and disseminate through a wide variety of communications platforms.what you’ll dostorytelling & content creation: develop and execute a comprehensive communication strategy to highlight organizational impact via regular newsletters and bulletins, social media, video and website content, articles, case studies, fact sheets, etc. establish and maintain a centralized content calendar and production timelines to ensure consistency, currency, and relevance. reputation management: monitor public perception by nurturing and optimizing engagement from key stakeholders, civic and community leaders, the business community, and elected officials. build newsletter subscriptions and social media following among targeted in-state audiences. support external public affairs/lobbying partners with briefing documents, fact sheets, and case studies to educate stakeholders and legislative funders on the value and impact of the organization’s work. earned media & public relations: in collaboration with the senior communications manager and visit nc pr team, produce press releases and story pitches for local and statewide media outlets to secure earned media placements highlighting the organization's newsworthy success stories at the state and community level. cross-functional orchestration: lead and align internal teams across the organization including tourism, film, business recruitment and expansion, international trade, and small business advisory. promote local edpnc events and activities taking place across the state (e.g., nc 100, go global road show, board and investor events, tourism fams and destination immersion events, film shoots, etc.). support investor relations efforts to secure private funding with relevant case studies, narrative, and data points. speaking opportunities and strategic sponsorships: identify strategic speaking opportunities with community organizations across the state for edpnc leadership to communicate the organization’s value proposition and business results at a grassroots level. similarly, identify marquee events hosted by organizations with complimentary missions where edpnc can sponsor, attend with investors and partners, and/or benefit from recognition among key audiences. research, tracking and reporting: using insights gleaned from the baseline market research study among key audiences (july 2026), developing data-driven strategies and messaging for each target group. measure the impact of awareness, engagement and reputation-building efforts using metrics, and engagement feedback. requirementswhat we are looking for5+ years of professional experience spanning public relations, corporate communications, marketing, or public affairs, ideally within north carolina. bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, public policy, marketing, or a closely related field. strong existing familiarity with the north carolina political and economic landscape is a plus. key competenciesexceptional written and verbal communication skills, including public speaking, presentations, and copyediting. proven experience managing multi-channel marketing and communications campaigns (newsletters, content creation, social media platforms, earned and paid media). ability to translate business and economic data points into creative, human-centric, accessible stories. commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality work with keen diligence and accuracy. customer service focus and behaviors; an initiative-taking, responsive and accountable collaborator; self-directed and comfortable operating independently. strong organizational skills with a proven ability to balance multiple competing priorities, manage tight timelines, and keep stakeholders informed without dropping details. a problem solver: someone who thinks creatively, brings solutions, is adaptable and able to respond to tough questions and issues with aplomb. high degree of professionalism; tactful; demonstrates mature judgment, discretion, and decisiveness. collaborative: attuned to the needs of a variety of stakeholders and audiences; proactively develop working relationships across the organization and with external partners, agencies, and vendors. travel and work conditionslocation: raleigh, north carolina (hybrid/office as applicable). schedule: monday and friday remote, tuesday-thursday in office (based on business needs). this position is typically performed in an office environment. domestic and international travel outside the office may occur in such settings as airports, hotels, conference and tradeshow facilities, and client/partner offices. the position may entail occasional on-site visits to a client’s facility, which could be manufacturing, distribution, or similar industrial environment. driver’s license and/or passport required (as applicable). we invest in our people—professionally and personally.at edpnc, our benefits are designed to support your career, well-being, and life outside of work.competitive compensation and performance incentives that reward impact and results hybrid work schedule that supports flexibility and balance generous time off, including 4 weeks of pto, 9 paid holidays, 3 sick and wellness days, and 3 flex holidays 401(k) with a 5% employer match after six months to help you build long-term financial security paid parental leave, including 8 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternal leave, because family matters comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with hsa and fsa options company paid short- and long-term disability coverage as well as 50k life insurance for added peace of mind employee assistance program that covers your entire household’s wellbeing voluntary benefit options such as critical illness, accident, hospital indemnity, life insurance, pet insurance, legal and identity protection and long-term care corporate amenities such as paid parking, gym access and complimentary snacks family forward certified, reflecting our commitment to family-friendly workplace practices apply nowjoin us in shaping north carolina’s economic future!

americans advancing justice affiliation in 2014. our work is organized into four areas: policy and organizing, civic engagement and outreach, impact litigation, and legal services.our mission is to advance justice in a broad multiracial movement and build power within asian american, pacific islander (aapi), arab, middle eastern, muslim, and south asian (amemsa), and immigrant communities across georgia and the southeast. we envision a just world that embraces self-determination, transformative solidarity, and thriving communities.about the departmentthe civic engagement and outreach (ceo) department is how advancing justice-atlanta reaches aapi and immigrant communities at scale. during election seasons, the department runs the organization’s field program, including in-language voter relationships that make field work possible, with community associations, faith spaces, businesses, campus groups, community centers, and the trusted leaders within georgia’s korean, vietnamese, chinese, south asian, muslim, and other ethnic, faith, and language communities.ceo works closely with the policy and organizing department. ceo builds the organization’s reach into communities and turf, managing traditional and soft canvassing, phone and text banking, and in-language mail and literature.build and run the voter registration program, including registration drives at partner sites and community events.own quality control for the field program, including canvasser accuracy, data hygiene, and daily tracking of contact rates, and adjust tactics to maximize contacts.lead election detail.desc: descriptionsenior product marketing manager, chariot marketing — cross-channel, cross-category marketing (xcm)about the rolecross-channel, cross-category marketing (xcm) aims to be the most culturally aware, creatively breakthrough, and measurably effective marketing organization in the world. we strengthen the brand, grow the business, and reduce cost for amazon. within xcm, chariot marketing owns the worldwide marketing strategy for amazon's branded delivery fleet, packaging experiences, and emerging physical media channels.we are looking for a senior product marketing manager who combines exceptional writing with sharp analytical thinking to lead brand-building initiatives that operate at global scale. this is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of creative strategy, channel invention, and data-driven decision-making — someone who can draft a compelling creative brief in the morning, pressure-test a measurement framework over lunch, and align a room of cross-functional stakeholders by end of day.key responsibilitiesglobal portfolio strategy. own the end-to-end marketing strategy for amazon's owned and operated channels globally — developing campaigns that reinforce amazon's brand across marketplace priorities (e.g., prime, amazon retail). own creative briefing and guide creative development and timelines through close coordination with creative, operations, and product. drive the strategic roadmap for emerging channels, building the business cases to bring new capabilities from concept through validation to scale.operations, marketing & business integration. this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy and operations. you will partner directly with operational teams to understand fleet deployment schedules, label print and application workflows, packaging specifications, and delivery station logistics — then translate those realities back into marketing plans that are both ambitious and executable. success requires fluency in the operations of the physical channels — you do not need to own these systems, but you must be able to ask the right questions, identify risk, and ensure that marketing commitments match operational capacity.strategic communications & decision framing. write recommendations, stakeholder updates, and strategy documents that are concise, insight-led, and built to drive decisions. translate complex program narratives into clear strategic recommendations that build alignment and move work forward. frame alternatives with specificity — articulate trade-offs, estimate business impact, and distinguish one-way from two-way doors.analytical rigor & measurement. partner with science and operations teams to define campaign measurement frameworks, evaluate performance against target perceptions and high-value actions (hvas), and translate complex data into clear strategic recommendations. conduct performance deep-dives, build learning agendas, and set the strategic measurement priorities for the channel. identify when data is directional versus conclusive and communicate uncertainty with intellectual honesty.cross-functional stakeholder management. lead alignment across a broad stakeholder ecosystem spanning internal amazon teams, creative, legal, science, operations, and global marketing teams. navigate competing priorities, resource constraints, and partner escalations across organizations. serve as the connective backbone between teams — educating cross-functional partners on channel strategy, managing expectations, and driving shared understanding of how the work ladders up.what success looks likewithin 90 days, you have authored or refined the current batch of campaign briefs, established relationships with key cross-functional partners, and developed a point of view on what's working and what needs to change. within six months, you are the person stakeholders seek out when they need a crisp recommendation backed by evidence — and the person the team trusts to put the right words on the page. within a year, you have measurably advanced the strategic position of chariot marketing's brand-building programs and are shaping the roadmap for what comes next.basic qualifications 7+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience experience using data and metrics to drive improvements experience with excel or tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent
