detail.desc: job descriptionas a media relations associate, you'll join the press office and support the j.p. morgan wealth management communications team. the team serves as a liaison to the media, protects the firm's reputation and partners with senior executives to shape their voice and visibility. you will work across the firm to ensure external information is timely, accurate and aligned with approvals and controls. you will also create media materials, help plan events, identify opportunities and manage tracking and reporting.this role plays a critical part in our communications strategy. the team translates complex financial and regulatory topics into clear, relevant messaging for broad audiences. communications professionals on this team advise senior leaders and help drive proactive and reactive media engagement.job responsibilitiesmedia monitoring and reportingidentify relevant media opportunities, reporter activity and industry trendsmonitor media coverage in real time and deliver clear coverage reports and insightsmaintain media trackers, coverage logs and reporter listscontent development and executive supportcreate thorough media briefings and briefing books for announcements, interviews and eventsdraft press releases, media pitches, reactive statements and talking pointssupport message development by conducting research and competitive analysisvisibility and engagementmanage awards and rankings submissions end to end, including timelines, drafting, edits and approvalsidentify and secure external speaking opportunities for executives and coordinate logistics and materialsbuild and maintain relationships with reporters and media partnerscontrols and coordinationpartner with control teams, including legal, compliance and risk, to follow established processes and support appropriate reviews and approvalscoordinate across stakeholders to align timing, facts and messaging before external outreachrequired qualifications, capabilities and skillsminimum 3 years of media relations experiencestrong writing and editing skills, with the ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly and conciselyproven ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively and meet deadlines in a fast-moving environmentstrong stakeholder management skills and a track record of collaborating across teamsability to work independently while contributing effectively in a team environmentstrong organizational skills and high attention to detailbachelor's degree requiredpreferred qualificationsexperience in financial services communications or a strong interest in wealth management and personal financeexperience managing awards and rankings programs, media monitoring and executive speaking opportunitiesabout uschase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of america's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. we also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.we offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. we also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. these benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.we recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. we are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. we also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. visit our faqs for more information about requesting an accommodation.equal opportunity employer/disability/veteransabout the teamour consumer & community banking division serves our chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. we're proud to lead the u.s. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

overviewbeing good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at state farm. it is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. we're moving with urgency to become a next gen good neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. as an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.work arrangements available: remote- fully remote opportunity available for candidates that do not reside near a hub location (listed below).hybrid- a "hybrid" position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in office and from their home. work arrangements could change over time based on business need.hub locations: bloomington il, richardson tx, dunwoody ga, or tempe, azresponsibilitiesresponsibilitiesstate farm is seeking a strategic, experienced, and collaborative director – media & public relations to lead enterprise-wide media relations, earned-media strategy, and external communications within corporate communications. this leader will play a critical role in strengthening state farm's reputation and public presence by shaping proactive media strategies, building relationships with influential media outlets, and identifying opportunities to share state farm's story. the director will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and business leaders, guiding external positioning, high-profile media engagements, and communications strategies that align with enterprise priorities and protect stakeholder trust.responsibilities include:set and lead the enterprise-wide earned-media and public relations strategy, aligning media priorities, audiences, relationship development and outreach with enterprise objectives. build and mature state farm’s enterprise media relations capability, including the operating model, talent, relationship strategy, standards, routines and performance expectations needed to create a proactive, best-in-class function. establish clear ways of working with business area and market area communications teams, ensuring media expertise is integrated into portfolio strategies while maintaining enterprise standards, relationship ownership and flexible surge capacity. personally cultivate and steward priority national and top-tier media relationships, stepping into major engagements where senior involvement can strengthen credibility or outcomes. partner across enterprise narrative, thought leadership, content and channels to translate enterprise priorities into earned-media opportunities and extend stories across the broader communications ecosystemlead the development of a proactive media agenda, identifying compelling stories and opportunities to strengthen state farm's visibility, reputation, and positioning on key industry issues. serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and business leaders on external positioning, high-profile interviews, complex media opportunities, and reputational considerations. provide strategic oversight of enterprise-significant media messaging, spokesperson selection, and response strategies, partnering closely with issues & crisis communications to ensure alignment. leverage media intelligence, industry trends, and performance analytics to inform media strategies, evaluate effectiveness, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. lead and develop media relations talent, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and high performance. qualificationsthe ideal candidate will have:extensive experience in media relations, public relations, corporate communications, or related fields, with a strong background in developing and executing enterprise-wide earned-media strategies. demonstrated experience building and maintaining relationships with national, top-tier, and industry-specific media outlets, including journalists, editors, and influential media stakeholders. proven experience advising c-suite executives and senior business leaders on external positioning, media engagement, high-profile interviews, and sensitive communications. exceptional media relations, writing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives, identify newsworthy opportunities, and communicate complex business topics effectively. strong understanding of reputation management, media intelligence, and the evolving media landscape, with the ability to anticipate emerging issues, navigate media risks, and leverage performance insights to strengthen communications strategies. demonstrated leadership experience guiding media relations teams, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, establishing operational standards, and driving accountability for results. applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the u.s. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for u.s. work authorization (e.g. h-1b visa) for this opportunity***** our benefitsstate farm values work-life balance and offers competitive compensation!potential starting salary range: $173,000 - $260,000starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experiencehigh end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experiencepotential yearly incentive pay with a target of 20% and maximum potential of 30%for los angeles candidates: pursuant to the los angeles fair chance initiative for hiring, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories.for san francisco candidates: pursuant to the san francisco fair chance ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.at state farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!get paid! on top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. stay well! focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. state farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. all medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, and you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!develop and grow! take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. plan ahead! plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/ivf/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. you can also start a savings account or consider financing through our state farm federal credit union!take a little “you” time! you will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. with the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!give back! we offer several ways to give back through our matching gift program, good neighbor grant program, and the employee assistance fund. finish strong! plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. visit our state farm careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the state farm team!

normal computing | build with usnormal is an applied ai company solving the hardest problems in ai and silicon. we build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical ai infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. we work as one team across new york city, silicon valley (mountain view), and london.your role in our missionwe are hiring a media & pr lead to develop the public story of normal inference systems. you will bring the science, engineering and performance of an unfamiliar computing architecture into the public conversation about ai infrastructure and energy.working with researchers and engineers, you will learn the science behind the systems and develop original angles for technical media and broader technology, business and policy audiences. through earned media, alternative media and speaking, you will open opportunities for voices across the company. alongside the hardware, our team communicates normal's frontier applied ai research program, which develops ai methods for silicon design and verification.reporting to the head of communications, you will own media relationships and pr programs, including major announcements, speaking opportunities and partner work. you will carry the public story that colleagues in editorial, technical writing and product marketing develop, and work with social and creative production to plan coverage and amplification around each announcement.responsibilitiesbuild media relationships: develop angles and sustained relationships across technical trades, mainstream media and selected analysts. write tailored pitches, manage incoming requests and own outreach through publication, maintaining an active story pipeline between major announcements.secure public engagements: build and prioritize a pipeline across independent media, podcasts, high-profile public talks, panels and industry forums. match opportunities to expertise across the company and cultivate hosts and organizers. develop speaker proposals and recognition nominations, and manage engagements through preparation and delivery.develop spokespeople: develop public voices and open opportunities for executives, engineers and researchers with distinct expertise and points of view. prepare them for interviews, talks and analyst briefings, working with colleagues on narratives, remarks and supporting materials.run major announcements: lead the pr and public-communications programs for product, research, financing, partnership and company milestone announcements, from planning through launch and follow-up. develop messaging with the head of communications and leadership, craft press releases, and manage stakeholder coordination, approvals, pitching, briefings and embargoes.lead partner pr: develop joint stories and announcement programs grounded in the work and results. coordinate with partner communications and investor pr teams on messaging, timing, approvals, outreach and amplification.prioritize opportunities: recommend where to invest across media, speaking and recognition based on audience fit, business relevance, likely impact and leadership time. follow industry narratives and competitor coverage, using results and coverage quality to improve priorities.prepare press materials: write media kits, briefings, q&a and contributed pieces with leaders and technical experts. anticipate difficult questions and misinterpretations, preparing responses with the head of communications and relevant experts. coordinate with colleagues to have editorial, technical and visual collateral reviewed and ready ahead of major pr pushes.plan amplification: develop remarks and executive posts tied to media, speaking and company milestones. work with social and creative production early on content before and after public engagements and around media coverage, coordinating publication timing and follow-up.what we are looking forexperience: substantial experience in media relations, pr or journalism, with work in deep tech, semiconductors, ai infrastructure or adjacent industries. relevant experience may come from an agency, a newsroom or a company; show us the stories, programs and relationships you personally developed.story and pitch judgment: you can recognize a strong story, develop an original angle and write tailored pitches that earn attention. you understand the editorial interests of the people you approach.program ownership: you have run complex announcements involving leaders and multiple organizations. you can build the plan, develop the materials, coordinate reviews and deliver under external deadlines, while keeping strategic decisions and dependencies clear.technical curiosity: you learn unfamiliar domains quickly, ask useful questions and earn credibility with engineers and researchers. you can explain why a technical result matters while preserving the qualifications that make it accurate.opportunity judgment: you can assess the relative value of an interview, public talk, panel or alternative media appearance, and explain your recommendation in terms of audience, impact and the time required.relationship building: you build productive relationships with journalists, independent media, event organizers and external communications teams. you can navigate competing priorities and sensitive information while keeping joint work moving.original writing: strong work across press releases, contributed articles, speaker proposals and briefing materials. you draw substance out of experts, bring your own thinking and take drafts to near-complete before final review.spokesperson development and voice: you have prepared leaders for public engagements and helped new voices build confidence and a distinct point of view. you can write in another person's voice, drawing out their thinking and retaining the substance of their argument.travel readiness: willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for team meetings, industry conferences, and media engagements as needed.equal employment opportunity statementnormal computing is an equal opportunity employer. we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.accessibility accommodationsnormal computing is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. if you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@normalcomputing.com.privacy noticeby submitting your application, you agree that normal computing may collect, use, and store your personal information for employment-related purposes in accordance with our applicant privacy notice.

multiple clients across complex, fast-moving accounts.extensive, active network of established relationships with top-tier national reporters, editors, producers, and other influential media contacts, job description:about dentsu creativebusiness-driven and creatively obsessed. we are dedicated to helping our clients achieve growth. we understand the challenge of standing out in an increasingly competitive marketplace. we recognize that experiences are becoming indistinguishable across industries, and new technologies can both enable creativity and risk commoditization. in this context, the need for a distinct competitive edge is crucial. we believe that embracing creativity is key for sustainable business growth. however, the conventional definition of creativity will not suffice. our view on creativity goes beyond norms; it’s not just how we execute, but a mindset that permeates our organization and our clients’ businesses. we call it transformative creativity. it’s outcome-focused creativity unleashed to solve business problems. this unique brand of creativity sets us apart and drives our clients to success.about our strategistswe’re proactive leaders. great strategists are proactive and take the initiative to lead teams and clients with new ideas and provocative thoughts. we get ahead of the ask, anticipating the next step and setting the agenda with the energy and optimism it takes to ensure that our work is fresh, our clients feel our partnership, and the team stays ahead of the curve and delivers exceptional ideas.we challenge the status quo. our strategists take pride in challenging the status quo, always seeking fresh angles and leading with innovative ideas. we push past right, to find what is interesting. we challenge assumptions. we generate the energy and enthusiasm needed to help our teams and clients find the next level in an ever-evolving world, embodying a challenger mindset.we’re makers and doers. at every level, from cso to junior planner, our strategists are makers who take pride in creating things, not just managing projects. we hold ourselves to a high standard of creation, putting hands on keyboards and turning ideas into tangible outputs, fostering a culture of hands-on involvement and tangible creativity that make ideas in our heads a reality in the world.we cherish a growth mindset. we value and fuel a growth mindset, encouraging our strategists to be their best and embrace feedback that challenges their thinking and actions. our culture is hard on the work but kind to our people, recognizing that personal growth is key to our agency’s success.we’re radical collaborators. we are radically collaborative, working fluidly across teams and skill sets with the outcome in mind, not personal egos. our strategists know that together we are stronger, actively seeking others’ input to solve problems and elevate the work, fostering a culture of collective excellence.role overviewas a sr. strategist, brand experience strategy, you will report to the group director, brand experience strategy. you will join a team of smart, creative strategists shaping how spirits, alcohol, and non-alcohol brands come to life across retail, restaurant and bar, entertainment, digital, social, experiential and trade. you lead day-to-day strategy on assigned accounts, keep pulse on leading market and consumer trends, turn insight into go-to-market plans, and partner closely with account, creative and analytics teams to make sure great strategy becomes great work in market.support strategy leads to create and drive experience strategies, programs and go-to-market plans that both inspire and drive business for our clientssynthesize signals across data, culture, and category to provide teams a clear point of view – not just information, but interpretation and impact on what we need to do. develop clear, inspiring, evidence-based briefs, povs, brand and program frameworks, and consumer journeyslead smaller strategy projects on assigned accounts, projects, and deliverables with minimal oversightacts as an inspirational and strategic catalyst for our cross-disciplined team of account management, creative, analytics, technology, and productionbuild strong knowledge of the spirits industry and competitive landscapeuses ai to accelerate research synthesis, pressure-test hypotheses and sharpen output quality – keeping human judgment at the forefront as a clear, defensible strategic point of view at the center of every recommendation.  qualifications4+ years developing integrated brand strategies, with some experiential, events, shopper or retail-strategy (or equivalent) experienceexperience in the spirits/alcoholic beverage category preferred; experience in other beverage or cpg categories will also be consideredacts as a catalyst to creative, media, data, account and other brand teams in finding new ways to add value to brand experiences and identifying future opportunitiesdemonstrates the maturity and leadership to be a key player on a collaborative, multi-disciplinary cross-agency teademonstrates proficiency in using and translating all types of data into insights that drive creative thinking and client growthproactively seeks out opportunities to make the work better in a collaborative wayhas a passion for solving problems and is comfortable using ai as a tool to work faster and sharpen thinkinghas built strong relationships with middle-level team members and clients, earning their trust and respectdemonstrates and fosters a collaborative spirit and way of working so ideas can flourish joining our creative communitywe aspire to be the most integrated network in the world for a lot of reasons. a big one is to make sure people always have your back. we don’t want talent to be islands at dentsu creative. we want this to be the place where you can do the work of your life while having a life. this means offering an inclusive culture that embraces individual ways of working - a culture that values compensating employees for their contributions in a multitude of ways. for everything we ask of our people to do right by our clients and creative standards, we commit to giving back equally in investing in your unique career aspirations and learning and development needs. seeing and celebrating our people is where we find joy. when you are a part of our creative network, you get an all-access pass to our global playground. there’s a purposeful, flexible infrastructure for you to jump toward initiatives that excite you in partnership with specialists in entertainment, experience, data, earned attention and more. your voice and unique lived experience are beyond valued. we want you to be loud, raise your hand and leave your imprint on how we continue building our creative culture while shaping what the very future of creativity can be. so, why not choose your own adventure? let us be your springboardadditional informationat dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in chicago, metro detroit, los angeles, and new york city, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two the data infrastructure to herald the ai era for physical systems.about the rolewe’re looking for a senior brand designer to own and evolve sift’s visual identity across digital, print, and physical channels. you’ll turn complex technical concepts into clear, compelling visuals that help engineers and decision-makers understand our platform. this is a hands-on role with significant creative ownership. you’ll work closely with marketing, sales, product, and leadership, and you’ll design and ship visual work from concept through final production.responsibilitiesdesign and ship most of sift’s visual work yourself across website, campaigns, social, presentations, sales collateral, and events, from concept through final production.translate complex technical products and concepts into clear visual narratives, diagrams, illustrations, and product explainers.own and evolve sift’s brand guidelines, ensuring consistency and quality across digital, print, and physical channels.build scalable brand systems, templates, and an organized asset library so marketing and sales can move quickly without sacrificing quality.own projects from concept through final production, gathering stakeholder feedback and balancing creative quality, business priorities, and deadlines.required skills5+ years of professional experience in brand, visual, or marketing design, with a portfolio showing high-quality work across digital, print, and presentation formats.experience designing for b2b technology companies, ideally with complex or technical products.strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, layout, and information hierarchy, with a proven ability to turn technical concepts into clear visuals.proficiency in figma and adobe creative suite, including building brand systems and templates and preparing print-ready files.a track record of working independently as a hands-on designer, managing multiple projects end to end with minimal direction and explaining creative decisions to cross-functional teams.bonus pointsexperience as the sole or first designer at an early-stage startup, including establishing or evolving a brand identity.experience designing for developer tools, infrastructure software, aerospace, defense, robotics, or other technical industries.experience creating technical illustrations, product diagrams, or data visualizations.motion design, animation, or video editing experience (e.g., after effects, premiere pro).experience with webflow, html/css, or other web tools.portfolio required: please include a link to your portfolio or relevant design work. applications without visual work samples will not be considered.location:sift’s headquarters is in marina del rey, ca (next to lax). we collaborate in person twice a week—on mondays and thursdays—and come together for a full week once every quarter. we are open to relocating candidates to la or working from our san francisco office for the right candidate.salary range: $125,000 - $175,000 per year. plus equity and benefits.eligibilityu.s. person required: must be a u.s. citizen, lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with itar (international traffic in arms regulations) / ear (export administration regulations) regulations.

detail.desc: design has always been at the heart of squarespace. from our award-winning super bowl campaigns to the digital experiences that bring our brand to life, our creative team has built a reputation for ambitious ideas, exceptional craft, and work that pushes beyond the expected.we're looking for a senior brand designer to help shape what's next. you'll work across brand campaigns, digital experiences, and content creation, bringing strong conceptual thinking and a refined design sensibility to everything you create.we're actively embracing ai as part of how we think, design, and create. we see emerging technologies as an opportunity to expand creative possibilities and challenge traditional workflows. we're looking for someone who shares that mindset, is already fluent in generative ai tools, and brings the curiosity and initiative to continuously explore what's next, while maintaining the creative judgment and craft that define great design.you’ll get to…lead the design and execution of brand campaigns, digital experiences, social content, and marketing initiatives, maintaining squarespace's high creative standards.develop compelling visual concepts and translate them into distinctive design solutions across multiple channels and formats.collaborate with designers, art directors, producers, and marketing partners to bring ambitious creative ideas to life.create and iterate on performance marketing creative, balancing creative quality with audience engagement and effectiveness.integrate generative ai into the creative process and explore new tools and workflows that expand creative possibilities and elevate the quality of our work.bring a strong point of view on typography, composition, color, imagery, and motion, ensuring a high level of craft and attention to detail.who we’re looking for6+ years of design experience at an agency, studio, or in-house creative team, with a portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking and visual craft.strong expertise in brand design, digital design, typography, art direction, and visual storytelling, with experience taking projects from concept through execution.experience designing across brand campaigns, digital experiences, social media, and marketing channels.exceptional creative judgment, with the ability to evaluate, refine, and art direct both traditional and ai-generated work.proficiency in figma and adobe creative suite, including photoshop, illustrator, and indesign.strong hands-on experience with generative ai tools such as runway, figma weave, midjourney, google gemini, claude, chatgpt, or similar platforms, and an understanding of how different models can enhance creative workflows.a proactive approach to experimenting with emerging technologies, developing new creative processes, and sharing knowledge with the team.strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate creative decisions, navigate feedback, and collaborate effectively across teams.benefits & perksa choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums fertility and adoption benefitsaccess to supplemental insurance plans for additional coverageheadspace mindfulness app subscriptionglobal employee assistance programretirement benefits with employer matchflexible paid time off12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leavepretax commuter benefiteducation reimbursementemployee donation match to community organizations7 global employee resource groups (ergs)dog-friendly workplacefree lunch and snacksprivate rooftophack week twice per yearcash compensation range: $105,500 - $170,200 usdthe base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.in addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. sales positions generally offer a competitive on target earnings (ote) incentive structure in addition to base salary.about squarespacesquarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. we empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with acuity and creating and managing social media presence with bio sites and unfold. our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in new york city, with offices in dublin, ireland, and aveiro, portugal. for more information about our company, visit https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers.our commitmenttoday, more than a million people around the globe use squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. at squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.thank you in advance for providing the following details about your work history from your resume! this helps us ensure that your candidate information is accurate and consistent during the hiring process.squarespace will never solicit your personal banking information or ask you to transfer money in connection with a job offer or interview. we also will not reach out to you via phone or sms without your permission or knowledge.if you plan to use ai in any capacity during your candidate journey, please review our candidate ai policy.

about gustoat gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. we handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and hr — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. with teams in denver, san francisco, and new york, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.all full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (rsus) — because everyone who helps build gusto should share in its success. offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. learn more about our total rewards philosophy.ai is a fundamental part of how work gets done at gusto. we expect all team members to actively engage with ai tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. ai experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.about the rolebrand design is how gusto earns trust, builds recognition and familiarity, and makes people feel something before they ever read a word. our brand is about how we show up in every moment, and this team owns some of its most important attributes, from how we use language to typography, from color and composition to illustration and layout. these aren't finishing touches. they're critical to how we show who we are and why we're different.we're looking for a brand designer who is a hands-on maker: someone who loves the craft of visual design, takes real ownership of creative output end to end (from concept through the actual production tools) and wants to help define how gusto looks and feels across formats. this is a senior individual contributor role focused on brand craft, production fluency, and the kind of deeply considered visual work that makes a b2b brand feel genuinely human.about the teamdesign at gusto is made up of over 80 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees. we're a cross-functional group that is always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use gusto. we don't care much about swim lanes and though we care deeply about quality and craft, we are never precious about it. we work closely with cross-functional partners in product, engineering, data, and marketing to design, build, and ship experiences that make a real difference. we believe great design can make hard things possible, even delightful.we are building an ai-native design organization, and we mean that seriously. we're looking for designers who are already working this way: using ai to prototype ideas quickly, shorten customer feedback loops, and ship quality ux directly to customers. this isn't a future aspiration: it's how we work now, and it's changing what the design role looks like at gusto and across the industry.gusto is expanding our in-house creative studio inside a fast-moving, late-stage startup. we launch products, educate customers, run brand campaigns, and show up at events, and we do all of it with a consistent visual language and voice that needs to work across web, print, digital channels, and everything in between. in the same week, you might be designing a landing page for a product launch and building a direct-mail campaign that ships to thousands of small businesses.here's what you'll do day-to-daydesign and execute visual work across product launches, product education, brand campaigns, events, mailers, and digital channelsbuild directly in production tools (figma, cms platforms like contentful, indesign), taking work from comp to shipped assetpartner closely with marketing, product, and growth teams from early concept through final delivery, often on tight timelinesdirect and evaluate ai-generated creative work, setting the standard for what's on-brand and what shouldn't shipuse ai tools to compress the distance between concept and execution, iterating faster and raising the quality barbuild repeatable templates and components that enable faster turnaround without sacrificing qualitymaintain brand integrity across a wide range of deliverables (including work where ai tools played a role in production), ensuring everything feels cohesive, human, and unmistakably gustohere's what we're looking for6+ years of experience in brand or graphic design for in-house studios, agencies, or content teamsa portfolio that demonstrates strong visual craft and range across web, print, campaigns, and digital content, including examples where you can speak to the role ai played in the workstrong design instincts across typography, color, composition, and layout: you know what makes work feel distinctive versus genericcomfort working hands-on in production tools (figma, cms platforms, adobe creative cloud/indesign), not just handing off compsa demonstrated point of view on ai in creative work: how to direct it, when to override it, and what it means to maintain a high creative standard when ai tools are part of the processcomfort moving between big, brand-defining work and fast-turn executional needs, and a maker mindset: you enjoy improving how work gets made, not just making the work itselfstrong collaboration skills across creative, production, marketing, and product partnersif you're energized by being close to the work, care deeply about craft & taste, and enjoy improving both the output and the process, this role will be an excellent fit.compensationour cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $147,000 - $174,000/yr in denver and most remote locations, and $178,000 - $211,000/yr for san francisco and new york. final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.at gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. engineering, design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "head of x" instead of a rank word like "director" that tells you neither. because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. if you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.gusto has physical office spaces in denver, san francisco, and new york city. employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). the same office expectations apply to all symmetry roles, gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in scottsdale.note: the san francisco office expectations encompass both the san francisco and san jose metro areas.when approved to work from a location other than a gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. this includes non-office days for hybrid employees.reliable, consistent presence: we expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. we hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. if you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at gusto.gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. we do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. we want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. if you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. please review our fraudulent activity disclaimer.personal information collected and processed as part of your gusto application will be subject to gusto's applicant privacy notice.

typography, motion design, marketing campaign design, ai-driven creative workflowscompensation: $160,000–$180,000 annually, plus equity and performance-based bonus. final compensation depends on experience.about the rolea senior brand designer is needed to lead the evolution of a financial planning platform's visual identity, creative direction, and brand storytelling across digital experiences. the role owns the development and consistent expression of the brand across websites, marketing campaigns, social media, product interfaces, and motion design. working directly with founders and executive leadership, this position shapes the brand's long-term creative vision while ensuring a cohesive, approachable experience for people making important financial decisions.this position combines hands-on visual design with the development of scalable brand systems, creative templates, production workflows, and ai-assisted design pipelines. the successful candidate will partner with marketing and product teams to create distinctive brand experiences, maintain design consistency, improve creative production efficiency, and connect design decisions to measurable marketing and business outcomes.what you'll dolead the evolution of the brand's visual identity, creative direction, and brand storytelling across web, social media, product experiences, and motion design.partner directly with founders and executive leadership to shape the long-term brand vision and guide its visual expression across customer touchpoints.develop and maintain scalable brand design systems, creative workflows, tools, and templates that ensure consistent visual identity across generated assets.collaborate with the marketing team to establish creative directions, design marketing campaigns, and deliver brand assets that support marketing objectives.participate in creative testing and optimization, using marketing performance data and business outcomes to refine design approaches.work closely with product designers and cross-functional teams to deliver a cohesive brand experience throughout the digital platform.co-create, improve, and maintain brand and product design systems that support consistent design execution across human-led and ai-assisted workflows.integrate ai tools into creative ideation, visual exploration, asset production, and design workflows to accelerate delivery without compromising originality or quality.develop ai-driven creative pipelines that enable scalable brand asset production while preserving established visual standards and brand consistency.apply strong creative judgment, design expertise, and critical thinking to refine ai-generated work and maintain a distinctive visual identity.use customer empathy and attention to detail to strengthen brand expression and create a more human, trustworthy, and accessible financial planning experience.maintain high standards for visual craftsmanship, brand storytelling, and creative quality across all delivered design assets.qualificationsrequired experience7+ years of professional experience in brand design, including substantial in-house experience at product-focused companies.demonstrated experience owning brand creative direction and leading at least one rebrand or significant brand evolution from initial concept through implementation and rollout.a strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design craftsmanship across typography, layout, color, and motion design.proven experience creating, scaling, maintaining, or evolving comprehensive brand identity systems.hands-on experience integrating ai into creative workflows, including ideation, design exploration, asset production, or production pipelines, supported by completed and delivered work.experience collaborating directly with founders, executives, marketing teams, product teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders in fast-moving startup environments.experience connecting creative work to marketing experimentation, performance metrics, and business results.required skillsadvanced expertise in brand identity design, visual storytelling, and creative direction across digital and product-focused experiences.strong command of typography, composition, layout, color systems, and motion design, demonstrated through professional portfolio work.ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable brand systems, creative templates, and workflows that ensure consistent visual execution.ability to align brand identity with product design systems and maintain a cohesive visual experience across websites, marketing channels, and digital products.practical knowledge of ai-assisted creative production, including where automation improves efficiency and where human creative judgment remains essential.ability to evaluate marketing tests and creative performance, incorporate findings into design decisions, and refine work based on measurable outcomes.strong creative judgment, customer empathy, and attention to visual detail throughout the design and production process.ability to independently guide creative initiatives, manage multiple design responsibilities, and take ownership of brand-related outcomes in a startup environment.interest in creating accessible, human-centered brand experiences that help people feel informed and confident when making financial decisions.preferred qualificationsprevious brand design experience in fintech or other industries where customer trust is especially important.

title: brand designerlocation: remote, us-onlyabout inmarketsince 2010, inmarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today’s top brands. through inmarket's data-driven marketing platform, brands can build targeted audiences, activate media in real time, and measure success in driving return on ad spend. inmarket's proprietary moments offering outperforms traditional mobile advertising by 6x.* our lci attribution platform, which won the martech breakthrough award for best advertising measurement platform, was validated by forrester to drive an average of $40 roas for our clients.source: wordstream us google display benchmarks for mobile mediaabout the roleare you a designer with a strong point of view and a great eye for brand? inmarket’s marketing team is looking for a brand designer to help shape and evolve how our brand looks and feels across every touchpoint. we’re looking for someone who understands what makes a brand feel distinctive, polished, and consistent: from typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy to the details that bring a brand system to life. you’ll help develop inmarket’s visual identity and apply it across marketing campaigns, digital experiences, sales materials, events, social, and other customer-facing experiences. this is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking a concept from idea to execution, building thoughtful visual systems, and finding creative ways to make a brand stand out in a b2b environment. you’ll work closely with marketing, content, product, and sales to translate ideas into strong visual experiences.we’re also an ai-forward company and are looking for designers who are curious about how ai can improve creative workflows, systems, and experimentation. you don’t need to be an adtech expert on day one. you do need to be a strong designer, curious, collaborative, and excited to build and evolve a brand.your daily impact as a brand designerhelp evolve and strengthen inmarket’s visual identity across channels and customer touchpoints.develop visual concepts and creative systems for marketing campaigns, launches, and brand initiatives.create polished, on-brand creative across digital, social, web, sales, events, and other marketing channels.design landing pages, presentations, one-pagers, sales collateral, event materials, and other customer-facing experiences.develop and maintain brand guidelines, templates, design systems, and reusable visual assets.bring consistency and a strong visual point of view to how inmarket shows up across the business.partner with content, product, sales, and marketing to translate ideas, messaging, and business priorities into compelling visual concepts.take projects from initial concept through final execution, balancing creativity with business objectives.help establish creative standards and improve the quality and consistency of work produced across the organization.explore new creative formats, tools, and ai-enabled workflows that make design work more efficient and effective.your experience & expertise2–4 years of experience in brand design, graphic design, marketing design, or a related field.a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design, brand thinking, and attention to detail.strong understanding of typography, color, composition, visual hierarchy, layout, and brand systems.experience applying a brand identity consistently across multiple channels and formats.experience designing marketing materials such as websites/landing pages, presentations, sales collateral, campaigns, or event materials.strong conceptual thinking and the ability to turn a brief or business objective into a clear visual direction.comfortable taking ownership of projects from concept through execution with minimal hand-holding.experience working within or helping develop brand guidelines, templates, and design systems.experience with ai tools as part of your creative workflow, or a genuine interest in building ai-enabled design processes.experience with social content, motion/video, or digital design is a plus.experience with adtech, martech, saas, data, media, or technology is a plusfamiliarity with tools such as figma, adobe creative suite, or similar design platforms.benefits summarycompetitive salary, stock options, flexible vacationmedical, dental, and flexible spending account (fsa)company matched 401(k)unlimited pto (within reason)talented co-workers and managementagile development program (for continued learning/professional development)paid paternity & maternity leavefor candidates in california, colorado, and new york city, illinois, minnesota, new jersey, vermont and massachusetts the targeted base salary range for this role is $80,000 -$90,000.actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to work experience, specialized skills and training, performance in role, business needs, and job requirements. base salary is subject to change and may be modified in the future. base salary is just one component of inmarket’s total rewards package that also may include bonus, equity, and benefits. ask your recruiter for more information!at inmarket, diversity is not just a value, it’s the very essence of who we are. it’s about recognizing and celebrating the unique perspectives each of us brings, from our colleagues to the communities we serve.we are committed to embracing the full spectrum of backgrounds, beliefs, abilities, and life experiences, knowing that this diversity strengthens us. at inmarket, our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion means valuing each individual’s unique contributions. together, we thrive.inmarket is an equal opportunity employer (eoe). qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

about us:live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. to fulfill gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.with platforms on ios, android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the us and canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.about gametimegametime is a mobile-first marketplace for last-minute tickets to live sports, music and theater in more than 50 cities across the u.s. and canada. we exist to bring people together through great live experiences, the once-in-a-lifetime moments fans remember. we're a profitable, growing company, and we're building the creative engine to match our ambition.about the rolewe're looking for a senior strategist who turns culture and insight into creative briefs, and turns good creative into “great.”gametime's creative team is evolving from static-first, conversion-only paid social production to a full-funnel and multi-channel mandate that includes paid social, but also: crm, tv, product visual merchandising, creator content, organic social and more. our brand & growth marketing partners set brand and channel strategy. our creatives direct and make the work. you sit in the middle, translating a brand brief into a creative brief sharp enough to make the work better, or bringing the cultural insight that keeps both brand and performance creative relevant to fans of sports, music and theater.this is a senior individual contributor role with no permanent direct reports, though you'll guide freelance strategists when we need extra capacity. you'll report to the vp of creative and work across creative that maps to both growth and brand marketing.what you'll ownyou'll be accountable for three key outcomes. your point of view shapes how you get there. creative briefs that make the work bettertranslate brand and marketing briefs into creative briefs that give creatives a sharp idea and a clear territory.own and evolve our creative brief process, and set the standard for what a good brief looks like at gametime.stay with the work from first brief to final cut, giving clear strategic feedback that holds the work to the idea.close the loop: write up what we learn from the work in market so it makes the next brief better. strategy for platforms and initiatives where we don't yet know what good looks likedevelop the creative strategy for new and high-potential platforms across the marketing org, such as ctv, spotify and audio, reddit and podcasts, with a clear view of what native creative looks like on each.partner with channel leads, who own buying and targeting, so that creative approach and media plan are built together.dig into initiatives where we want to raise the creative bar (i.e. creator-led content) and define what "better" means before we scale it.design light-touch research or tests that tell us what's working and write up what we learn. cultural insight that serves both brand and performancebe our radar for what's happening in sports, music and theater fandom, and how fans talk, share and buy.synthesize audience data, social listening, qualitative research and performance signals into a point of view on who our fans are and what moves them.surface cultural insights and creative territories that brand creative and performance creative can both use.partner with growth, brand marketing, and finance to connect creative strategy to business outcomes.you'll also lead and guide freelance strategists when projects need extra capacity, setting the brief standard they work to, and you'll be one of several mentors for junior creatives on the team, sharing the craft of strategy.what success looks likeby month 6 the brief is a tool people rely on; by month 12 our new platforms have clear answers.whenwhat's truefirst 90 daysyou've taken over the creative brief process, shipped briefs for live work, and met the creative, brand marketing, growth and channel partners you'll work with most. you've reviewed what we've already made and proposed the first platform or initiative to take on, agreed with the vp of creative and growth.by 6 monthsa creative brief standard is in use, and creative directors say it helps. strategy for at least two new platforms is in market with first tests running and learnings written up. you've defined what better ugc looks like and how we'll get there. a recurring rhythm for cultural insight is in place, and both brand and performance creative use it.by 12 monthsa brand campaign has been briefed end to end with you. at least one new platform has moved from experiment to a clear decision to scale or stop, with the reasoning. creative made from your briefs shows measurable lift against baseline in testing. creative directors and channel leads point to the briefs as a reason the work got better.what you bringwe'd rather you meet these four fully than half-meet twelve.taste and cultural judgment. 10+ years in creative strategy at an agency, a consumer brand, or a media, music, sports or entertainment company. you can show where your insight changed the idea, and you can tell a platform-native idea from a repurposed ad.briefs that people use. you write clear, sharp creative briefs that creatives want to work from, and you can walk us from brief to work to result.you bridge brand and performance. you're comfortable with metrics, creative testing and the language of a growth team, and equally comfortable pitching a brand idea.ai amplifies your thinking and never replaces it. you use ai for tasks like synthesis, trend scanning and pressure-testing, but the point of view is your own. bonusexperience with strategy across formats and channels (i.e. ctv, audio and podcast, social)experience with creator-led creative strategybackground in live entertainment, sports, music, theater, ticketing or marketplacesexperience mentoring junior talent or directing freelance strategists, with or without formal reportsthe realitythis is a broad senior role with no permanent direct reports, so your influence comes from the quality of your thinking. you'll work with several creative leads, channel leads and brand marketing partners, and you'll need to build trust and clear decision rights with each.brand campaigns take priority when work competes for your time, and priorities will move as our marketing org evolves. some of the platforms you'll take on are new to us, so you'll be setting the playbook as much as following one. the creative brief process is yours detail.desc: about prepass & prepass safety allianceprepass® is a leading provider of innovative transportation solutions that help commercial fleets operate more efficiently, safely, and confidently. through intelligent weigh station bypassing, toll management, and compliance solutions, we help fleets reduce administrative complexity, improve operational performance, and keep drivers moving.prepass safety alliance, the nonprofit provider of prepass, is a public-private partnership that brings together representatives from state transportation agencies, commercial vehicle enforcement, and the trucking industry. through this collaboration, members identify shared priorities and help shape policies and programs that advance commercial vehicle safety and highway efficiency.together, prepass and prepass safety alliance combine industry expertise, technology, and public-private collaboration to address real challenges facing commercial transportation and deliver meaningful value to the fleets, drivers, and communities that depend on our nation's highways.position summarythe senior manager, public policy & member communications will lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategic communications supporting public policy priorities across the prepass enterprise and member engagement for prepass safety alliance. this role will strengthen how prepass communicates its policy positions and public affairs activities, while helping the alliance inform and engage its members, and convey the value of its public-private partnership in advancing commercial motor vehicle safety and efficiency.reporting to the vice president of government & external affairs, the senior manager will translate complex policy issues, legislative and regulatory developments, grant awards, and related initiatives into clear, timely, and compelling communications. working under the vice president's direction, the role will help shape messaging and serve as the lead writer for enterprise-wide public policy issues and alliance member communications, including member updates, statements and releases, original articles, policy briefs, talking points, executive remarks, newsletters, social media posts, and other content for cross-functional stakeholders.working closely with the vice president, the senior manager will help build the alliance's member communications function, including the channels, tools, and processes needed to keep members informed and connected. the role will assess alliance member communications needs, develop recommendations for the leadership team to review, and implement agreed-upon approaches. in coordination with colleagues who manage member relationships, the senior manager will lead content development, establish a regular communications cadence, and support opportunities for member feedback and participation.the senior manager will also maintain the enterprise-wide public policy editorial calendar and coordinate it with marketing's calendar to support integrated planning and visibility across functions. this will include incorporating planned public affairs activities and content deliverables while maintaining flexibility to respond to emerging legislative, regulatory, and other policy developments.the senior manager will partner with marketing colleagues on design, production, and distribution of content while retaining primary responsibility for the substance, messaging, and writing of prepass public policy and alliance member communications, subject to the vice president's direction and review. internal communications support may be provided across the enterprise as it relates to policy priorities and alliance member activities.this role is well suited for a strong writer and detail.desc: descriptionamazon is seeking a driven and strategic senior communications manager to lead communications for the kindle, tablets, and amazon kids+ businesses within devices & services. this role will lead pr strategy and execution for product launches, proactive storytelling, and thought leadership across our reading, tablet, and kids’ devices portfolio.this is not solely a product launch role—the expectation is that the candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining strategies that keep these products and services visible year-round, well beyond individual launch moments. in this role, you will define and own end-to-end pr strategy and execution across kindle, tablets, and amazon kids+ product launches, ensuring coordinated messaging across all channels while developing proactive media campaigns that position these businesses as leaders in reading, entertainment, and kids’ digital experiences.key job responsibilitiesdefine and own the end-to-end pr/earned communications strategy and roadmap for kindle, tablets, and amazon kids+, including product launches proactive programs that keep these products visible beyond launch moments.build and run a prolific program for that drives consistent coverage, with a steady drumbeat of proactive stories, announcements, and opportunities tailored to each business and its audiences.build and maintain relationships with key technology, consumer electronics, lifestyle, education, and family media contacts (across press, creators and influencers), driving coverage of amazon’s role in reading, entertainment and family-friendly technology.develop communications platforms, campaigns and thought leadership programs that highlight new technologies and illustrate device/service capabilities.craft narratives that make complex product innovations accessible and compelling to media, creators and customers.build trust with cross-functional (and geographically dispersed) partners, including product, engineering, marketing, and executive leadership teams up to the vp and svp level.serve as the senior communications counsel for the business and product teams, providing clear recommendations on messaging, risk and trade-offs.develop integrated communications strategies that align with business objectives and product roadmaps.manage internal and external resources as needed, holding a high bar for measurable outcomes and media impact.basic qualifications 10+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership proven track record of securing high-impact media coverage in top-tier technology, consumer, and lifestyle publications. demonstrated ability to develop strategic communications plans that drive business results. experience serving as a trusted communications advisor to senior, executive-level leaders. extreme proactivity—a desire to drive campaigns and storytelling, outside of launch moments.preferred qualifications bachelor's degreeamazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.our inclusive culture please contact your recruiting partner.the base salary range for this position is listed below. your amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (rsus). final compensation summary: this position is assigned to the marketing branch of the non-appropriated fund (naf) fleet and family readiness support services department of fleet and family readiness program (ffr), commander, navy region northwest. the purpose is to develop, execute and evaluate marketing plans and strategies, as well as provide comprehensive informational materials that inform appropriate audiences and targeted groups of the regional and/or installation-specific programs, services and activities.dutiesserves as a marketing and publicity expert. provides advice to ffr program and facility managers regarding most efficient and cost-effective marketing and publicity to meet program goals and objectives. communicates regularly with customers and marketing staff to ensure draft work receives approval of the requestor, deadlines are met, and organization goals are accomplished. responsible for the development of marketing plans and production of marketing campaigns to enhance and promote programs from inception to completion. uses established real-world marketing practices, marketing analysis, data research and tabulation to initiate and complete plans. utilizes and maintains a working knowledge of marketing tools to publicize and encourage patronage/use of programs and facilities through strategic deployment of advertising campaigns that may include, but are not limited to: email, websites, presentations, social media, speeches, publications, official message traffic, banners, printed materials, and other promotional means. coordinates written and verbal communications for a wide variety of media including military newspapers, newsletters, websites, social media platforms and electronic and static marquees. coordinates production of publicity materials and distribution of materials. ensures all u.s. navy public affairs policies are strictly followed. prepares graphic requests and reviews submissions from programs for accuracy, viability and pertinence to program objectives. liaisons with the regional graphics department to ensure work is performed in a timely manner and within budget constraints. serves as proofreader to ensure quality of product produced for promotion of ffr programs. assists with coordination of special events, to include family fests, holiday programs, athletic events/runs, grand openings, concerts, and other events. coordinates resources in support of the event including graphics requests, marketing support and giveaways. interfaces with program managers to create a successful event. ensures photography support for events both on and off station. develops and revises visual presentations that include photography, scripting and formatting, which are utilized to promote site activities to commands. provides visibility for ffr programs and disseminates information by making presentations to individuals or groups regarding facilities, services, programs and special events. keeps regional marketing director apprised of project status, workload condition and departmental concerns. prepares purchase orders and statements of work in compliance with accounting standards for departmental and event-related purchases. maintains computer files in accordance with department standards for all completed work, including photographs. drives government vehicles to events, facilities and meetings. performs other related duties as assigned.qualificationsa bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, public relations or related field, one year marketing experience and knowledge of navy fleet and family readiness required, or a minimum of five years' work experience in marketing is required without a degree. knowledge evidenced by experience and education in marketing, public relations, communications, journalism, business administration or related field to design, plan, implement and evaluate goal-oriented marketing and public relations campaigns. knowledge of all phases of marketing and communications, including knowledge of principles, methods, practices, trends and techniques. knowledge of proper grammar, spelling and standard writing styles. knowledge of the ffr mission and the purpose of various ffr activities. skill in the use of microsoft office programs (e.g., word, excel, power point, outlook). skill in using a personal computer (pc) and mobile devices with various software programs (e.g., web content management systems, evolving social media platforms). ability to conceptualize and recommend advertising methods from written and verbal instructions. ability to gather and effectively organize information. ability to effectively work as a team member supporting different positions within the department. ability to analyze business needs and develop marketing plans in a fast- paced environment. ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. education: a degree from an accredited college or university with a course of study in marketing, public relations, communications, journalism, business administration or related field. (see qualifications section for guidance on experience in lieu of education).

camaraderie.other duties as assigned.qualifications2-3 years of experience in integrated communications/pr, preferably in an agency setting and/or within an applicable industry. understanding of communications workflows.proficiency with microsoft office suite (particularly outlook, word, sharepoint, powerpoint, and excel) and experience using ai tools like copilot.preferred defenders have. together, these shifts represent the biggest change in cybersecurity in a generation.amazon web services (aws) is investing to lead through that shift. we have long set the standard delivering a portfolio of ai-powered enterprise security services that use ai and autonomous agents to help defenders work at machine speed.this role sits at the center of that work. as a senior product marketing manager (pmm) for aws security and identity, you will help define how aws talks about both a key domain in securing ai and/or using ai to secure, and own the category narrative for a campaigns.basic qualifications knowledge of and experience with cloud infrastructure technologies experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences bachelor's degree in
