marks, part of the propelis group, marks is a consumer experience agency creating engaging moments across the entire brand spectrum—from brand design and packaging, to content and consumer connections. we are a collaborative global network of 1,900+ team members across 25+ studios and 20+ countries, partnering with some of the world’s most recognized brands to solve complex business challenges through design, strategy, and craft.this is a hybrid role based in chicago or cincinnati.about the teamwe're a multidisciplinary team of thinkers, designers, and makers who create brands that stand out, connect with people, and thrive in the real world.our work spans brand creation, visual identity, packaging design, and connected brand experiences across a diverse range of industries and categories. we bring together strategy, creativity, and craft to solve complex challenges, challenge conventions, and create work that is as intelligent as it is beautiful.we believe in big ideas, bold thinking, and the power of exceptional design to transform brands.about the rolewe're looking for an exceptional creative designer with big ideas, impeccable taste, and the craft to bring both to life.as a senior designer, you'll help imagine and create distinctive brand identities and packaging systems for some of the world's most exciting brands. from building a brand from the ground up to reimagining an established icon, you'll turn strategic insights into compelling creative concepts that are original, meaningful, and beautifully executed.you're a conceptual thinker and a passionate maker. you can dream up an unexpected creative territory, develop it into a cohesive visual identity, and bring it to life through packaging that commands attention. you think beyond individual designs to create flexible brand systems with the potential to live across multiple products, formats, and consumer touchpoints.you also understand that great ideas need to work in the real world. you bring the technical knowledge and production awareness to balance creative ambition with practical realities, without compromising the strength of the idea.you'll collaborate with creative leaders, strategists, and multidisciplinary teams, bringing your own perspective, curiosity, and creative energy to every challenge.what you'll doconcept development & creative explorationgenerate bold, original creative concepts grounded in brand strategy, consumer insights, and cultural relevance. explore multiple creative territories, challenging conventions and pushing beyond the expected. translate abstract ideas into compelling visual expressions through sketching, experimentation, and design exploration. bring a strong creative point of view, contributing ideas that elevate the work and inspire the team. take ownership of creative assignments, developing ideas from initial exploration through refined design solutions. brand identity & packaging designcreate distinctive visual identities and packaging design systems across a wide range of brands, categories, and industries. develop cohesive brand worlds through typography, color, imagery, graphic language, and visual storytelling. design packaging that balances standout shelf presence, intuitive navigation, and compelling brand expression. think beyond individual products to build flexible, scalable systems across portfolios, tiers, formats, and touchpoints. extend brand identities into broader consumer experiences while maintaining consistency and creative integrity. design craft & executiondemonstrate exceptional craft across typography, composition, color, layout, and visual hierarchy. bring ideas to life through beautifully considered design, mockups, visualizations, and presentation materials. refine concepts with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every element strengthens the overall idea. balance creative exploration with disciplined execution, maintaining quality from early concepts through final design development. build organized, technically sound files that support efficient collaboration and downstream production. technical & production awarenessapply a strong understanding of packaging structures, dielines, substrates, printing processes, and production constraints. consider how materials, finishes, and structural design can enhance the creative idea. develop concepts that are ambitious yet achievable, anticipating potential production challenges early. collaborate with adaptive design, production, engineering, and cgi specialists to ensure creative intent translates successfully into reality. understand when to push technical boundaries and when to adapt an idea to meet practical requirements. presentation & visual storytellingdevelop compelling creative presentations that communicate the strength and thinking behind design concepts. build clear, engaging visual narratives that take audiences from strategic insight to creative solution. articulate design rationale with confidence, clarity, and conviction. participate in internal and client presentations, contributing thoughtful perspectives and responding constructively to feedback. use storytelling, visualization, and presentation craft to make ideas tangible, exciting, and persuasive. collaboration, curiosity & innovationcollaborate closely with creative directors, design directors, strategy, and multidisciplinary creative teams. contribute actively to brainstorms, critiques, and creative working sessions. stay curious about design, culture, emerging brands, materials, and technologies. explore new tools, including ai-assisted creative workflows, to expand possibilities and accelerate exploration without compromising originality or craft. share inspiration, knowledge, and creative discoveries that elevate the work and the team. what success looks likeyou consistently bring fresh, compelling ideas that elevate the creative ambition of the work. your designs demonstrate exceptional originality, craft, and strategic relevance. you create brand identities and packaging systems that are distinctive, cohesive, and built to scale. your concepts are both imaginative and grounded in an understanding of real-world production. creative leaders trust you to independently develop strong ideas and carry them through to exceptional execution. you make the team stronger through your creativity, collaboration, and passion for design. you bring7+ years of experience in brand identity, packaging design, or a related creative discipline, ideally within a leading design agency or creative studio. an exceptional portfolio demonstrating original thinking, outstanding design craft, and the ability to create distinctive brand identities and packaging systems. proven experience developing creative concepts from strategic foundations through design execution. strong expertise in typography, composition, visual identity, and brand systems. experience designing across diverse industries, categories, and brand types. solid knowledge of packaging structures, materials, printing processes, and production requirements. advanced proficiency in adobe creative suite, particularly illustrator, photoshop, and indesign. strong visualization and presentation skills, including keynote or powerpoint. confidence communicating creative ideas and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. curiosity about emerging creative tools, technologies, and new approaches to design. the ideal personis a big thinker and an exceptional maker. someone whose ideas are as impressive as their execution. has a distinctive creative point of view, impeccable design instincts, and a genuine passion for the craft. loves the challenge of creating something entirely new as much as reimagining something familiar. can move effortlessly between different industries, aesthetics, and creative challenges. thinks in brand systems, not just beautiful individual executions. understands the practical realities of packaging without letting them limit creative ambition. is curious, resourceful, collaborative, and always looking for ways to make the work better. takes pride in creating work that surprises, inspires, and stands apart. about propelis: propelis is a portfolio of global marketing services and technology companies with a combined legacy of 150+ years, 2,000+ clients, 9,000 employees, and operations across 30 countries. propelis provides the scale and support of a global organization while preserving the unique culture and identity of each company in its portfolio.for more information visit: www.makemarks.comeeo statement: we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. we offer equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. equal opportunity employer minorities/women/veterans/disabled.we strive to make our employment website and application process accessible to all users and applicants. in doing so, we provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. if you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation or assistance completing the application process, please contact a member of our human resource team at globalhroperations@propelis.comour compensation reflects the cost of labor across several u.s. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. the u.s. pay range for this position is $75,000 usd - $78,000 usd annually. ultimately, in determining pay, we will consider the successful candidate’s location, experience, and other job-related factors.group benefits currently include a selection of health care plans with prescription detail.desc: overviewbrand strategy center of excellence | pepsico design center, new york (hybrid)about the rolewe’re looking for a curious, insight-led brand strategy director to help shape the future of our brands across food and beverage, including icons like gatorade, pepsi, cheetos, and lay’s. you’ll work with senior marketing leaders and design leaders on the big questions that come first. where should a brand go next? what do people really want from it? what does the category keep missing? what is culture telling us that we haven’t heard yet?you’ll bring together people, culture, the category, and the brand. working with our marketing and insights partners, you’ll dig into consumer, category, and cultural research to find the real tension, the thing people want that the brand or the category isn’t giving them yet. then you’ll connect it to what the brand stands for and can credibly own, and turn it into an opportunity, a strategy, and a story. that could be a positioning, a portfolio architecture, a set of distinctive brand assets, or a brief that marketing and design can build from. marketing owns the brands and the creative, and design leads the design work. you make both sharper by getting the thinking right up front, and you stay with the work until it ships.some projects get a full discovery, and others are fast, focused sprints. many cross markets, and you’ll often work with agency and research partners. you’ll help leaders who start in different places get to one direction, with clear recommendations they can act on.in a typical week, you might frame a brief with a marketing lead, work through new research with insights, and run a positioning workshop with a cross-functional team. you’ll report to the head of brand strategy.about the teampepsico’s design center is our in-house design group. more than 300 designers, strategists, and makers work across brand, packaging, product, experience, and licensing. the brand strategy center of excellence is a newer team inside it. we sit in the design center so the thinking up front and the design work that follows are built together. you’ll join a proven group and help build a new capability inside it.responsibilitieswhat you’ll do frame the question. help brand leaders define the core question before anyone looks for answers. find the tension. dig into consumer, category, and cultural research with insights, and decide what we need to learn and how. turn insight into opportunity. translate what you find into growth opportunities, a clear brand idea, positioning, and strategic direction. tell the story. write briefs and narratives that make senior leaders believe and give marketing and design a sharp place to start. stay with the work. partner with design directors from brief to launch so the strategy shows up in what we make. help teams think better. build simple tools and run workshops that help teams ask better questions. align the room. bring marketing, design, and senior leaders to one direction, and make it clear who owns what. work with partners. guide agencies and research partners, and keep the work moving across markets.qualificationswhat you bringmust have qualifications 8+ years in brand strategy, planning, or insights-led strategy, at a brand, an agency, or a consulting firm. a proven track record of turning insight into strategy. you’ve built brand strategies and positioning, and you can point to a project where a tension you found changed the strategy, the work, or the business. experience working side by side with designers and creatives, turning strategy into briefs that lead to great design. a learning obsession. you love getting smart fast: desktop research, trend and cultural scans, competitive audits, and conversations with people who know the category. you know which source or method fits which question. deep skill in consumer, category, and cultural insight, and in what makes a brand distinctive. you can spot a real tension in the data and in culture, then connect it to what a brand can own. storytelling that moves people. you make complex ideas feel simple and have told a story that got senior leaders to act. initiative. you start without a playbook and keep making progress when things are unclear. experience building something new, like a practice, a process, or a way of working, and an understanding of how large companies get things done. influence without owning the decision. you build trust with senior marketing and design leaders, align people with different goals, and bring a clear recommendation, not just options.location : new york, ny | hybridthis role requires three days per week in the new york office and approximately 10% travel.nice to have experience designing and leading qualitative or quantitative research. background in cultural strategy, semiotics, or design research. experience in consumer-facing branding. experience working across global markets and cultures.what you’ll get real influence on brands people love, with access to senior leaders. a seat inside an award-winning design organization. room to help shape a newer rolehello hello -- 👋 kyle here. i lead marketing at conversion, and up until now i've also somehow been the person responsible for all of our brand work. every logo variation, every deck, every launch page, every color and kerning our typeface. it has been an absolute blast but unfortunately i'm drowning in work and have to let this go.so, now i'm hiring a brand designer. someone who owns our visual identity top to bottom and builds our design system at scale.this will be the person who decides what conversion looks like and feels like everywhere it shows up across every medium! the identity system (logo, type, color, grid, motion language), the guidelines we use to pass to our agencies and freelance partners, and how we think about craft and brand for the entire business. you'll bring it to life across web, social, launch creative, decks, and collateral. when we ship a new feature or run a launch, you're making the page look incredible, designing launch video, and setting the visual story. this is brand and identity work rather product ui (levi owns our in-app surfaces), and not code. if you think of yourself as a design engineer, this probably isn't the right fit (but we are hiring those too -- look at our careers page!!)i care about this a lot, which is why the bar is high. we always evaluate portfolio first. i want to see identity work you've built from the ground the opportunitywe are seeking a senior performance creative strategist who can turn customer insight, offer strategy, and real campaign data into compelling advertising concepts that attract and convert qualified buyers.this person sits at the intersection of growth strategy, media, copy, creative design, and video production — developing ideas worth testing, writing clear creative briefs, and using campaign results to make each round of creative stronger. the role supports multiple revenue programs across business education, live events, real estate, and emerging offers.this is not a traditional brand-only strategist, production coordinator, or senior copywriter. we need someone who is equally comfortable reviewing paid social performance, developing a breakthrough hook, briefing a designer or editor, and defending a creative recommendation with evidence.what you will own audience and offer insight: study customer segments, objections, motivations, sales conversations, surveys, organic content, competitor advertising, and prior campaign results to identify persuasive creative opportunities. performance concepts: develop differentiated hooks, angles, storylines, proof points, visual directions, formats, and calls to action for static ads, carousels, short-form video, paid social, and youtube/video campaigns. creative testing strategy: build and maintain a prioritized testing roadmap with clear hypotheses, primary variables, intended audiences, success criteria, and next steps for winners and underperforming concepts. actionable creative briefs: create concise briefs and concept boards that give copy, design, and video production clear direction on the message, structure, references, deliverables, and approval requirements. creative performance analysis: partner with media buyers and analytics to evaluate hook and hold rates, click-through rate, qualified-lead cost, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, and downstream sales signals. cross-functional iteration: work with growth, conversion optimization, lifecycle, and organic teams to keep the ad promise aligned with the landing-page and follow-up experience. creative learning system: maintain a searchable library of tests, winning angles, customer insights, and production learnings so successful concepts can be reused and failed ideas are not repeated. brand and claims discipline: ensure concepts stay true to the grant cardone brand voice and meet standards for factual claims, testimonials, earnings references, offer accuracy, and advertising-platform policies.how the role fits the pod model creative leadership owns overall creative direction, brand standards, creative quality, staffing, and capacity. this role develops performance concepts and testing recommendations within that framework. growth strategists / growth marketing managers own the integrated campaign plan and full-funnel business outcomes. this role owns the creative hypotheses, messaging angles, and concept-level testing agenda that support that plan. copy owns final ad copy and scripts. creative design owns visual execution. video production owns filming, editing, and finished video assets. this role defines concept intent and provides strategic feedback. media buyers own ad-account setup, spend, bidding, and channel optimization. this role partners with them on creative evaluation and testing but does not independently control budget or publish campaigns.what you bring 5+ years of experience in performance creative strategy, direct-response advertising, growth-focused content strategy, or a closely related discipline. a portfolio demonstrating measurable acquisition, conversion, or revenue outcomes. strong practical understanding of paid-social creative, particularly meta, with working familiarity across youtube/video and google demand-generation formats. proven ability to turn customer research and campaign evidence into creative concepts, testable hypotheses, persuasive hooks, storyboards, and clear briefs. strong direct-response and storytelling instincts, with the ability to draft rough copy or scripts and give specific feedback to writers, designers, and video producers. strong analytical fluency across creative and business performance, including creative fatigue, video retention, conversion rate, qualified-lead cost, customer acquisition cost, and return on ad spend. excellent collaboration, prioritization, presentation, and feedback skills, with confidence working across senior stakeholders, media buyers, analysts, and production teams.preferred experience live events, webinars, education, coaching, consulting, real estate, or other high-consideration and sales-assisted customer journeys. experience marketing multiple offers to different audiences. familiarity with meta ads manager, google analytics, business intelligence dashboards, creative analytics tools, ad libraries, creator/user-generated-content formats, figma, or similar briefing tools. responsible use of artificial intelligence tools to accelerate research, concept development, and creative iteration.how success is measured a consistent pipeline of insight-led concepts and production-ready briefs with clear hypotheses and strategic rationale. improved creative win rates and faster learning across campaign testing. measurable improvement in qualified customer acquisition and buyer economics attributable to stronger creative. reduced creative fatigue and stronger consistency between advertising messages, landing pages, and follow-up experiences. strong cross-functional collaboration and documented reuse of successful customer insights and creative learnings.

rise.miami is a place like no other, and it does its best work when those who care about this city work side by side. we back the people and programs already making miami better, and help them reach more families.we champion a miami where every family can thrive, with a great public school down the street, a home they can afford and a fast, safe way across town. these three areas shape a family's quality of life. when one falls behind, the whole household feels it, which is why we work on all three together.why join usfreedom to build. you'll have real autonomy to shape your work, try new ideas and see them through, on a small team that moves fast and trusts its people.a think tank and a do tank. we don't stop at the report. we do the research, then put resources and relationships type: full time, exempt  location: remote or hybrid (rockville, md) salary range: $70,000-73,000  move united, an affiliate of the u.s. olympic and paralympic committee and a national leader in sports and recreation for individuals with disabilities, is seeking a communications  manager.   move united is an expanding, thriving charity dedicated to the life-changing power of sports for youth and adults with disabilities. the candidate will join a fast-paced team at a dynamic nonprofit with the opportunity to make an extraordinary difference in achieving the organization’s vision 2028.   move united uses the power of sport to push what’s possible for people with disabilities, confronting ignorance, fueling conversation, and inciting action that leads us to a world where everyone is included. we believe that sports make us more -- more determined, more powerful, more ourselves. we also see the power sports has to change the world, pushing people further and bringing people closer.   to this end, move united holds the vision that every person, regardless of ability, has an equal opportunity to participate in sports and recreation in their community. as we enter the next phase of our vision 2028, we seek to add an energized person to our dedicated team to help us fulfill our vision to impact more americans.   founded in 1956, move united provides adaptive sports opportunities through 250+ community-based member organizations serving more than 131,000 youth and adults with disabilities in 45 states. move united offers a highly collaborative work environment, a commitment to professional development, a flexible work environment, a generous benefits package, and an important mission.   i. general description (position overview)   the communications manager is move united’s chief storyteller, bringing our brand to life and sharing the stories of our athletes, member organizations, and programs across our movement and the country. this role manages our current channels, including email, podcast, video, livestream, social media, print, and earned media. it also shapes how we communicate today and identifies the best channels to reach new audiences. the communications manager acts as a key representative for move united at events, conferences, seminars, trade shows, and media opportunities. the role will also support other special events, administrative and programmatic areas as needed and may supervise staff. some travel, including weekends, is required. reporting to the director of marketing & communications, this position plays an important role in executing move united’s vision 2028, specifically supporting awareness efforts to position the organization as the recognized leader in community-based adaptive sports. the ideal candidate brings a strong background in inclusive and accessible communications best practices for audiences across a range of disabilities, including people who are deaf or hard of hearing, people who are blind or have low vision, and people with cognitive disabilities.  i. position requirements experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in communications, marketing, or media production required. education: minimum undergraduate degree in communications, journalism, marketing, or a related field required. core competencies & media relations: strong knowledge and experience in communications, proactive media pitching, storytelling, digital content creation, email marketing, project management, customer service, efficient multi-tasking, and attention to detail. accessible communications: working knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive language, including captioning, transcripts, audio description, alt-text, plain language, and accessible design for digital and print materials. multimedia production & broadcast management: demonstrated ability to produce, edit, and repurpose multimedia content (audio, video, and graphics) for digital platforms. experience overseeing video and livestream production, including developing storyboards and scripts, managing production vendors/contractors, and coaching on-air talent or event announcers. technical proficiency: proficiency in microsoft office suite, email marketing platforms, crm/database management, and digital content, podcasting, and livestreaming tools. experience with tools we currently use (such as constant contact, descript, riverside, canva, and youtube live) is a plus. leadership & judgment: proven ability to network, build partnerships, work independently, and exercise sound judgment and effective decision-making. supervisory experience is preferred. collaboration: demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. innovation & adaptability: curiosity about emerging platforms, technologies, and audience trends, with a track record of testing new channels, measuring results, and adapting strategy. travel: ability to travel within the united states (including some weekends). iii. specific responsibilities communications, email marketing & podcast content work with the director of marketing and communications and staff to implement move united’s communications, digital media, and branding strategies. maintain, update, and distribute move united’s annual organizational key talking points, mission messaging, and program boilerplates to ensure consistent, accurate language across staff, leadership, grant proposals, press releases, and external materials. manage move united’s email marketing strategy and execution:  produce and distribute move united’s general e-newsletter, including developing themes, gathering content, and growing the subscriber database. manage email marketing workflows, including audience segmentation, contact management, and performance tracking. provide training to staff.  review, edit, and approve external email communications drafted by various departments to ensure messaging accuracy, accessibility, and adherence to organizational branding guidelines.  manage video and livestream production to elevate move united’s digital storytelling: oversee video and livestream vendor contracts, production schedules, and deliverables from pre-production through final delivery. develop creative briefs, storyboards, scripts, and shot lists for athlete spotlights, program features, event recaps, and livestream broadcasts. recruit, schedule, and train commentators, and announcers for livestreams and video productions, providing talking points, pronunciation guides, and run-of-show briefings. review and approve rough cuts, graphics overlays, and final deliverables to ensure brand consistency and accessibility compliance (including accurate closed platforms  create derivative digital content from each episode, including short-form video reels, audiograms, social media graphics, seo-friendly show notes, and blog recaps, to drive audience growth and engagement. ensure all podcast and digital content meets accessibility standards (including accurate transcripts, closed captions, and alt-text). track and analyze podcast download metrics, waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. since its start as the google self-driving car project in 2009, waymo has focused on building the waymo driver—the world's most experienced driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. the waymo driver powers waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. the waymo driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ u.s. states.as a member of the communications team, you’ll be on the cutting edge of bringing autonomous driving technology to the public, developing strategies that will increase understanding, acceptance, and adoption of this life-saving technology. we work with reporters, editors, bloggers, and other influencers to tell stories about waymo and the potential of our technology to change how we move and live. we partner with the engineering, business, policy, marketing, and product teams to create messaging for new products and other initiatives, counter misinformation, and shape our reputation.this role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the pr lead, product & technology.you willown waymo’s proactive safety narrative and data storytelling: partner closely with waymo’s senior director of safety science and research teams to analyze safety performance data, launch regular safety impact data hub updates, and translate peer-reviewed studies into compelling outbound stories.build and mobilize third-party credibility: cultivate strategic alignment and co-storytelling with external researchers, validators, and partners across academia, public health, insurance, and safety organizations to reinforce trust and support waymo’s license to operate and expand.drive policy-aligned safety campaigns and sub-narratives: translate core safety and policy narratives for broader audiences—spanning first responder training and partnerships, women’s personal safety, teen rider trust, and other priority initiativesconnect safety to waymo’s technical foundation: collaborate with technical and product comms peers to articulate how waymo’s ai, simulation, hardware, and engineering rigor are purpose-built with safety at the core.scale bespoke safety campaigns globally: direct pr agency partners, oversee contractor support, and collaborate with country and regional pr leads to bring localized safety campaigns to life at the international, national, and local level as waymo scales in 2027 and beyond.partner on policy cycles and spokesperson readiness: serve as the primary comms handler for safety research leadership—prepping spokespeople, stepping in as an on-the-record spokesperson as needed, and partnering with policy comms to weave waymo’s broader safety approach into ongoing policy education and incident response moments.you have10+ years of communications experience (in-house or agency), grounded in public policy pr with strong technology or auto communications roots.proven executive presence and counsel: track record serving as the primary comms handler for senior technical, research, or executive leaders—able to advise, challenge, and earn trust from day one.deep media, validator, and spokesperson instincts: strong experience working across policy, business, tech, and science/safety press; experience partnering with third-party validators; and readiness to go on the record as a spokesperson.agency, contractor, and global campaign leadership: experience directing pr agencies, managing extended/contractor support, and collaborating across regional or international teams to land cohesive campaigns.solid incident-response judgment: familiarity with regulatory and issues communications, with the ability to partner smoothly with policy comms and legal on high-stakes, regulatory-level moments without losing focus on proactive storytelling.we preferfluency with data and peer-reviewed research: demonstrated ability to turn complex quantitative studies, white papers, and safety benchmarks into clear, accurate outbound narratives.experience communicating in regulated, safety-critical, or frontier technology spaces (e.g., public health, mobility, aerospace, ai, insurance, or energy); automotive experience is not required.ability to translate data-heavy and policy-heavy narratives into accessible, human-centered stories for broader mainstream audiences.a knack for data storytelling: experience launching recurring data hubs, transparency reports, or major research publications.education: bachelor’s degree in communications, public policy, journalism, public health, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).travel requirements10–15% domestic and international travel (estimated up to 15%) for team collaboration, industry/academic conferences, and media events.the expected base salary range for this full-time position across us locations is listed below. actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.waymo employees are also eligible to participate in waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.salary range$200,000—$247,000 usd

execution across traditional and digital channels, content creation, and demand generation marketing. this is a high-output role that requires comfort with creative production, measurement, sows, timelines, deliverable quality, and budget reconciliation.write comprehensive creative briefs, campaign briefs, and website briefs that ensure agencies and contractors deliver on-strategy output with minimal revision cycles.collateral development & content enhancementaudit, refresh, and expand the realcold sales collateral library on a rolling basis, including sell sheets, capability calculators, and interactive tools that support buyer education across awareness, consideration, and decision stages.coordinate with operations and subject matter experts to source technical accuracy (for campaigns, verticals, and events), seo optimization, and conversion rate improvements — with measurable goals against traffic, time-on-site, and form fill rates.develop and publish a consistent communications, or public relations.minimum of three (3) years of b2b marketing experience, with a demonstrable portfolio of executed campaigns, collateral, and digital programs.knowledge, skills, and abilities:hands-on proficiency with marketing automation and crm platforms (hubspot preferred).fluency in web analytics tools (google analytics, search console) and data visualization platforms mavericks wantedwhen was the last time you achieved the impossible? if that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on in 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. this model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. we build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. if you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. at bridgebio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of ai to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.position summaryyou are a fast, precise communications writer and operator who can help take a story from first draft to live – a press release on the wire, a disease awareness campaign across our channels, an all-company email in a leader's inbox. you know biotech news flow and the review gates every piece has to clear, and you know how to help make a rare disease visible to the people who need to recognize it, without crossing the promotional line. you're energized by the craft of execution – drafting, routing, scheduling, tracking – and you're eager to grow your scope as you learn the business.the senior manager of corporate communications will support bridgebio's corporate news flow, owned channels, disease awareness and education, and internal and executive communications. you will report to and work hand-in-hand with the director of communications, who sets direction and reviews and approves the work, while continuing to lead communications for regulatory milestones, launches, earnings, and financings. the team sits within brand & communications and you'll work daily with patient advocacy, medical affairs, investor relations, legal, regulatory, people, marketing, and our agency partners.this is a hands-on role with real room to grow. we want someone who takes initiative, spots gaps, brings ideas forward, and takes as much pride in distribution as in the narrative behind it. as you build expertise and trust, you'll take on increasing responsibility for workstreams within the function.why this role mattersbridgebio's newsflow has never been heavier. we are issuing roughly a press release a week – data readouts, congress curtain raisers, clinical and regulatory milestones, earnings, and financings – while preparing for three more commercial launches on top of attruby. across our portfolio, many of the conditions we work in are underdiagnosed or misdiagnosed, which makes disease awareness and education some of the most important work we do. our audience is growing quickly, and more teams across the company are asking communications for help telling their stories. this role adds the capacity we need to sustain that pace with quality.what you'll dopress releases & corporate newsflowpartner closely with director of communications, providing regular updates on in-flight work, flagging emerging issues and opportunities, and contributing ideas to communications planning across the team. draft recurring corporate press releases – congress curtain raisers, clinical milestones (e.g., first patient dosed), corporate announcements, etc. – for review by the director of u.s. communications, and support regulatory, earnings, and financing releases as needed support releases through bridgebio's press release review protocol: route drafts to reviewers, consolidate comments, track approvals against deadlines, and qc every detail support the path from draft to distribution across our owned channel ecosystem, including proof review, wire and nasdaq timing, ir email alerts, website posting, and partner notifications, in coordination with investor relations and bd draft supporting materials for announcements, such as internal companywide emails, board of directors notes, partner notifications, and social copy disease awareness & educationsupport planning, keeping up to date, and executing bridgebio's annual disease awareness calendar – rare disease day, condition-specific awareness days and months, and key advocacy moments draft unbranded disease education content – explainers, carousels, short-form video scripts, fact sheets, and patient and caregiver stories – that helps patients, families, and clinicians recognize conditions earlier, and help move it through medical, legal, and regulatory review help elevate patient, caregiver, and advocacy voices with appropriate consent, amplify advocacy partners' campaigns, and support coordinating paid amplification and tracking performance help bring awareness moments inside the company through internal communications, employee social toolkits, office screens, and lunch & learnsmaintain bridgebio's library of approved disease fact sheets and awareness assets so they can be reused quickly and compliantly social media & company channelssupport execution of bridgebio’s social strategy by drafting and managing day-to-day organic content and, in partnership with our digital media team and media agency, paid content for our channels (linkedin, x, facebook, instagram, youtube, tiktok)– announcements, congress recaps, awareness moments, on rare podcast promotion, culture and recruitment content support the day-to-day social review workflow: veeva/mlr submissions and material codes, legal and affiliate review serve as a first point of contact for social requests from medical affairs, patient advocacy, and other teams. support updates to corporate website and insights page content, and help coordinate social across bridgebio and affiliate entities (e.g., gondolabio, bbot) work with our social agency on creative, community monitoring, and reporting; prepare the regular analytics readout with observations on what's working internal & executive communicationsdraft all-company emails, leadership announcements, and organizational updates tied to corporate detail.desc: job description:at remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.we're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. if that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.remitly is evolving its brand, moving from a remittance app to the financial partner people rely on to live seamlessly across borders. organic social is a key place that brand shows up, connecting us with customers and communities in their own languages, every day.as senior manager, content strategy – organic social, you'll lead remitly's organic consumer social strategy across markets and languages, end to end. that spans content strategy and editorial, the serialized formats and creator programs that bring our brand voice to life, social listening and community management, and measurement and optimization. you'll lead a team of content specialists and agency partners, reporting to the director, global brand.what you'll do:own the organic social strategy. set and socialize the strategic direction for the function, ensuring cross-functional partners understand and know how to input into the approach. regularly merchandise results and learnings internally to uplevel the program.lead content development. oversee established content pillars, assess where they need to be augmented or evolved, and set channel roles and a quarterly plan across instagram, tiktok, youtube, facebook, rednote and emerging consumer-facing platforms.build repeatable content. develop serialized series (product features, customer faqs, how-to tutorials) that can be localized and reused across markets.run creator, ugc and ambassador content. brief and manage creators and production partners, and partner with the ambassador program on content that stays on-brand and compliant.go local. work with regional and language leads (including spanish and mandarin) to build content that sounds like it's from each market, not translated into it.turn listening into action. use social listening to track sentiment and themes, feed insights to product, cs and marketing, and set the playbook for community management and escalations.run intake and partnerships. own the social intake process for requests from product marketing, regional and corporate showcase oar mission, work, and activities across a variety of communications platforms and events  provide advice and recommendations to the oar communications director and oar laboratory and program leadership on sensitive issues, opportunities for engagement, and strategies for improved communications  document workflows and maintain organized files containing data associated with communications work required qualifications  ba/bs in a technical or business discipline — communications, journalism, science communications, environmental science, public affairs, or a closely related field detail.desc: position summaryjoin an influential team where you will help accelerate the growth and reputation of evernorth health services, a division of the cigna group. as a brand strategy senior advisor, you will translate business strategy, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and consumer and client insights into differentiated brand strategies that define where evernorth can uniquely win.you will lead high-impact work across brand positioning, portfolio and brand architecture, and awareness and reputation; own the evernorth naming function; and provide strategic brand leadership on complex, high-visibility enterprise initiatives and decisions, including those tied to business transformation.this role requires strong strategic thinking and problem solving, paired with the ability to bring strategy to life across key audiences and touchpoints. we are looking for a creative thinker who brings new ideas and a clear point of view, can distill complexity into actionable direction, collaborates effectively across marketing and the business, and can execute multiple priorities in a highly matrixed environment.key accountabilities includelead brand positioning and architecture. assess market, category and competitive dynamics to find opportunities for differentiation, and turn those insights into clear positioning, strategic recommendations, and differentiated messaging across go-to-market and brand relationship situations.provide strategic brand perspectives on complex enterprise decisions, including business transformation, m&a, portfolio evolution, new business models and new entity creation. translate complex business challenges into simple, compelling narratives, frameworks and recommendations for senior leadership.own the enterprise naming function, guiding naming strategy and identity development across m&a, new businesses, products and services, innovation, technology platforms, digital experiences and major enterprise initiatives.own critical workstreams supporting the evernorth brand migration, including legal and regulatory alignment and the development of enterprise playbooks that enable consistent brand adoption and execution.elevate the brand narrative and identity, partnering with creative teams and agencies to ensure consistent application across internal and external activation opportunities.use brand health, audience, competitive and market research to uncover insights and identify strategic opportunities. define success measures for major brand initiatives, and use performance, market and brand data to measure impact and inform ongoing strategic decisions.partner with key stakeholders across evernorth lines of business and with internal and external partners to understand dependencies, coordinate brand projects and execute strategies.socialize and educate internal and external teams on brand strategy and implementation.serve as a strategic thought leader, bringing a clear point of view, challenging conventional thinking and providing decisive guidance despite ambiguity.ideal candidates will offer8+ years of experience in brand strategy, marketing or a related field, including b2c and/or b2b brand and marketing strategy with messaging to multiple target groups.accomplished brand strategist and big-picture thinker who can translate business strategy and goals into brand strategy.strategic problem solver and creative thinker with a passion for creative expression and for improving the way companies relate to clients and customers.proven ability to distill complex situations and information into clear guidance, strategic frameworks and executive summaries, backed by strong writing and presentation skills.persuasive storyteller with well-honed communication skills who builds partnerships, informs and influences effectively, and builds trust.experience using data and research to inform strategy and execution.experienced in anticipating, understanding and meeting the needs of internal and external stakeholders, including working with communications, marketing and creative teams, and collaborating with internal and external agencies and creative resources.highly motivated and driven to succeed, with proven leadership skills and demonstrated expertise in a matrixed environment.able to manage multiple projects and priorities at the same time, deliver despite ambiguity, stay effective under pressure, and work both independently and as part of a team.ability to work from a cigna group office 3 days a week, as directed by the business. if you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10mbps download/5mbps upload.for this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 118,500 - 197,500 usd / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.this role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.at the cigna group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. we also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. for more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.about the cigna groupdoing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. at the cigna group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. through our divisions cigna healthcare and evernorth health services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. join us in driving growth and improving lives.qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.if you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the online application process, please email seeyourself@thecignagroup.com for assistance. please note that this email inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests only and cannot provide application updates or accept resumes.the cigna group has a tobacco-free policy and reserves the right not to hire tobacco/nicotine users in states where that is legally permissible. candidates in such states who use tobacco/nicotine will not be considered for employment unless they enter a qualifying smoking cessation program prior to the start of their employment. these states include: alabama, alaska, arizona, arkansas, delaware, florida, georgia, hawaii, idaho, iowa, kansas, maryland, massachusetts, michigan, nebraska, ohio, pennsylvania, texas, utah, vermont, and washington state.qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances.

when you join verizonyou want more out of a career. a place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. at verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. we do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. our v team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. in crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. want in? join the #vteamlife.what you'll be doing…sitting within the creative strategy organization and reporting to the senior director of brand strategy & gtm, the associate director of strategy & insights takes on the most complex strategic challenges facing verizon’s brand and spearheads marketing briefs that inspire compelling and breakthrough campaigns.this role is a hybrid between a strategist and a consultant - you will own the marketing brief and the insight behind it, quickly build a deep understanding of verizon’s range of products, services, and audiences, and synthesize data from a wide range of sources into one point of view that senior leaders and business partners act on. your work ensures that creative strategy across the brand ladders up to a cohesive brand narrative and expression.responsibilitiesown the brief: develop briefs for the team’s key brand initiatives, distilling audience, brand, cultural, and category insights into a single-minded proposition and a clear creative challenge. provide inspiration and strategic guidance during development, and give clear, constructive feedback that elevates the craft. partner with the associate director of brand go-to-market on channel strategy.uncover audience insights: go beyond demographics to understand the tensions, motivations, behaviors, and needs of consumer, small business, and enterprise audiences. source and synthesize quantitative and qualitative data from a wide range of sources, including custom research, segmentation, brand tracking, social analytics, syndicated reports, competitive intelligence, and in-market performance, into clear strategic recommendations. build audience portraits and segment narratives that give creative teams someone real to write for, using custom research with cmi where needed.read culture: track and interpret cultural shifts, fandom, creator ecosystems, and platform behavior. identify where verizon can credibly show up and what is worth saying, and translate those signals into creative territories.diagnose the category and competition: analyze category trends, competitor positioning, and white space across wireless, home, and business connectivity to find the points of difference the creative should own.partner across lines of business: collaborate with the creative strategy leads for consumer and business to sharpen their briefs and drive a more cohesive brand narrative and expression. adapt your approach to the different needs, purchase journeys, and cultural contexts of consumer and business audiences.test & optimize messaging and ideas with cmi: partner with cmi to design and run research that tests messaging, creative platforms, and ideas. use findings to shape the brief, refine concepts and choose between directions. translate results into clear guidance for creative teams and agencies.what we're looking for…you'll need to have:bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.experience in portfolio strategy, or at brands with a wide range of products, services, and audiences across consumer and business.a proven record of writing creative briefs that led to effective, award-worthy, or business-moving work.hands-on experience with messaging, concept, and creative testing, and with turning results into clear creative direction.demonstrated experience with qualitative and quantitative research, including segmentation, brand tracking, competitive analysis, and cultural trend analysis.even better if you have one or more of the following:experience in a fast-paced, matrixed creative organization.strong analytical skills, with the ability to quickly build a deep understanding of varied products, services, and audiences, and to source and synthesize data from a wide range of sources.experience leading development of custom research.executive presence and exceptional storytelling skills, with the ability to engage creative teams and senior executives alike.a collaborative, curious, and influential working style in a matrixed environment, with the ability to partner with peers and leads without direct authority.master’s degree.if verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.where you’ll be workingin this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three opportunityverizon is an equal opportunity employer. we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.benefits and vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, ad&d insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. we also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve summaryjob description: the director, brand strategy & execution provides enterprise leadership for the development, governance, and evolution of brand strategy across the organization's portfolio of brands. working closely with executive leadership and key partners, this role defines enterprise brand priorities, evaluates market opportunities, leverages customer and competitive insights, and develops long-term strategies that strengthen market position, support business growth, and advance organizational objectives.the director serves as the enterprise steward of brand architecture, positioning, and governance, ensuring a cohesive and differentiated brand portfolio aligned with organizational priorities. this role provides strategic oversight for brand performance, brand compliance, and enterprise brand engagement initiatives while establishing the strategic direction and standards that guide brand-related activities across the organization.essential accountabilitiesleads development, implementation, and continuous evolution of the enterprise brand strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational vision, growth objectives, and market opportunities.serves as the enterprise authority for brand architecture, positioning, governance, and portfolio strategy across all organizational brands.partners with executive leadership and business partners to establish brand priorities, strategic objectives, and performance expectations.defines and maintains clear, differentiated brand positioning, value propositions, and messaging frameworks that support enterprise and line-of-business objectives.evaluates proposed brands, affiliations, partnerships, joint ventures, acquisitions, and other strategic opportunities for portfolio alignment, market impact, and brand fit.leads assessment of market trends, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and performance analytics to identify strategic opportunities, risks, and recommendations.establishes enterprise brand governance standards and ensures consistent application of brand guidelines across internal and external audiences, channels, and customer groups.serves as the primary enterprise liaison with the blue cross blue shield association regarding brand standards, compliance requirements, and strategic initiatives.establishes strategic direction and performance expectations for enterprise social media and digital brand engagement efforts to ensure alignment with brand objectives and organizational priorities.oversees development and monitoring of brand performance measures, including brand awareness, reputation, engagement, preference, and business impact.collaborates with teams and business leaders across the enterprise to ensure integrated execution of enterprise brand strategies.leads strategic planning related to brand evolution, market expansion, reputation management, and long-term enterprise growth.oversees external agencies, consultants, and vendors supporting brand strategy, research, and development initiatives.provides leadership, coaching, and development to team members, fostering accountability, professional growth, and achievement of organizational goals.prepares and presents strategic recommendations, insights, and performance updates to executive leadership and other senior leaders.consistently demonstrates about nightnight is a next-generation media holding company redefining talent representation for the digital age. night manages over 400 of the world's most influential digital creators, artists, and athletes. with a digital-first ethos, night has emerged as a cultural powerhouse at the intersection of entertainment, entrepreneurship, and the creator economy. the company's comprehensive suite of services includes talent management, a venture studio, a rapidly growing licensing division, and a top-tier podcast network. as the traditional media landscape continues to evolve, night is building the infrastructure that empowers individual creators to become global brands.about the rolewe're hiring a sports content strategist to lead content and athlete brand strategy across the night sports roster - this role will help our athletes build audiences, personal brands, and commercial value that lasts beyond any single season. this is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role. working alongside night sports managers, you will be responsible for taking the long-term vision for an athlete and turning it into an actionable strategy across their personal brand, social platforms, and broader business.what makes night different is the network we bring to every athlete. we sit at the intersection of sports and the internet in a way that traditional sports agencies can’t. our athletes don't have to guess what works online or have marginalized commercial opportunities - they have direct access to some of the most engaged audiences on the internet, and a team that knows how to activate them authentically. the sports content strategist will be the person who figures out how to turn that structural advantage into content and moments that move culture.our sports managers are exceptional at developing athlete relationships and structuring deals. what they need is a dedicated content and brand expert who can build each athlete's digital presence with intention - someone who closes the gap between a great athlete and a brand people follow.what you’ll do develop and execute content strategy across night's sports roster, tailored to each athlete's sport, season, personality, and commercial goals  originate creative concepts across long form and short form digital channels - content series, creator collaborations, behind-the-scenes formats, moment-driven hooks - and own their execution  build content calendars around the sports cycle: training camp, season, playoffs, draft, offseason, and key career moments  broker collaborations between athletes and night's creator roster to drive cross-pollinated audience growth  source and manage external creative resources including videographers, editors, photographers, producers and other specialists  partner with sports managers and the brand partnerships team to make athletes more valuable to sponsors  track performance across platforms and translate data into clear recommendations for athletes and managers  stay sharp on platform trends, emerging formats, and what's cutting through in sports what we’re looking for 3 - 5+ years of experience in sports content, athlete marketing, social strategy, or a closely related role (team, league, agency, media brand, or in-house)  experience working directly with athletes or talent, not just team or consumer brand accounts  equal parts strategist and executor - you can develop a content vision and deliver it  deep fluency in social platforms: short-form video, instagram, tiktok, youtube  ability to identify the story, personality, and positioning that make an athlete interesting beyond their competition performance  strong storytelling and communications instincts, with an understanding of what can become an earned-media moment and when to bring in pr expertise  strong project management instincts - the ability to manage strategies and timelines across multiple athletes simultaneously  comfort operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment

growth-focused content strategy, or a closely related discipline.a portfolio demonstrating measurable acquisition, conversion, or revenue outcomes.strong practical understanding of paid-social creative, particularly meta, with working familiarity across youtube/video and google demand-generation formats.proven ability to turn customer research and campaign evidence into creative concepts, testable hypotheses, persuasive hooks, storyboards, and clear briefs.strong direct-response and storytelling instincts, with the ability to draft rough copy or scripts and give specific feedback to writers, designers, and video producers.strong analytical fluency across creative and business performance, including creative fatigue, video retention, conversion rate, qualified-lead cost, customer acquisition cost, and return on ad spend.excellent collaboration, prioritization, presentation, and feedback skills, with confidence working across senior stakeholders, media buyers, analysts, and production teams.preferred experiencelive events, webinars, education, coaching, consulting, real estate, or other high-consideration and sales-assisted customer journeys.experience marketing multiple offers to different audiences.familiarity with meta ads manager, google analytics, business intelligence dashboards, creative analytics tools, ad libraries, creator/user-generated-content formats, figma, or similar briefing tools.responsible use of artificial intelligence tools to accelerate research, concept development, and creative iteration.how success is measureda consistent pipeline of insight-led concepts and production-ready briefs with clear hypotheses and strategic rationale.improved creative win rates and faster learning across campaign testing.measurable improvement in qualified customer acquisition and buyer economics attributable to stronger creative.reduced creative fatigue and stronger consistency between advertising messages, landing pages, and follow-up experiences.strong cross-functional collaboration and documented reuse of successful customer insights and creative learnings.

summary/objective:salience health is looking for a marketing project & communications manager who can bring structure, momentum, and consistency to a growing, multi-location marketing department.at the center of this role is exceptional project management. this person will coordinate marketing initiatives from idea through execution—building timelines, managing dependencies, driving approvals, coordinating internal and external partners, and making sure projects keep moving and deadlines are met.the right person is also a strong, thoughtful writer who can learn salience deeply enough to calendars.manage creative intake, assignments, production schedules, review cycles, approvals, and asset delivery.coordinate projects across providers, clinics, internal stakeholders, agencies, vendors, and other external partners.track outstanding work, anticipate roadblocks, and proactively communicate risks or delays.own follow-up and accountability so projects do not stall waiting for feedback, approvals, assets, or decisions.build repeatable workflows and processes that improve how marketing operates.  copywriting & brand communicationswrite and edit compelling copy across campaigns, email, websites, landing pages, provider communications, patient communications, internal and executive communications, social, print, events, and other marketing projects.coordinate internal communications across the organization, including communication planning, message development, stakeholder input, approvals, scheduling, and distribution.learn and help maintain the salience voice across audiences and channels.translate clinical or complex information into language that is understandable without losing its meaning or accuracy.write with the audience in mind—understanding that communicating with a patient requires something different than communicating with a physician or employee.edit and proofread work for voice, clarity, accuracy, consistency, and impact.work with clinical and operational stakeholders to ensure messaging is both accurate and human.marketing operations & executioncoordinate day-to-day execution across digital, print, email, web, content, events, pr, and other marketing channels.coordinate website and intranet content, updates, publishing, and ongoing content maintenance.support campaign setup, scheduling, testing, qa, launch readiness, and distribution.coordinate website and intranet updates and routine publishing.manage print, collateral, signage, inventory, proofs, production, and delivery.maintain organized and accessible marketing assets, files, and project documentation.coordinate agencies, printers, freelancers, media partners, and other vendors.track marketing invoices, pos, subscriptions, renewals, purchasing documentation, and recurring commitments.performance & reportingmaintain recurring marketing dashboards, reports, and performance scorecards.monitor campaign pacing, lead volume, conversion trends, and performance against established goals.identify meaningful trends, issues, or opportunities and help coordinate appropriate next steps.consolidate performance information from crm, analytics, agencies, paid media, and other marketing platforms.monitor campaign links, forms, landing pages, and digital experiences for accuracy and functionality.what success looks likesuccess in this role means marketing work moves forward with greater visibility, consistency, quality, and accountability. projects have clear owners and deadlines, campaigns launch on time, and approvals, assets, or unanswered questions don't quietly stall progress. you keep internal teams and external partners aligned, reporting current, and the details organized while anticipating potential roadblocks early enough to solve them before they become problems.that same level of care carries into how salience communicates. our writing should be clear, thoughtful, accurate, and human, making complex clinical information understandable without losing its meaning. whether we're speaking to a patient, provider, employee, or community partner, our communication should reflect both the credibility of our work and the heart behind it. what it takes to succeed:exceptional project management: you naturally create structure, establish ownership, manage competing priorities, and drive work through completion.strong copywriting: you understand voice, tone, audience, messaging, and storytelling and can turn complicated ideas into clear, compelling copy.operational ownership: you don't simply identify that something is behind—you determine what needs to happen to move it forward.marketing fluency: you understand how content, creative, digital, paid media, email, web, pr, events, and analytics work together.proactive communication: you follow up, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders informed.attention to detail: you care about accuracy, quality, and the small things without losing sight of the larger objective.heart: you understand that behavioral healthcare is different. the words we use matter because the people behind the work matter.ada statementsalience health is committed to descriptionthe asset production manager sits at the intersection of production, creative, and operations. by building close relationships with creative teams and staying in constant communication with cross-functional stakeholders, the asset production manager drives and facilitates the production of marketing assets from inception to deployment.in this role, you will drive the production and delivery of a wide range of assets; gameplay, live-action, and cg trailers, screenshots, key art, b-roll, reactive social content, thumbnails, and more. this includes closely partnering with internal and external teams to ensure that assets are delivered on-time and at high quality. you will also oversee the localization process, maintain the asset production tracker, and manage a vast library of assets. the role owns the relationship with creative agencies and drives the operational work that supports them, including managing pos and wos.importantly, this role does not provide creative direction. instead, it reviews creative work in the context of the production risks and dependencies created by evolving creative requirements, translating creative decisions into production plans and flagging their downstream impact early. the ideal candidate builds strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including product managers, vendors, and licensors.key job responsibilities drive end-to-end production and delivery of marketing assets (gameplay trailers, live-action and cg trailers, screenshots, key art, reactive social content, and thumbnails) from brief to final delivery. build and maintain detailed schedules, workback calendars, and delivery milestones for all assets in production; proactively identify and mitigate risks. review all asset cuts and revisions to track progress, flag how evolving creative requirements affect schedule, budget, and dependencies, and surface impacts to creative directors and product managers early. organize creative reviews with product managers, paid media, licensees/licensors, and developers to gather feedback and secure approvals. manage post-production and creative agency vendors: solicit and review bids, initiate purchase orders (pos) and work orders (wos), and forecast asset production budgets. maintain airtable asset trackers and sync regularly with cross-functional teams on status and timing. own localization delivery, music licensing requests, legal/esrb submissions, and quality control across all final assets. publish trailers to youtube: schedule premieres, configure playlists and end screens, and provide thumbnails and metadata. source and manage in-game assets for vendors by coordinating with game producers and pulling directly from shared asset stores. provide rapid-response asset support for executive and senior leadership requests.a day in the lifeyour morning starts with a production standup reviewing the asset tracker, flagging a trailer revision that risks a localization deadline, and unblocking a vendor waiting on game assets from the studio. by midday you're in a creative review, translating feedback into schedule impacts and updated delivery dates. the afternoon brings a bid review for a new agency, a music licensing request to close out, and a quick qc pass on final assets before they go live. no two days look the same, but every day ends with assets moving forward.about the teamamazon gaming marketing operations builds the engine that helps marketers move faster, work smarter, and stay connected across luna and amazon game studios. we
